name: 2026 Lake Chabot Trail Challenge (Half Marathon & 5K)
description:
“Beginning July 1, 2024, the “Honest Pricing Law” or “Hidden Fees Statute,” SB 478, makes it illegal for businesses to advertise or list a price for a good or service that does not include all required fees or charges other than certain government taxes and shipping costs.”

RACE INFO: We are so excited to celebrate the 42nd annual Lake Chabot Trail Challenge Half Marathon and 5K. This race is well regarded amongst serious trail runners in the outlying areas. The race begins at 8am for the Half Marathon and 8:30am for the 5K. Please arrive early so that you may find parking, pick up your bibs, use restrooms facilities, and be properly prepared to race before the start. Race takes place rain or shine and there are no refunds.

RACE COURSE: The half marathon course is a scenic, hilly loop, mainly on dirt fire roads.  The ridge-line views look down upon scenic Lake Chabot, surrounding grassy slopes, and eucalyptus groves.  Mt. Diablo and San Francisco Bay are visible along the route. There are water stations with first aid and radio support; we recommend bringing your own hydration as well.  The half marathon has a time limit of 3.5 hours. The 5k (3.1 miles) course is an out and back that has gentle rolling hills and consists mostly of paved surfaces.  This route includes one water station with first aid and radio support.

RACE FEE: Pre-registered runners will be guaranteed a t-shirt if registered by Sunday, May 10th, 2026.  The price for the 5K is $40 and Half Marathon $65. You must register by Saturday, June 6th. We will accept race day registration; however, the price for the 5K is $45 and Half Marathon $70. If you register on race day, we can only accept cash, check or Venmo.

There is a nominal fee (~$5) for Chabot parking lot. Free parking on Lake Chabot Rd and nearby streets.

RACE PACKET & BIB PICK-UP:  We will have race packet and bib pick-up on Sunday, June 7th starting at 7am at the Willow picnic site which is also the finish line area. We will not be mailing out any race packets or bibs. Both races are chip-timed.

T-SHIRT: Entry fee includes short sleeve, high quality t-shirts for registrations by May 10th so sign-up early.  There are no guarantee of t-shirts for runners registered after that date and on race day. We ask for those who did not get a shirt to check in after the race. Please ensure that you select the appropriate t-shirt size. We will not be doing any size exchanges from your original request.

AWARDS: Finisher's medals to those who complete their race.  Age division medals given to the top 3 in each of 12 age divisions in the half marathon and 9 age divisions in the 5K.

Photos:  Race photos are being provided by Darrell Lavin of Darrell Lavin Photography. You will receive an email post-race for instructions on how to access and purchase official race photos.

QUESTIONS: If you have any questions, please contact Rachel Lunt at teamlunt07@gmail.com.

DIRECTIONS: The entrance closest to the event's parking lot is: 17404 Lake Chabot Road, Castro Valley, CA 94546.  On Google Maps, this will appear as "Entry of Lake Chabot Parking Space."  The registration area and start lines are just a few minutes walk from the lot ( just follow the signs).

name: 2026 Manion WOD - Fin-Law Gym
description:
The Manion WOD (Workout of the Day) is a powerful tribute to 1stLt Travis Manion, USMC, designed to unite veterans, families of the fallen, and inspired civilians in honoring one of our nation’s heroes. Hosted by CrossFit boxes, ruck clubs, and gyms nationwide—or completed virtually anytime, anywhere—this workout challenges its participants to push harder, go further, and grow stronger in memory of those who have sacrificed for our freedoms.

We can’t wait for you to take part in the 2026 Manion WOD! Gear up to challenge yourself, honor our nation’s heroes, and receive your exclusive 2026 Manion WOD shirt—plus the chance to earn even more exclusive rewards.

name: 2026 Mountains 2 Beach Marathon and Half Expo
description:
The Mountains 2 Beach Marathon & Half Expo is where thousands of motivated, health-minded runners — along with their families and friends — gather before race day to pick up bibs, shop, sample products, and connect with brands they trust.

Set along the California coast, Mountains 2 Beach attracts runners from across the country who are serious about performance, recovery, lifestyle — and supporting businesses that help them feel and perform their best.

As a vendor, you’ll be front-and-center with a captive, energized audience that is actively browsing, asking questions, and ready to purchase.

Why Vendors Love This Expo

  • High-intent audience

Boston-qualifying runners, endurance athletes, first-timers, and active families
Strong interest in nutrition, recovery tools, apparel, shoes, wellness, tech, travel, and experiences
Built-in traffic

  • Every participant must pass through the expo to pick up race packets
    Consistent foot traffic throughout the day — not just short rush periods
  • Meaningful engagement
  • Time for conversation, demos, sampling, and education
  • Opportunity to collect emails, give coupons, and drive repeat business
  • Brand visibility beyond race weekend
  • Integration opportunities in athlete communications
    Social amplification and content opportunities
    Word-of-mouth inside a deeply loyal running community

What Vendors Can Expect

  • A professional, well-organized layout with easy access and set-up
  • Support from an experienced event team who understands vendor needs
  • Space options to fit everything from boutique displays to full activation setups
  • A positive, festival-style atmosphere that makes conversations easy and fun


This is more than a race expo — it’s a chance to connect with an audience that values quality, performance, community, and authentic brands.

If your product helps people move better, feel better, recover smarter, eat well, celebrate, or live an active lifestyle… they’ll be excited to meet you at Mountains 2 Beach.

name: 2026 Optimism Cal Tri Newport Dunes - 11.1.26
description:
2026 Optimism Cal Tri Newport Dunes - 11.1.26. Started in 1978 as the Human Race Triathlon, Cal Tri Newport Dunes is the longest running triathlon in the world operating from the same location. Also started in 1978 was the Ironman World Championship Triathlon Oahu but it moved to Kailua-Kona, Hawaii in 1981. This serves as the Cal Tri Events National Championship Race with registration in the 1500-2000 range.

12 EVENT OPTIONS. 6 Olympic distance events (Triathlon, RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 1640 Yard Swim & 10K Run) and 6 Sprint distance events (Triathlon,  RunBikeRun, SwimBike, SwimRun, 400 yard Swim & 5K Run). Triathlon = swim + bike + run. Typically, the swim and run distances are standard but the bike distance varies from race to race. Check out the course maps for more detailed information.

TO DO. Disneyland Park & California Adventure Park. Balboa Island Ferry. Newport Beach.

AIRPORT. John Wayne (SNA)

AIR TEMPERATURE (AVG). 60 F / 73 F

WATER TEMPERATURE (AVG). 65 F. Wetsuit legal. Use the 20% CALTRI2025 discount code at blueseventy. Note: Fusion wetsuits not eligible for discount.

name: 2026 Silver Strand Half Marathon, 10 Miler, 12K & 5K
description:
🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️ Picture this: A heart-pounding, flat-out run along the closed Silver Strand Highway 79, with the majestic Pacific Ocean on your right and the stunning San Diego Bay on your left. 🌊

But hold onto your running shoes because it's not just a race – it's a BLAST! 🎉 As you tackle the half marathon, 12K, or 10-mile courses, you'll groove to the rhythm of the Taku Drummers, jam to the hottest beats spun by a DJ, and soak in live music that'll have you moving to the groove. 🥁🎵

And when you cross that epic finish line, your jaw will drop! 🏖️🌅 You'll find yourself right on the state beach, toes in the sand, and the ocean's gentle waves washing over the shore. But wait, there's more – get ready for the ultimate California Beach Party, featuring a live band and a buzzing beer garden! 🍻🎸

All of this unfolds as you conquer the iconic "Silver Strand" route from Coronado to Imperial Beach. 🌴

And just a stone's throw away is Coronado Island, seamlessly connected to downtown San Diego by a charming bridge. 🌉

But that's not all – when you participate, you're making a difference. Your involvement supports important causes: the Life Sports Foundation, Team Hoyt, and Islander Sports Foundation.

So, what's stopping you? Join us for the San Diego Half Marathon, 12K, 8 Miler, or 5K and prepare for a race day like no other! 🏆👟

Oh, and here's a little something extra – Special Discounted Pricing for All Branches of Our USA Military enlisted and Veterans (proof of Military ID required at Packet Pick-up). And let's not forget our first responders – Special Discounted Pricing for Police, Fire, FBI, and Border Patrol with valid ID.

Get ready to run, dance, and celebrate – this is going to be LEGENDARY! 🙌 #SilverStrandHalfMarathon"

All races will finish at Silver Strand State Beach. Please be sure to visit our Parking & Buses page to see parking options.

name: 2026 Solana Beach Triathlon & Duathlon and Solana Beach 5K
description:
Mark your calendar for July 26, 2026, and get ready for an unforgettable day of racing along the beautiful Solana Beach coastline. Whether you’re a first-time triathlete or a seasoned racer, this event has it all—an exhilarating ocean swim, a scenic bike ride, and a thrilling coastal run to the finish line.


Why You Should Join:
Prime Beach Location: Race in one of Southern California’s most picturesque beach towns
All Levels Welcome: From first-timers to pros, this triathlon is designed for everyone
Exclusive Finisher Medal & Swag: Walk away with a fantastic tech tee and a finisher’s medal
Support a Cause: This race benefits the Life Sports Foundation, helping foster children and at-risk youth live healthier lives through sports and fitness

Sprint Triathlon
1/4 mile swim - 9 mile bike - 5K run

Sprint Duathlon
1 mile run - 9 mile bike - 5K run

Sprint Aquabike
1/4 mile swim - 9 mile bike

Sprint Aquathlon
1/4 mile swim - 5K run

Solana Beach 5K

🏊 Ocean Swim with a Twist: Dive into the excitement with our surf-entry ocean swim. Safeguarded by dedicated lifeguards and supportive swim buddies, you'll experience the thrill of the Pacific in a safe and encouraging environment.

🚴 Cycle the Legendary Pacific Coast Highway: Pedal your way along the world-famous Pacific Coast Highway. With its breathtaking views and smooth terrain, the bike course promises both challenge and charm, perfect for setting personal records or simply enjoying the ride.
 
🏃 Run with the Ocean Breeze

🎉 A Finish Line Like No Other: As you cross the finish line, be prepared for a tunnel of high-fives, a cascade of cheers, and an atmosphere brimming with excitement. This is more than just the end of the race; it's a moment of triumph, a celebration of your achievement. Come Celebrate in the 🍺 Seek Beer Co Beer Garden!

Whether you're a seasoned triathlete, a duathlon enthusiast, or an aquabike aficionado, the Solana Beach event is tailored to offer a memorable experience. Embrace the challenge, bask in the coastal splendor, and make memories that will last a lifetime.

Join us for an event that’s more than a race — it's a coastal festival of sport, spirit, and community. Register now to be a part of this unforgettable adventure! 🌟

Whether you’re a first-time triathlete or a seasoned racer, this event has it all—an exhilarating ocean swim, a scenic bike ride, and a thrilling coastal run to the finish line.


Why You Should Join:
Prime Beach Location: Race in one of Southern California’s most picturesque beach towns
All Levels Welcome: From first-timers to pros, this triathlon is designed for everyone
Exclusive Finisher Medal & Swag: Walk away with a fantastic tech tee and a finisher’s medal
Support a Cause: This race benefits the Life Sports Foundation, helping foster children and at-risk youth live healthier lives through sports and fitness

Sprint Triathlon
1/4 mile swim - 9 mile bike - 5K run

Sprint Duathlon
1 mile run - 9 mile bike - 5K run

Sprint Aquabike
1/4 mile swim - 9 mile bike

Sprint Aquathlon
1/4 mile swim - 5K run

Solana Beach 5K

🏊 Ocean Swim with a Twist: Dive into the excitement with our surf-entry ocean swim. Safeguarded by dedicated lifeguards and supportive swim buddies, you'll experience the thrill of the Pacific in a safe and encouraging environment.

🚴 Cycle the Legendary Pacific Coast Highway: Pedal your way along the world-famous Pacific Coast Highway. With its breathtaking views and smooth terrain, the bike course promises both challenge and charm, perfect for setting personal records or simply enjoying the ride.
 
🏃 Run with the Ocean Breeze

🎉 A Finish Line Like No Other: As you cross the finish line, be prepared for a tunnel of high-fives, a cascade of cheers, and an atmosphere brimming with excitement. This is more than just the end of the race; it's a moment of triumph, a celebration of your achievement. Come Celebrate in the 🍺 Seek Beer Co Beer Garden!

Whether you're a seasoned triathlete, a duathlon enthusiast, or an aquabike aficionado, the Solana Beach event is tailored to offer a memorable experience. Embrace the challenge, bask in the coastal splendor, and make memories that will last a lifetime.

Join us for an event that’s more than a race — it's a coastal festival of sport, spirit, and community. Register now to be a part of this unforgettable adventure! 🌟

name: 2026 Winters Spooktacular Fun Run and Costume Contest
description:
RACE EVENT DESCRIPTION:

Grab your costume and running shoes and head out to the 2026 Winters Runners and Walkers Club Spooktacular Fun Run and Costume Contest on Sunday, October 25th.  We’re going to have a WICKEDLY good time.  This event is a thriller for the entire family.  In addition to the 1 Mile Adult, 5K Timed & 10K Timed, kids will scream with excitement on the 1 Mile Monster Dash. We will have an individual costume contest, as well as a best group costume contest.  Please join us for Winter’s 7th Annual Halloween Fun Run sponsored by the Winters Runners and Walkers Club. So, if you dare to challenge yourself to a spooky fun time, sign up TODAY and we’ll be waiting for you at the starting line…  Trick-or-Treat!  Happy Halloween!  Nutrishop Electrolyte mix will be available at one of the 5k/10k course water stations.

ONLINE REGISTRATION CLOSING:

Cutoff date for Online Registration is 10/23/26 at 11:59 PM.

REGISTRATION AND PACKET/PU:

Late Registration and Packet Pick-up 10/24/26 (Saturday) in front Hooby's Brewing 9 E. Main Street Winters, Ca 95694 Winters from 10am-4pm & Race Day 10/25/26 (Sunday Race Day) at Rotary Park, corner of Railroad St. and Main Street, Winters, Ca 95694 from 6:30-9:30am.  Sunday Race Day registrations close at the start of each race. 

START TIMES:

8:00am Start 10K (3 Hour Limit after race start time)

8:10am Start 5K (3 Hour Limit after race start time) 

9:30am 1 Mile Kids Monster Dash and 1Mile Adult

REGISTERED PARTICIPANTS:

All Races Finishers receive custom medals. 5K and 10K finishers receives Chip Timing. 1 mile Adult, 5K and 10K Finishers receives a custom medal + Tech Tee + One Free Hooby’s beverage (must be 21 years old for beer) (wine not Included) “ONLY FOR USE ON 10/25 FROM 8:00AM-12:00PM”. 1 Mile Monster Dash Finishers receives a custom medal + Tech Tee.

All Shirts Guaranteed before 10/9/26).  

NOTE:

The 5K & 10K course is open to regular traffic, please observe all traffic laws. Volunteers may be at intersections along the course. The 5K & 10K course will start opening sometime after 10:00 AM, there is a 3 hour timed course Limit for 5K and 10K races after the race start times. The start line will be separated by Pace Markers. 

AWARDS:

Place Awards for 5K&10K Male and Female 1st, 2nd, 3rd place winners. Costume Contest prizes for Individual and Best Group choices 5k / 10K and 1 mile races.

FEES:

1 mile Monster Dash $20.00. 1 mile individual adult/teen $20.00.

5K W/O Shirt 1/26 until 9/11 $30.00. 9/12 until 10/24 $35.00, then $40.00 on Race Day.

5K with Shirt 1/26 until 9/11 $35.00. 9/12 until 10/24 $40.00, then $45.00 on Race Day.

10K W/O Shirt 1/26 until 9/11 $35.00, 9/12 until 10/24 $40.00. then $45.00 on Race Day.

10K with Shirt 1/26 until 9/11 $40.00, 9/12 until 10/24 $45.00. then $50.00 on Race Day.

LODGING:

HOTEL WINTERS  12 Abbey St, Winters, CA 95694 (530) 505-9123 https://www.hotelwinters.com/

FAIRFIELD INN AND SUITES by Marriott 702 Matsumoto Lane, Winters, Ca 95694 (530) 240-3200  https://www.marriott.com/en-us/hotels/sacwi-fairfield-inn-and-suites-sacramento-winters/overview/

ABBEY HOUSE INN   101 Abbey Street Winters, CA 95694 (530) 795-5870  https://abbeyhouseinn.com/

October 25, 2026

8:00 am – 11:30 am

name: 2026 Wolfpack Regional Modern Pentathlon Sanctioned by USA Pentathlon Multisport (USAPM)
description:
The Wolfpack Regional Modern Pentathlon is an all-day event in which participants have an opportunity to compete in all five disciplines of the Olympic sport of Modern Pentathlon as it will be featured at the LA 2028 Games.  These sports include ninja obstacle course racing, fencing, swimming, and laser-run (running and laser pistol shooting).

Competition Venues:
Obstacle Course Race: Ninja Republic in San Mateo, CA
All Other Events: Sequoia High School in Redwood City, CA

Schedule:

8:00 am - 11:00 am: Obstacle Course Race at Ninja Republic

11:30 am - 2:30 pm: Fencing at Sequoia High School Main Gym

3:00 pm - 4:30 pm: Swimming at Sequoia High School Pool

5:00 pm - 8:00 pm: Laser-Run at Sequoia High School Stadium

This event is suitable for people of all genders, abilities, and ages (7+).  No previous experience is needed.

For purposes of division assignment, the age of an athlete is their age as of December 31, 2026. 

For youth athletes, the 2026 Wolfpack Regional Modern Pentathlon will serve as a selection competition for Team USA for the 2026 UIPM Youth and Junior World Championships.  Participants will gain valuable experience for the 2026 USAPM National Championships, which will be held in the Fall (location and date TBD).

Please contact Coach Kirt at president@wolfpackpentathlon.com for more information.

name: 2026 Wolfpack Spring Training Series
description:
This is a series of Saturday training sessions focusing on three of the five disciplines of Modern Pentathlon: laser-run (running and laser pistol shooting), and ninja warrior training.  Fencing will also be offered separately (for a $25 drop-in fee) at Bay Area Fencing Club on Saturday mornings.

Schedule:

11:00 am - 12:30 pm: ($25 drop-in fee) Fencing Training at Bay Area Fencing Club (15445 Los Gatos Blvd.; Los Gatos, CA 95032);

1:30 pm - 2:30 pm: Laser-Run Training at Raymond J. Fisher Middle School;

4:00 pm - 5:00 pm: Ninja Training at Black Urban Barn (148 E. Virginia St. #2; San Jose CA 95112).

The laser-run training will be coached by Coach Kirt or Coach Pablo, both of whom are certified USA Triathlon Associate Coaches and former U.S. Olympic Trials competitors.

The ninja warrior training at Black Urban Barn will be coached by Earl Hooks, four-time competitor on the American Ninja Warrior television show. Participants will receive group coaching from Earl, focusing on strength, flexibility, and other exercises that are needed to master the standard Modern Pentathlon obstacles.

name: 2026 XTERRA WETSUITS Mission Bay Triathlon & San Diego 5K
description:
Mark your calendars for event #3 of the San Diego Triathlon Series & the Triple Crown of Triathlon
📅 Sunday, October 11, 2026
📍 San Diego, CA – Mission Bay

Proud Host of the 2026 USAT State Championships 🏆
The XTERRA WETSUITS Mission Bay Triathlon is proud to once again host the 2026 USA Triathlon State Championships — featuring Age Group, High School, and Club Championships!

Olympic Distance / Sprint Distance / Duathlon / Aquabike / Aquathlon

What This Means for Racers:
🥇 State Champion Titles
Compete for the honor of being crowned California State Champion in your triathlon division (Sprint or International), as well as in High School and Club categories. Olympic Distance / Sprint Distance 
🎽 Coveted State Champion Jersey
1st place winners in each age group, high school, and special category earn the exclusive right to purchase and wear the official California State Championship jersey.
🚩 Club State Championships
All State Championships also serve as the Club State Championships. Clubs (age group & high school) can earn the designation of Top Club in California and win a Club State Champion banner from USA Triathlon.

🎟️ Qualification for Nationals

Sprint Triathlon → Qualifies you for Sprint Nationals
International Triathlon → Qualifies you for Olympic-Distance Nationals
Top 35% of finishers or top 5 athletes (whichever is greater) qualify.
State Championships after June 1, 2026, qualify athletes for both 2026 AND 2027 Nationals.

🎓 High School Championships

Eligibility: Any student currently enrolled in high school and up to six (6) months post-graduation.
Exemption: All athletes who finish a State High School Championship race will automatically qualify for Sprint Nationals, provided they are age 15 or older by December 31, 2026.
🌍 Open to all athletes — residency in California is not required.

Why Race Mission Bay?
Race in San Diego’s iconic Mission Bay, claim your place on the podium, and showcase your achievement in the California State Championship Jersey. 🚴‍♂️🏊‍♀️🏃‍♀️

👉 Don’t miss your moment to race, win, and represent — Register today!

Join us at the birthplace of the sport for the XTERRA Wetsuits Mission Bay Triathlon!

2026 is the 38th annual XTERRA Wetsuits Mission Bay Triathlon benefitting Life Sports Foundation. San Diego is the Birthplace of Triathlon! In 1974, the first Mission Bay Triathlon was as a run-bike-swim-run event on Fiesta Island by the San Diego Track Club. Every year competitors from around the country and from around the world, come to Mission Bay to celebrate the birthplace triathlon.  We invite you to become part of this wonderful legacy event and become part of history!

The event offers races for adults and kids,  from complete beginners to seasoned Professionals. There are many different races going on simultaneously, and while a traditional Triathlon is Swim / Bike / Run, KOZ Events, the organizer of the San Diego Triathlon Series,  offers more of a Multisport Race. Our race is very inclusive and we make triathlon accessible to as many people as possible. We have the traditional Swim/bike/ Run Triathlon but we offer so much more. If you do not like swimming, we have the Duathlon which is a Run/ Bike/ Run, if you don’t want to bike then choose the Aquathlon Swim / Run, or if you don’t want to run choose the Aquabike  Swim/Bike. We even have a Mini Distance Triathlon for beginners that want to try out the sport. We even offer free training groups every week to help people get started, train, and get connected to the San Diego Triathlon Community.

name: 310K Run/walk powered by Leslie Cohen Law
description:
2025 Results at this link

https://www.racefoxresults.com/leslie-cohen-law-5k 

Leslie Cohen Law PC is once again proud to be hosting the 310K Run/Walk, a 5K event that raises funds for the Public Counsel Debtor Assistance Project. Now in its 15th year, the 310K is a community-driven race that takes place right on the beach in Santa Monica, drawing many returning runners and walkers year after year. The event welcomes participants of all paces—whether you're running to set a new personal record or walking with friends to support a great cause. With in-person and virtual options, the 310K offers a meaningful way to give back while enjoying one of the most scenic race routes in beautiful LA.

 

For the 2nd year in a row, we return to the California Incline!

This year, the 310K will take place on Sunday, November 22nd—a great way to kick off Thanksgiving week with purpose and community spirit.

Our new location last year got such rave reviews that we need to make it a tradition. We will once again start at the iconic Santa Monica Pier and run down and then back up the California Incline.

Our Beneficiary

Proceeds from the 310K support the Public Counsel Debtor Assistance Project (DAP), which provides free bankruptcy-related legal services to individuals and families across Greater Los Angeles. Through clinics, educational workshops, and one-on-one legal representation, DAP helps clients understand their rights, navigate the legal system, and find paths toward financial stability. DAP is part of Public Counsel, the largest pro bono legal aid organization in the United States. Leslie Cohen Law PC received the James King Community Service Award from Public Counsel in 2016 in recognition of the impact of the 310K.

name: 33rd Annual Brea 8K Classic presented by Brea Mall  - Race Starts at 7am!
description:
Join the Excitement at the Brea 8K Classic!


What started with just 68 runners has grown into one of Southern California’s most beloved community races—and this year, we’re going bigger than ever! Thousands of runners, walkers, volunteers, and supporters from across the country will come together for a day of fitness, fun, and purpose.

Why run with us?

A Scenic, USATF-Certified Course: Enjoy rolling hills and vibrant neighborhoods in beautiful Brea.
Unforgettable Energy: Live music, cheering crowds, and a post-race celebration featuring local food and drinks.
Make a Difference: Every step you take supports Brea Olinda High School’s award-winning music program—helping students access instruments, sheet music, and opportunities to perform and compete.


Your participation matters. This single event is the most impactful fundraiser for our city’s only comprehensive high school. By joining, you’re not just running—you’re investing in creativity, collaboration, and the cultural heartbeat of our community.

Ready to be part of something special?
Sign up today and experience the thrill of the Brea 8K Classic. Lace up, show up, and make an impact!

name: 3rd Annual Porterville 5K/10K Trail Run
description:
Description:

On 4/12/2025, the Porterville Military Academy athletic department is hosting a 5k/10k run/walk starting and finishing at Porterville Military Academy. Join us for a 5k or 10k dirt path course that is out and back. We are also hosting a children's 1/4 mile short course for your little ones to get in on the action. We look forward to seeing your whole family enjoy this community event.

All 5k race participants will receive for FREE:
  • Custom race t-shirt
  • Finisher Medal
  • Chip time and digital certificate
  • Race bib with individual number
  • Upbeat motivational music
  • Free Parking
All kids 1/4 mile participants will receive for FREE:
  • Custom race t-shirt
  • Finisher medal

Age Group Winners:

The top three males and the top three females in each age group will be rewarded with a prize after the race! The prize is still being worked on and will be posted here as soon as the artwork comes back. The age groups are...

  • 1-10
  • 11-19
  • 20-29
  • 30-39
  • 40-49
  • 50-59
  • 60-69
  • 70-79
  • 80+

Packet Pickup:

  • Place: Porterville Military Academy front office
  • 4/9/2025 from 4:00 PM - 7:00 PM
  • 4/11/2025 from 3:00 PM - 7:00 PM
  • If you are unable to make it to packet pickup, you can come on the morning of the event from 6:30 AM - 7:45 AM

Virtual Race - If you live locally, you are encouraged to come to packet pickup. Otherwise, the race medal will be mailed to you after the race.

We do not store any unclaimed race packets after the race. If you do not pick up your packet prior to the race, then it is considered forfeited. Leftover supplies are donated to volunteers and local charities.

Who we support:

  • The Experimental Aircraft Association (EAA), is an international organization with over 200,000 members. EAA chapters provide a community for pilots and aviation enthusiasts. The Porterville EAA Chapter 1547 has supported Porterville Military Academy Cadets in multiple facets by providing scholarships, overseeing more than 150 Porterville Military Academy Cadets flying an airplane, and mentoring our future aviators on the theories of flight.

name: 3rd Annual TRANS PRIDE 5K
description:
SIN CITY CLASSIC ATHLETES! 🏃🏼‍♀️🏃🏽🏃‍♂️‍➡️ 🏃🏽‍♀️‍➡️ Grab your spot early with our 🥳 EXCLUSIVE SIN CITY PROMO RATE! 🎰

WE WILL BE RUNNING THIS DISCOUNTED RATE FROM:  FRIDAY 01/16/26 to SUNDAY 01/18/26

 🏳️‍⚧️ !!Details below!! 🏳️‍⚧️

We’re back for our 3rd year!

 

Don’t miss this year’s 3rd Annual Trans Pride 5K/10K in Los Angeles - or join virtually from anywhere!

Our joy is revolutionary, so let’s come together for a day of movement, resource sharing, fundraising, and more! ALL allies and LGBTQ are welcome and wanted! Our community energy is powerful and uplifting and we need each other more than ever so sign up early and bring a friend! 

ALL are welcome and wanted!

☀️ Open to all ages and skill levels

☀️ LGBTQIA+ individuals and allies

☀️ Family-friendly

Not into the fun run part? That’s okay! There will also be a Trans Resource Exchange, Picnic, and Raffle to raise funds for our Finish Line Grant (learn more below)

WHEN: Sunday, July 26th, 2026 ☀️

WHERE: In person - Crystal Springs Picnic Area - Pettigrew Field Griffith Park - 4730 Crystal Springs Dr. 🌈

Don’t live in LA? Grab a few friends and register for the virtual run! Head outside and enjoy moving your body for a cause. Take pictures and post and be sure to tag @transpride5K to spread the word.

Finish Line Grant: We are seeking talented artists and athletes who inspire, create, and uplift our community. One individual will receive the Finish Line Grant to assist them in their endeavours directed towards making a lasting impact on our Trans community and beyond. 🌷 We will be accepting applicants in the spring so stay tuned and follow us on socials to keep in the loop @transpride5k. 🤩 

LOOKING FORWARD TO SEEING YOU THERE!

name: 41st Nature Made Great Race: Half Marathon, 5K, 10K, 15K, 10M, 1M
description:
The Nature Made Great Race is a celebration of running that features the incredibly scenic Chesebro Half Marathon mostly trail race, and on road: the Deena Kastor 5K, Old Agoura 10K, 15K Double Stack Challenge, Cronies 10.3 Mile Triple Stack Challenge and United Track 1 Mile run/walk.

Established in 1986, the Great Race has won many awards and accolades over the years including:

Best Half Marathon in Nation by Active.com
Voted #1 Running Event in L.A.
Selected a Top 10K in U.S. by Runner's World
Best Race Swag by Competitor Magazine
Best Post-Race Party by LA Sports & Fitness Magazine
Best Post-Race Party by Active.com
Best Post-Race Party by Runner's World
Best Brunch Run by Athlinks 

 

Runner Perks

  • Run on a beautiful, scenic and serene course
  • Custom-designed drawstring goodie bag with actual goodies
  • Premium technical running top (men's or women's cut, in short sleeve or long sleeve)
  • All finishers are rewarded with a beautiful, commemorative finisher’s medal
  • Two medals for finishers of the 10 Mile Triple Stack Challenge and 15K Double Stack Challenge
  • LA's #1 Post-Race Party with lots of quality free food, music and shopping
  • Live Results with RFID timing
  • Photographers on course
  • Plenty of aid stations
  • USATF certified and sanctioned courses
  • Well-marked routes
  • The Great Race Super Discount on Great Race apparel & gear (the earlier you register, the more offers you receive)
  • Sports & Fitness Expo
  • Free parking at the Expo
  • Free race day parking
  • Announcer greets you at beautiful Chumash Park at SoCal’s most active, fun finish line
  • Hundreds of Age Group Awards
  • Prizing: Audio/Video Equipment to Top Finishers in Select Races like TVs, Headphones, Music Players, etc.

Great Race runners comment year-after-year about the gorgeous scenery, the serenity and the most Most Beautiful Courses in Southern California!

So Much Fun!

name: 43rd Annual Providence Saint John's Health Center Brentwood Run
description:
🏃‍♀️ Join Us for the 43rd Annual Brentwood Run 🏃‍♂️

Be part of a beloved Brentwood tradition as the 43rd Annual Brentwood Run returns to San Vicente Blvd! This historic race features a flat and slight downhill course, making it a fast and enjoyable run or walk for participants of all levels. Beyond the race, enjoy a huge expo with local vendors and a dedicated kids area. Best of all, your participation benefits the Brentwood Library and supports the local community!

name: 46th Annual AMS 5K & Wellness Expo VI
description:
Locals know this as a popular and inclusive community event that offers a fun family environment focused on physical and spiritual Wellness. Participants walk, jog, run, and/or race. This event also includes a Stroller Competition and Costume Contest.  


For those racing, the fast and challenging 3.1-mile course includes certified timing and a large digital clock at the finish.


For EVERYONE, this event provides an opportunity for Wellness and to experience a fun-filled, all-inclusive activity & the American Martyrs community.

The race starts and finishes in downtown Ferndale, CA

name: 4th Annual Northeast Trail 5K (RUN/WALK)
description:
Join us in supporting the Northeast Division Youth Programs through the 4th Annual Northeast Trail Run 5K. These programs are dedicated to fostering strong ethics, values, and essential life skills in young individuals, guiding them toward becoming responsible and productive members of the community. Through structured activities, mentorship, and positive engagement with law enforcement officers, the programs provide meaningful opportunities that deter delinquent behavior and encourage personal growth. Your participation helps us continue creating a safe, supportive environment where youth can thrive.

The first 500 participants will receive a custom medal and event t-shirt. 

Race Day Schedule:

6:00 am to 8:00 am  Registration Open for New Registration and Packet Pick Up
8:30 am Start of 5K Run/Walk


Awards:

Top Male and Female top 3 runners

 

Rain or Shine.

name: 55th NorCal John Frank Memorial Run
description:
March 7, 2026

10-Mile USATF Pacific Association Road Grand Prix event.

Run a spring race along the beautiful Sacramento River Trail and across two iconic pedestrian bridges, the Diestelhorst Bridge and the Stress Ribbon Bridge, in Redding, CA.

Plus a 3-Mile Run/Walk and 1 Mile Run/Walk. Kids 14 and under run the 1 Mile for free.

Course Records:

$2900 in prize purse for 10-Mile, awarded to USATF Pacific Association members.
$2500 in course record prize purse for 10-Mile. $1000 for men/women open course records, $250 for men/women masters (40+ y/o) course records.

  • Women's Open: 55:23 (Sara Hall, 2016)
  • Men's Open: 48:38 (Brendan Gregg, 2022)
  • Women's Masters: 57:09 (Linda Smith, 2010)
  • Men's Masters: 50:47 (Sergio Reyes, 2022)

Packet pickup will be on Friday March 6, 2026, from 11am to 5pm, at Fleet Feet Redding, 1376 Hilltop Dr, Redding, CA 96003.
Race day registration opens at 7:30am at Lake Redding Park, 2225 Benton Dr, Redding, CA US 96003.

1 Mile starts at 8:30 AM.
10 Mile starts at 10:00 AM.
3 Mile starts at 10:05 AM.

name: 5inco De Miles
description:
5INCO DE MILES y Las Millas de Oro SD (cinco de mayo and the golden miles). 


5INCO DE MILES y Las Millas de Oro SD is a fun, festive race celebrating Cinco de Mayo in the beautiful Chula Vista Bayfront. Created to bring more running events—and more mile races—to the South Bay San Diego community, this event welcomes runners of all ages, speeds, and experience levels.

Set along scenic Bayside Park, the course is perfect for athletes chasing fast times and families looking to enjoy an active holiday together.

Race Options

  • 5K – Open to all runners and walkers
  • Open Mile 39 and under 
  • Masters Mile – For athletes 40+
  • Kids’ Mile – Ages 13 and under
  • Doggy Mile – A fun, untimed mile for participants running or walking with their pets

Giving Back 🐾
Doggy Mile proceeds benefit Kane’s K9s & Animal Rescue, a local nonprofit dedicated to helping abandoned and at-risk animals find loving homes.

Inspired by Mexican heritage and the Battle of Puebla, La Batalla de las Millas blends culture, competition, and community into a unique Cinco de Mayo running experience—because every mile deserves to be celebrated.

name: 5K for Fragile X
description:
Superheroes are back once again!! 

Join us on Saturday, April 18th, 2026 for the 13th Annual 5K Walk/Race for Fragile X and celebrate our Southern California Fragile X Community! Click Here for Event Details for Participants 

Why race for Fragile X syndrome? 

Fragile X syndrome (FXS) is the leading known cause of inherited intellectual disability and the leading single gene cause of Autism. Fraxsocal’s mission is to promote public awareness and with your help we can accomplish this goal! Also, to provide a forum for families and children with FXS to meet & greet and create a stronger FXS community! We also support research for effective treatments and ultimately a cure for FXS. Treatments for Fragile X are likely to help people affected by autism, Alzheimer’s, and other brain disorders.

Fragile X Community 

A Family Fun Day will proceed after the walk with Family, Friends, Food and Fun!! It's a great time to chat with other families affected by fragile X syndrome (FXS) and it's also a nice opportunity for you to take your kid(s) or adult(s) with FXS or any disability for that matter, judgement free! 

How to participate:
  • Participate in person: Sign up to walk, run, bike, scoot or stroll (it's a very family friendly walk/run) All you do is click the "Sign up" button above and register yourself and the whole family! Mark your calendar and be sure to arrive early so you can get your FREE t-shirt and goodies before we begin. 
  • Participate virtually: Sign up by clicking the "Sign up" button above and register yourself and the whole family! (Make sure you have someone there in person to pick up your t-shirts otherwise you will be donating them to our organization in which we say, "thank you"! ) 
  • Start a Fundraiser: Whether you are participating in person or virtually you can start an individual fundraiser (starting goal is $250) and attach it to a TEAM (Starting goal of $2,500) in the honor of your Fragile X Super Hero.
  • Become a Sponsor:  Whether you personally, your company or a company you know are interested we have multiple packages to choose from! 
  • Recognize a participant with a fun, inspirational sign to be placed along the 5K course!
 
Race Fundraising Goal: $75,000 Last year we raised over $55,000!!! Let's see if we can top that!! Donations can be made by clicking the Donate Tab.
 
Share!

Inform your network of supporters! Use these Social Media graphic template to help you tell others that you are racing and/or fundraising! Invite them to race or donate in your honor or in the honor of your Fragile X Superhero.

Map to find us

More about our organization: 
FRAGILE X ASSOCIATION of SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA (FRAXSOCAL)
Our non-profit organization was formed to promote public awareness of Fragile X Syndrome with special emphasis on educators and health professionals; provide a forum for families and children with Fragile X to meet and share their ideas, concerns and problems; and support scientific research on Fragile X Syndrome.

name: 5th Annual ProYouth Color Run
description:
DISCRIPTION 

ProYouth is hosting the 5th Annual color run. Come out and run in our 5k, or bring the whole family and run, jog, or dance your way through our 2 mile course. We will throw in the color and the fun! With registration you will receive a participation medal and a white shirt to get blasted with color. There will be color stations throughout the fun run and powder will be in the air so bring a head covering if you wish. After your race, enjoy a snack and a colorful dance party with our DJ. All proceeds will benefit the programs and students who are part of the ProYouth afterschool network. Parents if you do not want to run/walk, you can sign the kids up to do the run/walk and just watch and take photos! See our Facebook page for race updates.

 

RACE INFORMATION
We will be having two races. Both the 5k and color run will begin at 9:00 AM. The 5K race is for all those who wish to test themselves by competing in our 5k course and people who wish not to be colorized (I'm sure you will get some color, but it will be much less than others). There will be a trophy awarded to the top male and female runner. The race will be timed.  Photos will also be taken at the finish line and uploaded onto our page. Please be aware that our course will be on the road and in the grass. The color run is open to people of all ages who want to run, walk, jog, or dance your way through the course. Throughout the fun run you will be blasted with color at the color stations. Photos will be taken at the finish line and along the course. Photos will be posted on our page within 24-72 hours of the finish.

 

WHAT TO WEAR
We recommend that you wear white for catching the brilliant color and sunglasses for shielding your eyes. Also, you should wear a bandanna around your mouth and nose to keep from inhaling powder. We will supply a mask in case you want to use that.

 

ENTRY FEE
ALL ENTRY FEES ARE NON-REFUNDABLE. We are accepting entries online through runsignup.com. Be sure to sign up early as the price will go up as we get closer to race day.

 ***EVERYONE planning on running/walking The ProYouth Color Run MUST complete a registration form and sign the waiver!

 

GIVEAWAY/PRIZES
Every participant will receive a medal and a t-shirt plus a swag bag. Anyone who signs up after the cutoff date is not guaranteed a medal or shirt. Trophies will also be awarded for the top male and female in the competitive 5k run. 

 

AFTER THE RACE
We will provide you with a water and banana after the race. You will also be able to hang out at our post-race health fair and listen to Simon Ybarra’s Mobile Dj Service and Entertainment will be providing music during and after the race.

name: 71st Annual Fontana Days Run
description: The Fontana Days Run Half Marathon began back in 1955 with a reported 200 participants. Race founders were unaware that the annual Half Marathon would grow to include over 2,000 participants. The Fontana Days Run provides participants with a safe, festive, and well organized event. The Annual Fontana Days Run features a Half Marathon, 5K Run, 5K Family Fitness Walk, and a Children's Half Mile Dash. Finish Line festivities include local vendors, exhibitors, entertainment, and food.

name: 7th Annual Super Bulldog Jog 5K Run/Walk
description:
The Bulldog Jog is a 5K run/walk for all ages.  Course will begin and end inside the school, however the majority of the 5K will run through our surrounding community residential streets.  Located exclusively on the school’s campus, will also be the “Health Fair," which will include “FREE” pre- and post-run festivities (beginning at 7am) featuring a variety of entertainment, as well as health and fitness information.  This event will offer not only finisher medals, shirts, and timed bib at a low cost to those who register, but also fun activities for the whole family at the Health Fair.

-----------------------------------------------------

El Bulldog Jog es una carrera/caminata de 5 km para todas las edades. El recorrido comenzará y terminará dentro de la escuela; sin embargo, la mayor parte de la carrera se realizará por las calles residenciales de nuestra comunidad circundante. Ubicada exclusivamente en el campus de la escuela, también se realizará la "Feria de la Salud", que incluirá actividades gratuitas antes y después de la carrera (a partir de las 7:00 a. m.) con una variedad de entretenimiento, así como información sobre salud y ejercicio. Este evento no solo ofrecerá medallas, camisetas y dorsales cronometrados a bajo costo para quienes se inscriban, sino también actividades divertidas para toda la familia en la Feria de la Salud.

name: 9/11 Run to Remember
description:
The 9/11 Run to Remember 5k and 1m walk will be held on Saturday September 5th.

The 9/11 Run to Remember was established to honor and remember the 2,977 people lost in the horrific 9/11 terrorist attack. The run starts and finishes at the California 9/11 Memorial in Clovis, CA, a permanent monument which is the largest of its kind outside of New York City.

name: 9th Annual BRAVE Race 2026
description:
The BRAVE RACE is hosted by The Joyful Child Foundation - In Memory of Samantha Runnion (55-0794474).

The Joyful Child Foundation is dedicated to preventing crimes against children through programs that educate, empower, and unite families and communities.

Your participation benefits The Joyful Child's Be Brave-Be Safe Empowerment Programs.

You can choose to participate virtually or join us in person at Wolverine Stadium in Aliso Viejo, CA on Sunday, February 22, 2026

Participants can walk or run a 1K, 5K, 10K. Prize money to top 3 male and female in 5k and 10k.

name: A Snail's Pace x Adidas Sunset 5000
description:
Music, food and running! Celebrate a night under the lights with us by running 12 and a half laps! This event is open to all ability levels. We will have 8 heats of the 5K (3.1 miles), seeded based on your expected 5k time, with maximum cut off time at 35 minutes.

All participants will receive a post race meal ticket for our food truck partner, Birreria y Tacos Doña Betty. Finishers will also receive a commemorative race medal, and winners of each heat will get a special surprise.

Adidas will have spikes and super shoes for you to demo during the race so you can hit your fastest time! 

Heats will be chosen based on expected finish times, and will be announced closer to race day. Please estimate as close to your current fitness as possible. If you win your heat by 2 minutes or more, you will be ineligible for any prizes. BE HONEST WITH YOUR PROJECTED TIME!

Space is limited and will sell out. 

**Race director reserves the right to review and revoke winning times.

name: AAUW Madtown 5K
description: The race begins at 8 am Cedar Creek at 500 N Westberry in Madera, California. The runners will run north on Westberry and then turn left on Riverview until you come to an entrance to run along the cannel. You will turn around at the marked area and return to Cedar Creek where we will have breakfast and provide the runners with their times. Each runner will be provided with a T-shirt.

name: Abrazo 5K Walk & 10K Run 2026
description:
Abrazo 5K Walk & 10K Run

This year’s Abrazo 5K Walk and 10K Run embraces the theme “Get Up, Stand Up.” Inspired by Bob Marley’s words, “One love, one heart, let’s get together and feel all right,” we honor his legacy of using music to uplift voices, champion social justice, and spread messages of love, unity, and resilience.

Casa Familiar continues this spirit through our mission of Advancing Communities—even in the face of adversity—by celebrating the strength of our comunidad.

Join us to uplift community wins and support Casa’s youth and senior programs. As a participant, you’ll help us meet growing needs while celebrating together.

Expect lively Rasta vibes, energizing music, and two special awards presented after the race during a short closing program.

Event Details

The Abrazo 5K Walk & 10K Run takes participants along the scenic San Ysidro–Tijuana border. This year, we’re excited to bring back the Beer Garden — celebrate after the run with a refreshing drink! Beer access is included with your food and drink bracelet.

Welcoming more than 300 participants each year, this annual fundraising event is packed with community spirit, fun, and contagious energy.

Date

Saturday, May 2, 2026

Schedule

  • 6:30 AM: Registration 

  • 7:00 AM: Welcome 

  • 7:30 AM: 10K Run

  • 7:35 AM: 5K Walk 

  • 8:45 AM - 11 AM: Awards & Raffles

Join us to uplift community wins and support Casa’s youth and senior programs. As a participant, you’ll help us meet growing needs while celebrating together.

Expect lively Rasta vibes, energizing music, and two special awards presented after the race during a short closing program.

Event Details

The Abrazo 5K Walk & 10K Run takes participants along the scenic San Ysidro–Tijuana border. This year, we’re excited to bring back the Beer Garden — celebrate after the run with a refreshing drink! Beer access is included with your food and drink bracelet.

Welcoming more than 300 participants each year, this annual fundraising event is packed with community spirit, fun, and contagious energy.

Date

Saturday, May 2, 2026

Schedule

  • 6:30 AM: Registration 

  • 7:00 AM: Welcome 

  • 7:30 AM: 10K Run

  • 7:35 AM: 5K Walk 

  • 8:45 AM - 11 AM: Awards & Raffles

name: Akash Wine Run 5k
description:
THIS EVENT IS NOW SOLD OUT!  IF YOU WOULD LIKE TO JOIN THE WAIT LIST, PLEASE REGISTER HERE TO GRAB A SPOT AND YOU WILL BE EMAILED AUTOMATICALLY IF A SPOT OPENS UP.   WAIT LIST ENTRIES WILL BE OFFERED ON A FIRST COME FIRST SERVE BASIS IF ADDITIONAL SPOTS OPEN. 
Any waitlist participants who do not receive a spot for 2026 will receive a coupon code to receive a discounted registration for 2027!

Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Sunday, March 1, 2026 for an exciting annual event that features Akash Winery & Vineyards. We have 2 waves starting at 9am and 11am but both will sell out fast so sign up soon!  Come join us on the gorgeous, open-air patio, where you’ll find far more than beautiful views and amazing wine. This winery is loved by locals and out-of-towners alike, thanks to the happy energy and friendly faces of our knowledgeable team.  So, whether you are looking to run, walk or just enjoy the wine and camaraderie this race is a sure thing for a great time and an incredible experience! This race is timed and scored by J3 Timing.  Results will be posted at www.J3Timing.com. 

Registration Includes:

  • T-shirt:  Super Soft Ring Spun Cotton t-shirt included! 
  • Wine Glass: Shatterproof, Collapsible, and Portable!
  • Finisher Medal: Doubles as a Wine Stopper!
  • Race Bib: Chip timed 5k run/walk
  • Results Posted Online
  • ...and of course, a pour of wine!

name: Alameda Island Running Festival
description:
We are back for another year of racing with our start and end at Faction Brewery. The race start and finish will be right outside, and the Health and Wellness expo presented by Alameda Health Systems will be inside the old hanger.
As with all of our events, a portion of our registrations will be donated to our Beneficiary Alameda Education Foundation. you can read more about them from our direct links below:
  • Alameda Education Foundation: https://alamedaeducationfoundation.org/
 
Race Weekend Packet Pick Up:
  • Thursday and Friday September 17th and 18th : Lauren's Closet 1420 Park St, Alameda, Ca. 94501
    • 10:00am - 6:00pm * we encourage you to get your BIB and shirt early and sleep in race morning! 
  • Saturday 1:00pm - 5:00pm Race Start/Finish Expo 2501 Monarch St, Alameda Point - Faction Brewery
  • Sunday: 6:30am - 8:15am Race Start/Finish Expo 2501 Monarch St. Alameda Point - Faction Brewery
 
Race Events and Schedule: 
  • Saturday: 
    • Hella Bae Running 5k and 1 Mile Shake-out run presented by Skechers : 1:00pm
    • Yoga in the Hanger presented by Breathing Room Studio
  • Sunday 
    • Half Marathon: 7:30am
    • 10K: 8:00am 
    • 5k Presented by Penumbra: 8:15am
    • Family Fun Run: 10:00am
 
Race Timing and Restrictions:

the Island Running Festival is a chip-timed event.  Participants can run, jog or walk the entire course. 
Jogging strollers are permitted but are asked to start in the back of the pack.  Wheelchair athletes are permitted but due to safety concerns and street closure restrictions cannot travel faster than the fastest runner.   No bikes, scooters, skateboards or other wheeled vehicles are allowed. Dogs are not allowed on our race courses.  We love dogs, but there are those who are not so comfortable around them and there are also dogs that are uncomfortable around hundreds of other people, therefore NO DOGS ALLOWED on the course or at the finish line.

We will provide bike parking for those of you that prefer to bike to the event. See the race website for more details. 

 

Medical and Water Stops:

We will have a dedicated paramedics team on site and available to help assess your race day medical needs and administer acute first aid when necessary. A medical station will be located near the finish line and team members will be roaming the course. 
Water Stops: see maps page for more info
  • Half: Mile 2, 5.5 & 11
  • 10k: Mile 2, 5.5
  • 5k: Mile  2 & 2.5 
 
Volunteers:
We can always use volunteers and it takes the support or our community and friends to make these events successful. if you are interested in learning more visit our website and volunteer support page or reach out to info@outfrontendurance.com

name: Alameda July 4th Parade R.A.C.E.
description:
Come out for our July 4th tradition and run this flat and fast point to point 5k thru the closed streets of Alameda. We will be starting again at 8:30am to provide ample space between our runners and the Parade that follows. 

General Overview: 

The 5K run (3.1 mile) and walk takes you through beautiful Alameda winding thru business and residential streets. This run benefits the Midway Shelter of Alameda. 

Packet Pick-up:

  • 7/1 thru 7/3: Laurens Closet. 1420 Park St, Alameda. Hours 10:00am - 5:00pm  
  • 7/4 Race morning registration opens at 7:30am 1440 Park St, Alameda ~ La Pena corner of Santa Clara (New Location)

Race Day Details: 

  • Start: 1420 Park St. Alameda, ca. 94501
  • Packet Pick-up : 7:30am
  • Race Start : 8:30am
  • Finish: 1526 Webster St, Alameda, CA 94501 (across from Tapout Fitness)

We will have shuttle service in 2026 to get runners back to the start. We have made strides towards this for a couple years and we finally have it lined up for this year. 

 

If you are traveling via Bart or public transportation please review the schedules below to get you to the race start, and picked up from the race finish. 

  • Bart Website: https://www.bart.gov/
  • AC Transit Site: https://www.actransit.org/

name: Albany Move'n'Groove 2026
description:
Run, walk, or stroll a 5K in a flat loop course circling Albany CA's Memorial Park and Albany High School while listening to live music from multiple bands in the fifth annual Move'n'Groove on Sunday May 31, 2026!

The action kicks off with the kids-only 0.5 mile race for kids 10 years old and under in a mass start at 9:45am. The 5K starts in waves after the kids race, with the first wave (fastest runners) starting at 10:15am.

This musical festival and fitness event will feature bands representing an eclectic array of diverse musical genres positioned around the course during the races playing till Noon. On-site food vendors may be present — stay tuned for news!

Registration is only required for those competing in the 5K or kids race. There is no fee required to attend the event to watch the bands, enjoy the live music, or rec skate on the streets after the race! This fun community event is funded in part through the City of Albany's unique Sugar-Sweetened Beverage Tax. Fiscal sponsorship is provided by the Albany Community Foundation.

Key Dates & Prices

  • Kids race: $5 thru Apr 30, then $10
  • 5K Early Bird 🐤: Feb 1–28 = $10
  • 5K Regular Bird:  Mar 1 – Apr 30 = $15
  • 5K Late Bird 🐦: May 1 – May 28 = $20

Thursday 28 May 2026 is the last day for online registration. A limited number of slots may be available for sign ups at our packet pickup.

Packet pickup will be on the Saturday before the event at Road Runner Sports in Berkeley, Noon-3pm.

T-Shirts will be available for purchase separately through April 30 for an additional $15. Indicate your T-shirt preference during online registration. A limited number of shirts may be available for purchase at the event and/or packet pickup.

Summary of features for 2026:

  • Event takes place at the end of May instead of late April (less chance of 🌧️).
  • Three (or four) live bands playing around the race course till Noon.
  • Event ends at Noon — no afternoon band.
  • T-shirt available for purchase separately through April 30.
  • Races will start on Portland Ave at Pomona, instead of on Thousand Oaks Blvd as in past years.
  • Food vendors (pending)
  • Pre-event training sessions by IBX Fitness (details pending)

Event Schedule

Kids 10 and under go first at 9:45AM and complete one loop around the block (0.5 mi) instead of 6 loops for the 5K. All kids will line up on the street at the starting line for a mass start without waves. Faster/older kids should line up near the front of the pack.

After the kids race, the 5K runners/walkers/strollers/para athletes will line up starting at 10:00AM into corrals corresponding to their starting wave based on expected pace as entered in the registration form, and also indicated on their bib. The first (fastest) wave starts at 10:15AM with subsequent waves leaving every 2 minutes thereafter. The 5K consists of 6 complete loops of the course — participants are responsible for keeping track of their own lap count!

There will not be a separate roller/inline skating division for the 5K, but attendees are welcome to skate or scooter recreationally on the streets & sidewalks to enjoy the bands after most of the 5K participants have finished (starting around 10:45am) and until the bands stop playing (Noon). The streets & sidewalks are smooth, so you can 🛼 or scooter to the music after the 5K! Be mindful of pedestrians, and no electric scooters – human powered only!

About the course

The 5K course is fast and nearly flat and will be closed to traffic and free of parked cars during the event. Here's a course map and a Strava segment for the course which includes an elevation profile. Participants are responsible for keeping track of their own lap count (6 total). Course distance is not USATF certified, but the distance is quite close to a true 5K based on GPS (a little longer, 5.25K). Chip timing will ensure accurate results for all participants. Pavement is free of potholes and generally in great shape. Note that roads are slightly cambered (sloping down near the sides), which can cause knee/ankle pain. Running or walking in the center of the street will alleviate that problem.

Event Website

See the main website for additional event details and FAQ: MOVEnGROOVE.org

The 5K consists of 6 complete loops of the course — participants are responsible for keeping track of their own lap count!

There will not be a separate roller/inline skating division for the 5K, but attendees are welcome to skate or scooter recreationally on the streets & sidewalks to enjoy the bands after most of the 5K participants have finished (starting around 10:45am) and until the bands stop playing (Noon). The streets & sidewalks are smooth, so you can 🛼 or scooter to the music after the 5K! Be mindful of pedestrians, and no electric scooters – human powered only!

About the course

The 5K course is fast and nearly flat and will be closed to traffic and free of parked cars during the event. Here's a course map and a Strava segment for the course which includes an elevation profile. Participants are responsible for keeping track of their own lap count (6 total). Course distance is not USATF certified, but the distance is quite close to a true 5K based on GPS (a little longer, 5.25K). Chip timing will ensure accurate results for all participants. Pavement is free of potholes and generally in great shape. Note that roads are slightly cambered (sloping down near the sides), which can cause knee/ankle pain. Running or walking in the center of the street will alleviate that problem.

Event Website

See the main website for additional event details and FAQ: MOVEnGROOVE.org

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA

Event Schedule

6:20am – Bib pick-up opens

name: Almond Blossom Run 2026
description:
Welcome to the 2026 Almond Blossom Run!!


Durham Sports Boosters is excited to announce that the 44th annual Almond Blossom Run will be held Sunday, February 22, 2026!

Please join us in Durham for a beautiful Sunday morning run around the almond orchards with the trees in full bloom to see how special this race really is! As in past years, this event will include a 5K and 10K run with chip timing provided by Under the Sun Events. 

For our 2026 race, you have three options to enjoy our event:

  • A live, in-person event with waves every 5 minutes based on your registration level
  • A virtual event on our official course at your convenience-if you would like to enter the results for your run, please do so the morning of the Feb. 22nd by 9AM
  • A virtual, make-your-own course-if you would like to enter the results for your run, please do so the morning of the Feb. 22nd by 9AM


In-person participants (with data submitted via RunJoy, etc.) are eligible for top male and female finisher awards. Winners in both the 5K and 10K events will receive a gift certificate for a pair of running shoes from Fleet Feet in Chico. Medals will be awarded to the top finishers for each age division as well. Register here now!

Participants in the virtual event will receive instructions on how to submit virtual times, but will not be eligible for prizes.

Registration for in-person and virtual race is just $45 (with $1.85 convenience fee). Participants may choose from a long-sleeved, technical or short-sleeved, poly-cotton blend shirt upon registration, but be sure to register early-limited sizes and styles have been pre-ordered, so be sure to register early. Please note: For those participating in the virtual make-your-own course race, there will be a $10 shipping fee for those wanting a shirt.  

Sponsors are a critical partner in this event and allow us to continue our financial support of our athletic programs in Durham. Proceeds from the 2026 run will benefit student athletic teams at both Durham Intermediate School and Durham High School. Durham Sports Boosters is currently seeking funds to update the scoreboard and PA systems and the DHS Coliseum, upgrade equipment for boys and girls teams at both DHS and DIS, and implement improvements to the high school gym trophy cases. Thanks to our racers and generous sponsors, over $35,000 was spent in 2025 on our many athletic programs. We were able to purchase updated uniforms for DHS Cheer, Volleyball, Ski/Snowboard, and DIS basketball, equipment for Softball, Golf, Track and Field, and the Swim Team. Durham Sports Boosters also collaborated with Durham Park & Recreation to update the pool cover, and with the Durham Gala and Durham Volunteer Firefighters to purchase two new scoreboards for the DHS Gym. We have been busy, and it is because of supporters like you! Please click the donation tab here to see how you can support our athletes. 

You can become a part of our 2026 sponsorship team for this great event through this registration portal for as low as $100. In addition to knowing you have supported a great cause for our athletes, you will also receive wonderful advertising for your company. The race is on!

name: Almond Bowl 5K & 10K November 1st, 2026
description:
Join us, in person, on November 1st, 2026 for the 52nd Annual Almond Bowl in the beautiful Lower Bidwell Park!

Keeping with the Chico tradition we will be hosting a 5k and 10k race starting on South Park Drive and finishing near the Sycamore Field. The price of this race includes your race shirt from Upper Park Clothing, a race bib for you to wear during your run and plenty of post-race snacks for after your run!

10k: 8:10am

Dec 11th - March 31st - (online)              10k $50.00

                                                                        5k $40.00

April. 1st - August. 31st - (online)           10k $55.00

                                                                        5k $45.00

September 1st - Oct. 30th                        10k $60.00

(online @ 9am)                                             5k $50.00

In person Registration at Packet Pickup 
 
                                                                      10k $60.00

                                                                        5k $50.00
 

In person registration will be available at Fleet Feet Chico during packet pickup ONLY. (October 30th and 31st, 2026) Packet pickup will be from 10:00am - 2:00pm Friday and 9:00am - 2:00pm on Saturday. 

 
Registration Information
Online registration closes October 30th at 9:00 a.m. Registration will be available in person on October 30th and 31st at Fleet Feet Chico from 10am-2pm on Friday and 9am-2pm on Saturday. You need to Register by Friday October 9th to guarantee yourself race shirt. If you register between October 9th - November 1st your shirt will NOT be guaranteed. Limited number of extra shirts will be available first come first serve at packet pickup. All left over shirts/unclaimed shirts will be available for pickup or for sale (non-registered runners) AFTER the race on November 1st. Shirts will be first come first serve starting at 9:00am.  

OFFICAL COURSE CERTIFICATION AND MAPS

5K and 10K: Flat, fast loop through beautiful (newly paved!) lower Bidwell Park. 

Click here for both course maps.

 

DIRECTIONS AND PARKING FOR OPTIONAL RACE LOCATION

To the course:
Enter Chico via Highway 99 either from the north or from the south. If you are coming from the north on 99, take the Highway 32 offramp and turn right at the first intersection. If you are coming from the south on 99, take the Highway 32 offramp and turn left at the second intersection. Now you're heading west on 32 (East 8th St). From here. If coming from north 99 take the highway 32 exit and turn right onto 8th St. 

Take 8th St just under a half-mile, then turn right on Sycamore St.
Sycamore St runs a few blocks into Woodland Ave, which runs parallel to the park. The park itself will be closed to vehicle traffic on race day, so find a parking spot on or near Woodland Ave. Please be courteous and park legally. Do not park in a way that blocks local residents' entry to or exit from their homes.
There are several entrances to the One Mile Recreation Area from Woodland Ave. For race-day packet pickup, look for the sign marked pre-Registered. For any other assistance, make your way to the Information booth.


 

PACKET PICKUP

Packet pickup will be held at Fleet Feet Chico on the following days and times:

Friday and Saturday October 30th and 31st, 2026

10:00am-2:00pm (Friday)

9:00am-2:00pm (Saturday)

Fleet Feet - Chico
241 Main Street
Chico, CA 95928
(530) 345-1000

 
Race Rules:
Be courteous when overtaking slower runners or walkers in your elected race location. We want you to race hard and fast, but with safety of yourself and others in mind.

Where your Race number so it is visible on the participant's front!

Run your race with pride!

You must cross the timing mat for your chip to be read. If you are planning of racing for top finisher, the race is based on gun time and first to cross the finish line.

All other placements (age groups) will be based on chip timing.


Run, hard, run fast and have fun!


No pets will be allowed on course during the race.


All strollers must start at the back of the pack.


Thank you for understanding. 
 

AID STATIONS AND RESTROOMS
There will be 3 for the 10k and 2 for the 5k.

1.     Cedar Grove Bathrooms – Water 
2.     Peterson Drive Gate – Water 
3.     99 Overpass (Vallombrosa side) – Water
Restroom on the course will be located at One Mile recreation on the North and South side of the pool, Cedar Grove Park, and Pettersen Dr. Park entrance as well as portable restrooms at the start and finish.
 
 

T-SHIRTS AND AWARDS
Guaranteed Tee-shirt cutoff is October 9th, 2026

Cotton Poly blend shirts from Upper Park Clothing Co. will be provided to all participants who register for this event before the tee shirt cutoff. (10/9/26) Any participant who registers on or before October 9th will be guaranteed a race tee. Any participant who registers after October 10th will be able to receive a race shirt based on a limited size availability (very few extras will be ordered). Any shirts not picked up at packet pick up prior to the race will be available on a first come first serve basis to all paid runners for pick up, and available for sale to any unregistered spectators starting at 9:00am at the Fleet Feet booth. 
All shirts come in adult male (unisex) sizes, so you may wish to choose a smaller size than normal for female and child runners. No youth sizes will be available. 
 

AWARDS FOR TOP FINISHERS
 
We will be offering a CASH PRIZE Top male and female for each race! (5k & 10k) We will have an award ceremony at 8:30am for the 5k, 9:00am for the 10k.
 
Age group awards can be found at the Fleet Feet tent following the award ceremony for each race. 
(Awards will also be offered to the top three in each age group category for each gender in each race)
 
All unclaimed prized will be available for pick up at Fleet Feet Chico on Tuesday 3rd during regular business hours. (10:00am-5:00pm)

14 and under / 15-19 / 20-29 / 30-39 / 40-49 / 50-59 / 60-69 / 70 and over

name: Aloha Run Long Beach
description:
More Than Just a Race—It’s an Experience
 
The Aloha Run was created for runners, joggers, and walkers who want more than just a start line and a finish time. Our 5K and 10K races combine fitness with fun, offering a relaxed and supportive environment for participants of all ages.

From upbeat island music to smiling volunteers, every detail is designed to keep you motivated and smiling from start to finish. Whether you are looking for a San Diego 10K to test your pace or a 5K in Long Beach to enjoy with your family, you’ll find the perfect blend of competition and celebration here.

name: Always Hope Easter Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🐣 Get ready to lace up your sneakers and chase some fun!
Join us for the Always Hope Easter Run - a family-friendly, fun, and make memories that’ll last longer than chocolate eggs!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Alysia Montaño's Surprise Birthday 1 Mile Race
description:
🤫 SHHH! IT’S A SURPRISE! !DATE CHANGE! Alysia is going to the Boston Marathon so its now May 2nd!

You are invited to a birthday celebration unlike any other. To celebrate Alysia turning 40, we are taking over the historic Edwards Stadium at UC Berkeley for a one-mile track event!

Whether you’re looking to set a new Personal Best or just want a fun, nostalgic jog on a legendary track, this event is for you. We’re hosting a series of seeded heats so you’ll be running alongside people at your own pace.

The Details:

Distance: 1 Mile (4 laps of glory).
The Clock: We will have an official timer on-site to capture your results.
The Heats: Heats will be organized by your projected finish time. From elite speedsters to casual walkers, everyone has a place on the start line.
The Price: Entry is $19.86—a tribute to the year the guest of honor was born.
The Cap: Registration is strictly limited to the first 600 runners.
⚠️ THE GOLDEN RULE: > This is a SURPRISE PARTY. Please DO NOT post this link or any mention of this event on social media (Instagram, Facebook, X, etc.). We want Alysia to be completely shocked when she walks into the stadium. Only share this link via direct text or email with friends, family, and colleagues you know would love to join us.

name: Anaheim Turkey Trot 5K/10K  -Corner of Katella on the SANTA ANA RIVER TRAIL.  Across the street from Honda Center
description:
Anaheim Santa Ana River Trail Turkey Trot 5K/10K
Run up a Thanksgiving appetite at this year’s Anaheim Santa Ana River Trail Turkey Trot! Caren Ware Events brings you the ultimate race bling and the best holiday-themed motivation to stay healthy and active. Enjoy a scenic run along the paved Santa Ana River Trail and finish with a view of the iconic “Big A” of Angel Stadium.

Event Location:
Just north of Katella & S Douglas Road on the Santa Ana River Trail, between Angel Stadium and the Honda Center.
Closest Google address: 2610 E. Katella Ave, Anaheim, CA 92806 (former JT Schmid location).

 
What Each Participant Receives:
A collectible themed turkey shirt, beanie, or stuffed event turkey
A custom cast Turkey finisher medal or a choice of race beanie
Chip timing by ITZABOUTTIME with age division awards (3-deep per 5-year span)
A fresh slice of pumpkin pie with whipped cream at the finish
Fun, camaraderie, and holiday cheer
Enjoy music, a festive “along the fence” event expo, Thanksgiving decorations, and photo ops!

 
Race Day Schedule:
6:30 – 8:00 AM: Registration & walk-up packet pick-up
7:50 AM: Warm-up session
7:55 – 8:10 AM: Rolling start for 5K & 10K (must start by 8:10 AM)
8:11 AM: 1-Mile Fun Run start
9:00 AM: 5K Awards Ceremony (top overall & age divisions)
9:30 AM: 10K Awards Ceremony
All participants must wear the correct bib on the front for proper scoring.

 
Early Packet Pickup 

Pickup Details:

TBD

You may pick up packets for others; no ID required.

Race Day Pickup: 6:30 AM at registration booth near start/finish

 
Course Information:
Location: Santa Ana River Trail, Anaheim (paved, multi-use trail)
Enjoy views of Angel Stadium along the way
Shared path with cyclists, walkers, and dog walkers
Safety: Stay right, allow space for others, and follow public path rules
Pro tip: Write what you’re thankful for on your race bib!
 
Parking Information:
Designated Event Parking: Angel Stadium back lot (adjacent to Transit Center) – $10 race day cash pay to attendant or make payment  via zelle carenfasttrack@aol.com or venmo caren-Ware-1 have proof to show attendants. Or prepay when registering.
Enter via Douglas Way off Katella
Proof of parking payment required, (Please show attendant digital parking pass, run sign up payment receipt, Venmo payment, zelle payment  or pay cash)
Limited additional parking at Transit Center Lot B
 
Restrooms:
Public restrooms available at the Transit Center
Limited porta-potties at start/finish and near the 1-mile mark
 
Awards:
Age Division Awards: 1–7, 8–10, 11–14, 15–19, 20–24, 25–29, 30–34, 35–39, 40–44, 45–49, 50–54, 55–59, 60–64, 65–69, 70–74, 75–79, 80–84, 85+
Top overall male & female in 5K, 10K, and 1-Mile Fun Run
 
Additional Details:
Street tacos and tamales served at the finish line (vouchers available to be pre-purchase online)
Finisher medals handed out immediately at finish option of beanie (limited quantity)
Event takes place rain or shine
Thank you for supporting Caren Ware Events, spreading health and hope through our races. We look forward to seeing you there!

Questions? Email: carenfasttrack@aol.com
