Green Valley Lake, CA (Between Running Springs & Big Bear in the San Bernardino Mountains)

 
🕖 START TIMES
7:00 AM: Early Start Half Marathon (for those expecting to take 3.75+ hours)
7:30 AM: Standard Half Marathon Start
8:30 AM: Mass Start for 5K & 10K
 
🏞 COURSE HIGHLIGHTS
This is a breathtaking mountain race in the heart of the San Bernardino National Forest!

Start with a scenic ¾-mile out-and-back along the lake
Climb gradually up Green Valley Lake Rd and onto a forest service road
Enjoy a 400 ft elevation gain to an overlook at the 5K turnaround
10K and Half Marathon continue along rolling terrain on FS Road 2N13, through pine forests and rocky vistas
Course is part paved (1.5 miles), then transitions to dirt roads and trail
Water & aid stations every 1.5 miles
Get ready for that fresh air, mountain-made, above-the-clouds experience!

 
📍 LOCATION
Green Valley Lake – Just 40 minutes from Redlands, located off Hwy 18 between Lake Arrowhead and Big Bear.

Post-race activities take place in the Downtown Community Garden on Main Street.
Race HQ / Packet Pickup: Black Dog Social Club, 33231 Green Valley Lake Rd.

 
🥇 WHAT YOU GET
Custom, high-quality event t-shirt
Unique, huge finisher medal
Top 3 overall awards per race distance
Age group medals (3 deep in 5-year spans up to 80+)
Chip timing by Itz About Time
🏆 Age Groups:
10 & under, 11–14, 15–19, 20–24, 25–29, 30–34, 35–39, 40–44, 45–49, 50–54, 55–59, 60–64, 65–69, 70–74, 75–79, 80+
(Separate overall awards for each race distance.)

 
🏁 AWARDS CEREMONY – COMMUNITY GARDEN
9:15 AM – 5K Awards
9:30 AM – 10K Awards
9:45 AM – Half Marathon Awards
 
🧁 FOOD & FUN
Coffee ,pastries , street tacos, and more available for purchase packet pickup and race morning
Food available for purchase post-race
Live music at the Community Garden post-race
Hang out in a welcoming mountain community with big hometown vibes
 
🎽 PACKET PICKUP
Friday, July 31 3:00 PM – 6:30PM @ Black Dog Social Club
Saturday (Race Day): 6:30 AM – 8:30 AM @ Race Site
 
🏕 STAY THE WEEKEND
Make it a full mountain getaway!

Airbnbs in Green Valley Lake
Green Valley Lake Campground (0.5 miles from race) 
Giant Oaks Lodge, Running Springs (5 miles)
Rentals available at: green-valley-lake.com
 
🌅 FRIDAY NIGHT SUNSET RUN (Optional Add-On)
Friday, August 1 at 7:00 PM – Sunset Trail 5K
A fun, scenic, single-track 3.1-mile warm-up trail run.
💌 Email: carenfasttrack@aol.com to sign up.

 
🚴‍♀️ WANT TO RENT MOUNTAIN OR E-BIKES?
Visit Mountain Life Supply Co.
32855 Hilltop Blvd, Running Springs (past Valero Gas Station on right)

 
🌲 GIVING BACK
Proceeds benefit The Children’s Forest via the Southern California Mountains Foundation, empowering youth to become leaders in environmental stewardship.

Your support helps:

Train young Forest Rangers, Firefighters & Scientists
Maintain trails like The Exploration Trail
Support the Camacho family in memory of their daughter
We also proudly support:

The Green Valley Lake Community Garden (host of our awards)
The Local Museum, providing water support on the course
🙏 Donations welcome – Hit the "DONATE" button at registration!

 
FINAL NOTES
This is a scenic mountain course – come for the run, stay for the views!
A perfect escape from the summer heat and city smog
Come experience the camaraderie and community like no other!

name: Grievances & Gratitude Run – Not a Resolution - Just a Reset 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
Grievances & Gratitude Run


Release. Move. Begin Again.

Skip the resolutions. Start the year with intention, movement, and joy.

Grievances & Gratitude is a feel-good New Year run designed to help you exhale, reset, and step into 2026 lighter—surrounded by community, movement, and positive energy. This is about letting go of what no longer serves you and making space for gratitude, clarity, and forward momentum.

You can write down everything you’re ready to release… or just one thing. You can take part in the experience—or simply show up and run. However you choose to participate, this event meets you exactly where you are.

Every participant receives a finisher medal, and the option to take part in our signature Let Go & Affirmation Experience—because new beginnings don’t have to be loud or rigid. Sometimes they just need movement and space to breathe.

 
How It Works
Let Go Before You Go
Before the run, write down anything you’re ready to release—grievances, frustrations, stress, or heavy thoughts. Place them into our “goodbye” containers and symbolically leave that energy behind.

Run Free
Head out on a scenic course and move your body with intention. Run or walk at your own pace, clear your mind, and let each step carry you forward.

Affirmations Await
After crossing the finish line, visit our New Year Mantra Board and select a positive affirmation to guide you into the year ahead. Leave with gratitude, purpose, and renewed energy.

This isn’t just a race—it’s a moment. A reset. A fresh start grounded in movement and community.

 
Why CaliFlow Runs?
CaliFlow Runs creates inclusive, high-energy, community-driven events that celebrate you. Our races are accessible, joyful, and thoughtfully designed to support physical and emotional well-being—without pressure, pretension, or upsells.

✨ Professionally chip-timed
✨ USATF-certified courses
✨ Free race-day photos
✨ No forced shirts. No gimmicks. Just good vibes.

 
Who Can Participate?
Everyone is welcome.
Runners • Walkers • Strollers • First-timers • Seasoned athletes
This event is for anyone ready to move into the new year with intention.

 
Course Information
Our courses are open, meaning you’ll share the path with other runners, walkers, and beachgoers. Please stay on the pedestrian side of the beach path at all times.

✔️ Clearly marked course
✔️ 3 on-course water stations
✔️ Restrooms available along the route
✔️ Friendly staff and volunteers throughout

 
Bib Pick-Up & Start Times
Bib Pick-Up: 6:15 AM
📍 Race Ready Athletics Tent

Start Times:
• Half Marathon: 7:00 AM
• 5K & 10K: 7:30 AM

 
Start Location
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd
Long Beach, CA 90803

 
Parking Information
• Free street parking available
• Metered parking: $2.00 per hour

 
Awards
🏅 Top 3 men and women in each distance receive awards
🎤 Podium ceremony at 9:00 AM

 
Start 2026 grounded, grateful, and moving forward—together.
Come for the run. Stay for the release. Leave lighter.

name: Griffith Park Trail Marathon Relay & 8K
description:
Join us for the Griffith Park Trail Marathon Relay & 8K, an unforgettable race experience celebrated as one of Runner’s World magazine’s 10 Best Races You’ve Never Heard Of in 2024! This iconic event is the perfect opportunity to push yourself, bond with friends, and take in the breathtaking beauty of Griffith Park. With a combination of scenic trails and challenging terrain, you’ll be in for the ride of your life. Whether you’re a seasoned runner or just starting out, join us for a solo run or bring a team for a relay. And with fully-stocked aid stations and an energetic volunteer crew, you’ll have everything you need to crush it. So come on, grab your running shoes, and let’s make this a moment to remember! Register now for a day of adventure, camaraderie, and lasting memories.
One of the largest urban parks in the country, Griffith Park is a 4,300-plus acre slice of runner heaven. The grounds include famous sites like the Abandoned Los Angeles Zoo, the Observatory, and the Hollywood Sign. There’s more than 30 trails totaling around 50 miles for runners and hikers. Join us for the Griffith Park Trail Relay Marathon and get a taste of what the second largest city park has to offer.
  • All participants will receive a premium short sleeve women's or men's cut t-shirt. (Guaranteed shirt size if you register by May 17!)
  • Relay run is chip timed for fast & accurate results.
  • $1500 in Cash prizes for the Open division
  • Trophy/Plaque for the top 3 teams in each recreational division
  • Finisher’s medal for all participants
  • Limited Edition Badges (Relay Only)
  • 3 well supported aid stations with medical staff (2 on course, 1 at start/finish)
  • Food and refreshments at the start/finish area.
  • Music from multiple live DJs
  • Multiple Food Trucks
  • Access to the exclusive GPTMR packet pickup sale and raffle at Fleet Feet Burbank

name: Half-Marathon Training for Fun & Fitness
description:
-Registration opens on June 1st and will remain open until August 1st.

-Orientation night will be July 10 @6pm at the Trkac Store, just past Target, in Grass Valley CA.

-Runners will be provided with a 12-week guided training plan designed to help the runner gain confidence and fitness to tackle a half marathon.

-Beginning on July 19th, every Sunday morning will be dedicated to the long run. We will meet at different trailheads to discover scenic routes, have fun, build confidence on the trails, and connect with a community of fellow runners. Refreshments will be provided following the run each Sunday. 

-Learning more about running and techniques on how to best achieve your running goals.

-Ideally, runners interested in training should be able to comfortably run a 5K and log at least 6 miles a week to begin their half-marathon quest.

-If runners are new to the trails or simply want to increase their distance, this training is perfect in preparation for their first or 6th half-marathon race and beyond!

-All participants are encouraged to utilize the Sierra TrailBlazers weekly runs to supplement their training with group support.

-Each runner will be given a training plan to follow and adapt to their lives and needs as they train to race and enjoy the Champion Mine Trail Race or any half-marathon during the fall of 2025.

- Train-for-fun code can be used if you and your running buddy sign up at the same time for the Half Marathon training, save $10 for both!

name: Harvest Hustle – 5K, 10K, Half Marathon
description:
It's the Harvest Hustle, let's boogie! Welcome to our beautiful course at Hansen Dam Recreational Area!

Details

Start Location: Hansen Dam Recreation Area Ranger Station, 11770 Foothill Blvd., Lake View Terrace, CA
Parking: There are multiple free parking lots near the start

Event Schedule

6:30am – Bib pick-up opens at the start
7:00am – Half marathon start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Course

5k & 10k – this 5k route is used for the 5k (done once), 10k (done twice)
Half Marathon – this 4.4-mile route is used for the half marathon (done 3 times)

More About the Course: This is an out and back course. Our courses are not closed, which means that there are often runners, walkers, and others enjoying the day along with you.

On-course support: Courses are well marked with two water stations along the way.

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Email us at events@hightideruns.com

name: Have a Heart for Kids 5K Run/Walk
description:
The Have a Heart for Kids 5K Run/Walk is a fundraiser for the Yuba City Education Foundation.  The proceeds benefit students and their families within the YCUSD community. 

Start and Finish will be on the River Valley High School track with an 8:45am warm-up and announcements and a 9:00am start.  Breakfast will be served at 9:30am and awards at 10:00am.

Registrations are open until the day of the run, however T-Shirts orders cut off on Sunday, February 15, 2026.

name: HDR Kick Off 5000
description: High Desert Runners Season Kick-Off Race 5K. Run the beautiful running path at Pelona Vista

name: HDR Miles Mania
description:
Here is a chance for runners of all ages to race the MILE -- FOR FREE!! 

  • This is a FREE EVENT!  There will be no race shirts, but there will be participation ribbons and age group 1-3 place ribbons. 
  • The races will be held by age and grade level beginning at 8 am and Noon!

The West Antelope Valley Education Foundation (WAVE) and the High Desert Runners are hosting these races on the track at Joe Walker Middle School as part of the Empowering Youth Festival.

name: Healing Hearts: Walk/Run/MOVE! for Suicide Prevention
description:
🏃‍♀️💜 A Movement for Healing, Community, and Hope 💜🏃

Join us on Saturday, May 17th, for Healing Hearts: Walk/Run/MOVE! for Suicide Prevention, a powerful day of movement, community, and collective care benefiting Crisis Support Services of Alameda County. Whether you walk, run, roll, or dance, every action you take supports life-saving suicide prevention services in our community.

FULL PROGRAM HERE

🌟 WHAT MAKES HEALING HEARTS SPECIAL?

This is more than just a race—it's a day of healing, joy, and connection for the whole family. After you hit the pavement for our walk/run, stick around for a wellness fair, movement classes, local vendors, delicious food, and a heart-centered program that uplifts the strength of our community.
______________________________
EVENT DETAILS 📅 Date: Saturday, May 17, 2025
📍 Location: Edoff Bandstand, Lake Merritt

🕘 Start Times:
8:30 AM: Registration & Check-in Opens
9:00 AM: Opening Ceremony with Baba Ruben Drum Performance
9:30 AM: 5K around Lake Merritt starts in 2 waves - Racers and Walkers
9:35 AM: Tai Chi and Qi Gong with Master Sheldon
10:05 AM: Trauma Informed Yoga with Marsha Rosenblatt
10:40 AM: Dance Party and Closing

🎟️ EXTRA FUN – RAFFLE, FOOD, & MERCH

🍽️ Fuel up with delicious eats from local vendors
🎟️ Win big in our raffle with fun prizes
👕 Grab a Healing Hearts T-shirt to wear your support proudly
_________________________________

💡 GO BEYOND THE FINISH LINE – FUND RAISE FOR A CAUSE! 💡

Your impact doesn’t stop at the finish line! Take your support to the next level by fundraising for Crisis Support Services of Alameda County.

🏆 Create your own fundraising page or join a team to rally your family, friends, and colleagues behind this life-saving cause. With just a few clicks, you can:
✅ Set a personal goal
✅ Customize your fundraising page
✅ Invite others to join you
✅ Help expand suicide prevention services in our community

🎉 PLUS, our top fundraisers will receive special prizes as a thank-you for their incredible support! Stay tuned for exciting rewards and friendly competition!

💜 Every dollar raised makes a difference!

name: Healthy Kids Running Series Spring 2026 - South Orange County, CA
description:
Who We Are: Healthy Kids Running Series is a five (5) week running program in the spring and fall for kids Pre-K through 8th grade. Each HKRS Series takes place once a week and offers age-appropriate running events including the 50 & 75 yard dashes, the 1/4 mile, the 1/2 mile and the 1 mile run. Kids will earn points for each race they complete based on their finish.

Pricing: The registration fee covers the entire five (5) weeks of the Series which includes race bibs for each week, a runner shirt, a finisher medal and any sponsor giveaways. Registration is non-refundable and non-transferable. Online Early Bird registration increases three weeks prior to the first race event. 

High School: We also welcome our high school runners! Our high school students will be running a 2 mile race. 

Challenger: This Series offers a Challenger Division which is an adaptive 75 yard race for children with disabilities and/or special needs. This allows for parents, siblings, and friends to be on the course with runners to provide support as well as bringing their own supportive devices such as crutches, braces, wheelchairs, etc. to be used by runners. 

Makeup Date Information: 5/24/2026

Single Day Racing: Single day race registration opens one hour prior to the start of each race. The registration fee covers one single race to be run on the day of registration. ALL single day registrations should be completed onsite at the race location. Single day racers will have the option to upgrade to the full series (see tab on the left side of the page for instructions). There is a strict no-refund and no-transfer policy.

Awards: All participants receive a medal on Week 5! Trophies will be awarded to the overall top finishers in each of the divisions listed below (broken out by boys and girls respectively): 

Pre-K 50 Yard Dash

Pre-K 75 Yard Dash  

Kindergarten & 1st Grade

2nd & 3rd Grade   

4th & 5th Grade  

6th to 8th Grade    

High School 

Challenger

Share your running photos with our community! Find us on Facebook @HealthyKidsRunning or Instagram @healthykidsrs! 

#GetUpandGo

Each HKRS Series takes place once a week and offers age-appropriate running events including the 50 & 75 yard dashes, the 1/4 mile, the 1/2 mile and the 1 mile run. Kids will earn points for each race they complete based on their finish.

Pricing: The registration fee covers the entire five (5) weeks of the Series which includes race bibs for each week, a runner shirt, a finisher medal and any sponsor giveaways. Registration is non-refundable and non-transferable. Online Early Bird registration increases three weeks prior to the first race event. 

High School: We also welcome our high school runners! Our high school students will be running a 2 mile race. 

Challenger: This Series offers a Challenger Division which is an adaptive 75 yard race for children with disabilities and/or special needs. This allows for parents, siblings, and friends to be on the course with runners to provide support as well as bringing their own supportive devices such as crutches, braces, wheelchairs, etc. to be used by runners. 

Makeup Date Information: 5/24/2026

Single Day Racing: Single day race registration opens one hour prior to the start of each race. The registration fee covers one single race to be run on the day of registration. ALL single day registrations should be completed onsite at the race location. Single day racers will have the option to upgrade to the full series (see tab on the left side of the page for instructions). There is a strict no-refund and no-transfer policy.

Awards: All participants receive a medal on Week 5! Trophies will be awarded to the overall top finishers in each of the divisions listed below (broken out by boys and girls respectively): 

Pre-K 50 Yard Dash

Pre-K 75 Yard Dash

name: Heart & Soles Run
description:
Hit the pavement on Saturday, April 25, 2026 in support of children's health and wellness at the 13th Annual Heart & Soles Run! All 5K/10K registrations include:
  • Short sleeve tech fabric race shirt
  • Bib with professional race timing
  • Fast and scenic course around Santa Clara University
  • Post-race refreshments
Founded in 2014, the Heart & Soles Run is a 5K/10K race that takes place in the spring of each year. The scenic course circles around the beautiful campus of Santa Clara University and along nearby tree-lined streets. After the race, watch your kids (2-7 years old) in the Kids Run, visit vendor booths, and enjoy the celebratory atmosphere in the finish area. 
Your registration supports local nonprofits that provide students with equitable access to exercise, nutrition, and well-being resources. In total, the event has raised nearly $1 million in support of children’s health and wellness. Event proceeds are donated to the following youth organizations:
  • Boys & Girls Clubs of Silicon Valley
  • Santa Clara County Office of Education
  • YMCA of Silicon Valley

name: Heart and Sole Valentine's Run 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
❤️ Heart & Sole 5K • 10K • Half Marathon

Saturday, February 6, 2027
Long Beach, California

Celebrate movement, community, and love for the run at the Heart & Sole Run, set along the stunning Long Beach coastline. This Valentine’s-themed event is about more than romance—it’s about loving your body, your miles, and the community that shows up beside you.

Whether you’re running solo, with friends, or alongside your favorite people, choose from a 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon on a flat, fast, and scenic coastal course with ocean views and nonstop good vibes.

🕕 Bib Pick-Up & Start Times
Bib Pick-Up:
6:00 AM – 8:00 AM
📍 Race Ready Athletics Tent

Same Day Registration Opens

6:00 AM Race Ready Athletics Tent

Start Times:

Half Marathon: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K: 8:00 AM


Start Location:
5000 E Ocean Blvd - Granda Beach/Rosies Dog Beach
Long Beach, CA 90803

 

🏁 What You Get
Professional chip timing
Heart & Sole–themed finisher medal for every participant
Free race-day photos
Live DJ & finish-line festival atmosphere
Overall & age-group awards
On-course water stations
Clearly marked course & experienced race staff
Stroller-friendly & walker-friendly event


This is a high-energy race experience designed to feel welcoming, fun, and well-run—whether it’s your first race or your fiftieth.

❤️ Finish With Heart
Heart & Sole is about starting your day with intention, finishing strong, and leaving with your heart full and your sole proud.

Join us and run with heart.

name: Heart of Cool Trail Run
description:
Are you looking for a fun run for a great cause? If so, HoC 5k, 10k and half marathon is just what you are looking for!  Proceeds from this race go directly back to youth of BOMUSD (Black Oak Mines Unified School District) to inspire their future success through agriculture, engineering and VAPA (Visual and Performing Arts).  In addition, a percentage of the funds will also be used to scholarship a child to attend Camp Taylor, a camp specifically designed for youth with heart disease. 

Register by September 30 to receive a HoC cotton t-shirt with registration.  All half marathon participants receive something new for 2025 (TBD).  Check out our Instagram or Facebook page for a photo of the design.

This is a family friendly event and we highly encourage you to bring the whole family!  We offer a family discount package for immediate family members for the 5k and 10k distance!  If you want to participate in the event without your child, take advantage of our $8 per child - child care for children ages 3 and up!  We will have a post race pancake breakfast. 

The Heart of Cool Trail Run traverses some of the best trails Cool, CA and the Sierra Foothills have to offer.  Run on the same trails as many of the famous local (and world renowned) events such as Western States 100 Mile, Way too Cool 50k, Rio Del Lago 100 Mile, and many more!

To reduce waste and the possibility of littering our trails, this will be a cup free event.  Be sure to bring a cup or water bottle that can be refilled at aid stations.

Packet and bib pick up will be on Race Day.

Registration will be available online until the start of each event!

We can always use volunteers for this event. If you are able to lend a hand during the race, or the day before, please click on the Volunteer tab.

name: Heartfelt Fun & Run
description:
Heartfelt Help Foundation is hosting our fourth annual virtual 5k!  Hike, bike, run, walk, swim or dance!  However you move, move with us and raise needed funds to help heart transplant recipients right here in Northern California pay for the costs associated with transplant that insurance doesn't cover.  This includes our lodging program, providing temporary recovery housing when their doctors require it, their insurance doesn't cover it, and they can't afford it, and our new program, Axel's Helping Hand to help heart transplant patients and their families in Northern California with costs that are non-medical, but patients and families are unable to pay due to loss of income related to their transplant.  This includes overdue rent, car payments, utilities and much more.  We believe that financial stability leads to family stability which ultimately leads to the health of the patient and longevity of their new heart.

HHF ensures Equity and Access for heart transplant recipients despite their personal financial limitations providing what is necessary to facilitate recovery, and helps patients return them home as soon and as strong as possible.  

Join us today wherever you are and let's move to provide help and hope for financially disadvantaged heart transplant patients!

Heartfelt Help Foundation is a 501(c)3 nonprofit organization in good standing.  All donations over and above the event registration fee are fully tax deductible to the extent allowed by law.

Early Registration Bonus!  Register yourself and five friends by August 29th and receive a $20.00 refund!

name: Heroes 4 Hearing 5K
description:
Avoid lines on race day:

Pick Up Your Bib and shirt on Saturday August 16th at Sports Basement from 11am to 1pm.

Place

Shoreline Aquatic Park
200 Aquarium Way, Long Beach, CA 90802



HearAid Foundation presents our 4th Annual Heroes for Hearing 5K Fundraiser.

Be inspired by heroes overcoming their hearing loss. Run with heroes who bring the gift of hearing. Become a hero.
  
 
Join us on Sunday, August 17th on the water front, behind the aquarium, in Long Beach, California (or virtually) as we celebrate our recipients and those who helped give the gift of hearing! Let’s run and walk together so we can keep on giving this precious gift. All participants who register by July 25th are guaranteed to receive a t-shirt, and ALL participants are guaranteed to have lots of fun!

Join us for an exhilarating run through the marina and along the shore with views of the Queen Mary in Long Beach, California. Whether you're up for a 5k or the Kids Run, this event promises a memorable experience amidst the natural beauty of the shoreline.

Event Details:

Location: Shoreline Aquatic Park, 200 Aquarium Way, Long Beach, CA 90802

Bib Pickup: Starts at 7 am
Race Start Times:
5k: 8:00 am Kids Dash: 9:15 am

Parking Available a short walk away at the multi-level aquarium parking lot. Fees in the lot are by the hour, click this link for more details.


Course Map: https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6274860286/

Course Description:

The race starts and ends behind the aquarium, next to Pierpont Landing.

5k runners will follow the scenic path around along the marina, through Shoreline Village and out along the jetty where you will have a majestic view of the Queen Mary before heading back to the start.

Water station will be at the entrance to the jetty and you can stop here twice during the run/walk if you need to.

Course Time Limit: 1 hours and 45 minutes. You must cross the finish line by 9:45 a.m.

What You Get:

All participants will receive a finisher's medal, finish line treats, and free downloadable race photos.
Race results will be posted on our website within 12 hours of the race.

Gear Check: Personal items can be stored with our staff.

Water Station on the course, with water and electrolyte beverages.

Race Photos: Our course photographer will capture your journey, and you can download your photos for free within 24 hours of the event.

Results: Published on RunSignup within 12 hours of the race.

Refund and Deferral Policy:

Unfortunately, we do not offer refunds, please purchase the inexpensive insurance if you think there is a chance you might need to back out and will want a refund instead of considering it a donation to the charity. 


Who Can Register:

Everyone is welcome! Our races are open to participants of all ages, abilities, and races. Whether you're an experienced runner, a casual jogger, or a first-time walker, you're invited to join us. Parents can bring their children and strollers, as we believe in creating an inclusive and welcoming atmosphere for all. Come and be a part of this fun and rewarding race experience!
We look forward to seeing you in Long Beach for a day of fitness, fun, and camaraderie. Get ready to lace up your running shoes and create lasting memories in this beautiful setting!

name: Hike To: Eagle Rock
description:
UPDATE: we are moving departure time one hour to the left. New departure at 0700 

6.5 mi out & back | Easy Difficulty | Elevation Gain 990 feet | Warner Springs, CA

This hike is located about 2hrs from base. The first section of the trail takes you through a shade of oaks. Trees open up to grasslands overlooking remote area. At the end, you are treated to a unique rock formation called Eagle Rock. This hike is rated as easy, relatively flat, with little incline. This trail is a portion of the Pacific Crest Trail (PCT). We are likely to encounter backpackers on the trail. Please be sure to give backpackers the right of way.

Transportation is required.

Safety Tips: Wear lightweight non-cotton clothing and head covering (hat). Use sunblock. Must carry 2L of water, coupled with electrolyte tablets. Wear a trail shoe with good traction. Bring a small backpack to carry your water, snacks, and other hiking essentials. Trekking poles recommended if you have them. Come prepared with a fully charged cellphone.

name: Hike Volcan Mountain Wilderness Reserve
description:
5 miles out and back | Hard Difficulty | Elevation Gain 1,230 feet | Julian, CA

Volcan Mountain Trail is located near the old mining town of Julian. The trail follows an old road to the summit and this pleasant day hike provides excellent vistas. There is little shade along this route, so come prepared with sun protection and plenty of water. If you want to make this a loop, consider taking the Five Oaks Trail on the way up or down and enjoy a change a scenery.

Safety Tips: Shade is extremely limited on this trail. Wear lightweight non-cotton clothing and head covering (HAT) is required. Use sunblock. Must carry 1-2L of water, coupled with electrolyte tablets. Wear a trail shoe with good traction. Bring a small backpack to carry your water, snacks, and other hiking essentials. Trekking poles recommended if you have them. Come prepared with a fully charged cellphone and notify staff of any allergies or injuries they should be aware of for this difficult hike. Be sure to hydrate the day before as well.

name: Hike: Pyles Peak Trail!
description:
6.2 miles out and back | Hard Difficulty | Elevation Gain 1,788 feet | Mission Trails reginal park / estimated 4Hr hike 

HIKE: PYLES PEAK TRAIL

Sunday, February 22, 830 AM, FREE

Have you always wanted to hit two summits in one day! Here is your chance to do both Cowles and Pyles peak in one go. This 6-mile trail is rated as difficult and has no shade. Be ready to challenge yourself and bring at least 2 liters of water and a hat. bring a lunch if you get hangry. 

Safety Tips: Shade is extremely limited on this trail. Wear lightweight non-cotton clothing and head covering (hat). Use sunblock. Must carry 2L of water, coupled with electrolyte tablets. Wear a trail shoe with good traction. Bring a small backpack to carry your water, snacks, and other hiking essentials. Trekking poles recommended if you have them. Come prepared with a fully charged cellphone.

name: Hill Canyon Trail Trot 5k
description:
Lace up your trail shoes and join us for the inaugural Hill Canyon Trail Trot, a scenic run along the creek through canyon trails and oak-lined paths. This fun, family-friendly race welcomes runners, walkers and hikers of all levels. 

100% of the proceeds supports the Stepping Stones Riding Program, whose mission is to connect horses and people regardless of circumstances and wealth with low cost riding lessons and horse experiences. 

Whether you're chasing a PR (fast and fun course)  or just want an incredible morning outdoors with friends, the Hill Canyon Trail Trot 5K is the perfect way to kick off your weekend while supporting a great cause. We can't wait to see you there!

Register now to lock in Early Bird pricing!  $35.00 ( plus registration fee )   December 2025 through January 2026!

Medals awarded for 1st, 2nd and 3rd place age group winners, M & F .  Age groups: 13 & Under, 14-19, 20-29 30-39,40-49,50-59,60-69,70 & over.

Kiddie K - 10 and under .  Finishers will receive participant awards.

name: Hills Are Alive Run/Walk
description:
Join us for the 2026 Hills Are Alive 5k Run/Walk and 10k Run!
Race: Saturday May 30, 2026
Options: 5K Run or Walk, 10K Run, Virtual 5k or 10k
Runners/walkers will meet at the historic Ernie Howlett Park on Saturday, May 30!
Check-in begins at 7 am and the race starts at 8 am.

Runners/Walkers will be able to enjoy a scenic trail route which runs through our City’s bridle trails and ends back at the park. All registered participants receive an event t-shirt and custom medal. Winners for the 5k and 10k events will receive trophies (first place only; women and men). 

PACKET PICK-UP:
Packet pick-up for in-person runners or walkers, who registered prior to Friday, May 29, will take place on Friday, May 29th, at City Hall located at 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North in the Council Chambers from 9:00 am-4:30 pm. Any in-person runners or walkers who register on Friday, May 30 or on race day will pick up their packets at Ernie Howlett Park the day of the race.

Fees: 5k and 10k
Early Registration - $30 until 3/22/26 at 11:59 pm
Standard Registration - $40 until 5/29/26 at 8:00 pm
Day of Registration - $45 - IN-PERSON ONLY from 7:00 AM - 7:50 AM

Please Note: There are no strollers or dogs allowed on the race course

To view race course map for 5k and 10k please visit our City website HERE.

name: Ho'omau Foundation 5K from anywhere in the world
description:
Join us virtually from anywhere or in person - you choose what works best! Our goal is to raise awareness that our scholarship application is now open for Native Hawaiian and Pacific Islander students attending a vocational school, 2-year, or 4-year college anywhere in the U.S.

🧩 Join the Bingo game for extra fun. Win a social media shout-out or Amazon gift card!

💖 FREE to Join. Donations are welcome and appreciated. Every step helps make a real impact in our communities.

name: Hoag Kids Run The OC
description:
The Kids Run the OC is a 10-12 week program in which students accumulate 25+ miles through fun games & activities led by a volunteer coach at their school. The goal of the program is to build a lifelong love of fitness in all students, while building healthy habits and making new friends. The last mile of the training program is run at The Kids Run Final Mile Event during the first weekend in May. The Kids Run The OC Final Mile Event is presented by Hoag Hospital.

For safety purposes, this event is limited to children from participating schools ONLY. Not sure if your school is involved this year? Check HERE.

PLEASE NOTE: Participants in this event are limited to children and select coaches. Please do not register for this event as an adult or parent.

name: Hobby Joggers
description:
Hobby Joggers organizes FUN RUN events designed to be non-competitive, high-energy, and genuinely welcoming. Our races celebrate participation over placement, with Signature Anti-awards that recognize effort, spirit, creativity, and showing up, not just who finishes first.

Every participant receives an “I Showed Up” award, a playful take on participation awards that includes a fun swag bag or treat alongside a thoughtfully designed medal. Because showing up counts, and we fully embrace it.

Each event features a playful theme that encourages dressing up, having fun, and leaning into the experience. Race morning includes our signature Bib Bedazzle Station so you can add personal flair and glam before hitting the course. Expect high-energy, bass-heavy music to keep the vibes up from start to finish. Our Lucky Duck Hunt adds a playful, interactive twist that rewards curiosity and participation. We wrap up each event with a post-race Raffle as our way of saying thanks for showing up and hanging out.

Whether you run, jog, or walk, Hobby Joggers creates a no-pressure, stress-free environment where all paces and bodies are welcomed and celebrated. This is not your average race experience.

We RUN FOR FUN.

name: Hollywood Sign Run | Hike - 8M | 8K | 5K | Kid
description:
Experience the thrill of the Hollywood Sign Run/Hike in Griffith Park—now featuring a scenic out-and-back course to the Hollywood Sign Viewpoint! Take in sweeping views of Downtown Los Angeles, the Griffith Observatory, and a stunning close-up of the world-famous Hollywood Sign.
Whether you're a seasoned trail runner or a hiking enthusiast, this event offers an unforgettable adventure for all levels. Traverse iconic trails, soak in the natural beauty of the park, and connect with fellow outdoor lovers along the way.
Challenge yourself, take in the views, and be part of an inspiring day in one of L.A.’s most legendary landscapes.
 
All participants receive the following items and perks:
  • Picturesque, scenic, and well marked out and back courses
  • Panoramic views of the Observatory, Downtown Los Angeles, and an up close view of the Hollywood Sign (8M Only)
  • Stunning views of Glendale, DreamWorks Campus, and the Los Angeles River
  • Enjoy unparalleled views of the San Fernando Valley, Warner Bros. Studios, and the Disney Animation Building. Plus a special turn-around at Cathy’s Corner, the iconic film location from the Academy Award-winning movie La La Land.(8K only)
  • Ultra-soft, ultra-comfy premium gender specific short sleeve t-shirt*
  • Unique Finisher’s medal for all participants
  • Special award for Overall and Age Grade Division Winners
  • Prize from our sponsors for overall winners
  • Free Photos (w/ Mt. Lee and the Hollywood Sign, the Observatory, and DTLA, 8M Only)
  • Fast and accurate chip time results
  • Course Aid Stations (1-4) with medical staff
  • Volunteer Support
  • Gear check
  • Finish Line Fruit, Snacks, and Refreshments
  • Flexible deferral and transfer options
 
*Guaranteed T-Shirt Size Deadline is January 5th, Men or Women's cut

name: Honor Our Fallen 5K
description:
Join us for our 4th Annual Honor Our Fallen and Remember the Families 5K Memorial Run & Walk as we pay tribute to our fallen heroes who served in the San Bernardino County Sheriff’s Department. This year, we will be commemorating Deputy Hector Cuevas, Jr. and Deputy Andrew Nuñez who were both killed in the line of duty in 2025. This is a partnering event with SEBA, the Sheriff’s Department, and the Sheriff’s Athletic Federation.

SEBA's Peace Officer Relief Fund (PORF) is proud to financially sponsor this event for our members, members' families and supporters. All funds raised will go directly to the SEBA Charity Fund, supporting programs that give back to our law enforcement families and community.

name: Honor Run 2026 - KCSEBA
description:
Kern County Sheriff's Employees' Benefit Association 12th Annual Honor Run

Proceeds raised from the event will be donated to the Kern County Sheriff’s Employees’ Benefit Association and will be used to assist the families of our fallen deputies by providing scholarships for the children left behind.  In addition, a portion of the money raised will be used to support the Sheriff's Activities League (SAL) supervised youth activities and programs throughout the county.

Race Day registration for 5K and 10K begins at 7:00 a.m. and ends at 7:45 a.m.  

5K and 10K runs will start at 8:15 a.m.  Race Day Registration will be $50*

Kids 1K race day registration begins at 7:00 a.m. and ends at 7:45 a.m. 

Kids 1K run will start at 8:00 a.m. Race Day Registration will be $10*

*does not include online processing fees

Online registration will close at 8:00 a.m. on Monday, March 2, 2026.  (Shirt size guaranteed if registered prior to February 5, 2026)

The race will begin at Section 2 of Hart Park with parking located around the park and near the site of the run.

This year, there will be a pre-race packet pick-up that will occur on Thursday, March 5, 2026, from 4:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. at the Kern County Regional Training Center.  The Regional Training Center is located at 962 Norris Road, Bakersfield, 93308. 

After the race - medals will be awarded for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place in each division and a runners raffle!

We look forward to seeing you and thank you for supporting this great cause!

Participants in the event are also welcome to walk the race route.  Strollers are welcome.  Runners who want to bring their leashed dogs for the run are welcome to do so.  There will be water bowls at the turnaround points for your canine buddies!!!

Race Day registration for 5K and 10K begins at 7:00 a.m. and ends at 7:45 a.m.  

5K and 10K runs will start at 8:15 a.m.  Race Day Registration will be $50*

Kids 1K race day registration begins at 7:00 a.m. and ends at 7:45 a.m. 

Kids 1K run will start at 8:00 a.m. Race Day Registration will be $10*

*does not include online processing fees

Online registration will close at 8:00 a.m. on Monday, March 2, 2026.  (Shirt size guaranteed if registered prior to February 5, 2026)

The race will begin at Section 2 of Hart Park with parking located around the park and near the site of the run.

This year, there will be a pre-race packet pick-up that will occur on Thursday, March 5, 2026, from 4:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. at the Kern County Regional Training Center.  The Regional Training Center is located at 962 Norris Road, Bakersfield, 93308. 

After the race - medals will be awarded for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place in each division and a runners raffle!

We look forward to seeing you and thank you for supporting this great cause!

Participants in the event are also welcome to walk the race route.  Strollers are welcome.  Runners who want to bring their leashed dogs for the run are welcome to do so.  There will be water bowls at the turnaround points for your canine buddies!!!

name: Hop Skip and Splash 5K Fun Run/Walk
description:
Hop, Skip & Splash 5K Fun Run/Walk

Making Waves for Water Safety in Orange County

Join us on Sunday, October 25, 2026, for the fourth annual Hop, Skip & Splash 5K — a fun, family-friendly beachside fundraiser benefiting swim lessons and water safety education for children throughout Orange County. Whether you run, walk, or skip across the finish line, your participation helps save lives by supporting families who lack access to these life-saving resources!

Registration Opens May 2026!

Sponsorship Opportunities Available
Interested in supporting the event or promoting your organization?
Email info@jasperray.org for details.

This event is proudly presented by the Jasper Ray Foundation in partnership with the Orange County Drowning Prevention Coalition.
Together, we’re working to ensure every child in Orange County has access to life-saving swim lessons and water safety education.

Questions?
Contact us at info@jasperray.org

name: Hornitos Run
description:
The legend of Hornitos continues, with the 48th Annual Indian Gulch Hornitos Run hosted by the Merced Running Club.  Come run the historic Hornitos foothills on this road race through some of California's most beautiful range land. Select from 2, 5, and 10-mile out & back courses from the town of Hornitos to Indian Gulch. 

 

Join us for this race at the Hornitos Central Park, where you will find the starting line. All three distances are an out-and-back course along Hornitos Road. There will be aid stations at the turnarounds for the 5- and 10-mile distances. The 2-mile turnaround will be clearly marked on Hornitos Road. The total pre-registration fee for all events is $40, which includes all fees. Same-day race registration will be available for $50 per person, race day from 7:00 - 8:00 AM, cash and checks only. 

 

Packet pickup will be held race-day morning from 7:00-8:00 AM at Hornitos Park, near the start line. T-shirts will be given away for all  pre-registrations, and available first-come first-serve to same-day registrants. New this year will be professional chipped timing, provided by BizzRunningCompany. Top finishers in each 10-year age group earn a unique, race-themed award! Race registration includes a continental breakfast, and well-stocked aid stations at the 5- and 10-mile turnarounds. This year, proceeds continue to benefit the Mariposa High School Track Team, and additional donations can be made directly to the track team through this website. 

 

This is a plastic-cup-less event. Please bring your own cups and/or drinking bottles for water at aid stations. Also - as much as we love babies and dogs, we do not recommend them for this race as it is run on an open road with a narrow shoulder. Walkers are welcome on the 2 and 5 mile course; 10-mile participants should be ready to run!

 

“Golden Horseshoe” Awards go to the first male & female finishers in all age divisions: 1-9/10-19/20-19/30-39/40-49/50-59/60-69/70+

 

Merced Running Club Members: Use your Coupon Code to receive $5 off registration!

name: Hotshot Half Marathon
description: Come join the fire community for a beautiful 14.5-mile trail run along Bullards Bar Reservoir. Hosted by the Tahoe Hotshots, the Hotshot Half Marathon is a fundraiser for fallen Firefighter and beloved friend Mike Kelly. The course is 95% single track with the remaining course being mostly fire roads. There will be 3 fully stocked aid stations hosted by local fire departments, Forest Service employees, and local Camptonville community members. There will be a taco truck at the finish line that accepts cash/cards. 100% of the money raised will go to the Wildland Firefighter Foundation.

name: Huffin for the Stuffin- Turkey Trot  5K, 10K, & Half Marathon
description:
🦃 3rd Annual Huffin’ for the Stuffin’


5K • 10K • Half Marathon • Kids Dash
📅 Saturday, November 14, 2026
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803
🥧 Every Turkey Trot deserves a head start!

 

 
🏃‍♀️ Race Overview
Get ready to gobble, wobble, and trot your way down the scenic Long Beach shoreline!
The 2nd Annual Huffin’ for the Stuffin’ is the perfect way to earn your pie early. Choose from the 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon and enjoy the ocean views, holiday tunes, and feel-good vibes that’ll have you running with gratitude (and maybe a little gravy).

Whether you’re chasing a PR, trotting with your flock, or just here for the snacks — this race is for every pace, every age, and every turkey-loving runner in between.

 
🎁 What You Get
🏅 Finisher Medal (because you cranberry-lieve you did it!)
📸 Free Race Day Photos
🎶 DJ + Finish Line Festival
🍪 Post-Race Snacks & Treats
💧 Water & Electrolyte Stations
⏱ Chip Timing on a USATF-Certified Course
🏆 Overall & Age Group Awards

 
🎭 Costume Contest – Bring the Holiday Heat!
Dress to impress the turkeys out of us!


Prize Categories:

Most Creative Costume
Best Group / Family Theme
Funniest Turkey-Inspired Look
Whether you’re rocking a full bird suit, a pilgrim hat, or just festive socks — come strut your stuffin’!

 
🕒 Race Day Schedule
Bib Pick-Up/Runner Check In: 6:00 AM – 7:35 AM (Race Ready Athletics Tent)
Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K Start: 8:00 AM
⚠️ No late starts — turkeys wait for no one!
 
🚗 Parking & Amenities
🅿️ Free Street Parking
💵 Beach Lot: $2/hour (via Passport app or pay station)
🚻 Restrooms Near Start Line
🚰 Water Stations Every 2 Miles
👶 Stroller & Walker Friendly
🏁 Fully Marked Scenic Course

 
☀️ Weather & Safety
This event is rain or shine — because turkeys don’t quit!
(We’ll only postpone for tsunamis, tidal waves, or a zombie turkey uprising 🧟‍♀️🦃 — you’ll get an email if that happens.)

 
🎉 Join the Flock!
Bring your crew, bring your feathers, and join us for a morning of miles, medals, and major gobbles!
Let’s make this the most festive trot on the coast.

🦃💨 Come Huff for the Stuff and Run for the Pie!

💫 A Quick Note
There are several races that take place in and around our Long Beach course locations — but there’s only one CaliFlow Runs. 🌊 We are not affiliated with any of them.


If you’re looking for an exceptional race experience with professional chip timing, free photos, well-organized staff, and that signature CaliFlow vibe, make sure you see the CaliFlow Runs name or logo before you register.


If it’s not CaliFlow, it’s just an "average"race.. ❤️

name: Hunter's Heart Foundation - A World Beyond Wheels 5K Walk, Run, Ride 2026
description:
HUNTER’S HEART FOUNDATION - A WORLD BEYOND WHEELS 5K

Join us for a fun and meaningful 5k run/walk as we raise critical funds to fight Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD).  DMD is a debilitating genetic disorder that weakens muscles over time. Children with DMD face a daily battle, and research for a cure is ongoing.  This 5k is your chance to make a difference! Portion of the proceeds from the race will benefit CureDuchenne, a non-profit organization dedicated to research and finding a cure for DMD

WHEN: Saturday, September 19, 2026, 10:00 am-1:00 pm

WHERE: Whittier Narrow Recreation Center, 750 S. Santa Anita Ave., South El Monte, CA 91733

How you can support: 

·       Register for the walk 

·       Create your own Champion peer-to- peer group and invite 5 or more people to raise $100 each.  

·       Donate to make a difference

·       Sponsorship available

You will receive Team/Sponsorship recognition showcasing participation on Hunter's Heart Foundation and CureDuchenne website and social media platforms.

Here's why you should participate: It's a great way to get active and have fun! Whether you're a seasoned runner or a casual walker, this event is for everyone.

You'll be making a real difference in the lives of children with DMD. Your participation will help fund critical research and program support.  It's a family-friendly event! Bring your whole crew to cheer you on and enjoy the festivities.  Register today and help us run towards a cure for DMD!!!!

REGISTRATION: 9:00AM

RACE STARTS:   10:00AM

Visit our website at www.hhdmd.org for additional information.

name: Huntington Lake Triathlon, 5k & 10k
description:
What will you find at the Huntington Lake triathlon?

+ Finisher's Medal
+ Event T-Shirt
+ Pancake breakfast
+ Rosa Brother's Chocolate Milk
+ Prizes and Giveaways
+ Complimentary Race Photos

The Huntington Lake Triathlon is a fun and challenging race in an incredible location in Lakeshore, CA near the China Peak Resort. This event features a lake swim in Huntington Lake, a challenging road bike course, and a ‘high altitude’ run, which is part trail and part paved, finishes the race. Each athlete registered for the Huntington Lake Triathlon will receive a custom t-shirt, athlete goody bag, swim cap, post-race meal, and be eligible for raffle prizes and race awards three-deep in each division. Take the weekend and come up and enjoy this fun event with your family.

Note: A USAT membership is required for the Triathlon, (but not the 5k/10k)  If you do not have one, you can purchase one during the registration process.

Parking: There is a $10 vehicle entrance fee.  We recommend car pooling if possible.

Volunteer: Earn a future discounted multisport or free run! Transferable and never expires.

name: Impact 5K:  Dash Thru the 80s
description:
IMPACT 5K:  DASH THRU THE 80s STRIKES BACK!

Join us on FEBRUARY 22nd for a day to support addiction recovery!

Check in starts at 6AM, the 5K starts promptly at 8am.  Join us for an inspiring and impactful day at the second annual Impact Drug & Alcohol Treatment Center 5K Run/Walk at the picturesque Hahamongna Watershed Park in Pasadena. This exciting event is designed to bring together our community in support of a healthier, safer, and more vibrant Pasadena.

COME IN YOUR BEST 80s GEAR!  

We will be rocking to the sounds of 80s tribute band THE SKINNY TIES

Dash Thru the 80s will host a costume contest with amazing prizes and judged by KROQ's Megan Holiday!

Impact has been active in the treatment of addiction for men and women for over 50 years.  Our ability to continue this level of care comes because of the generosity of our supporters.  This event, and the funds raised, will go a long way toward making sure that we can continue the simple promise we make to everyone still lost in the fog of addiction:  we're here when you're ready.

We can't wait to see you all at Hahamongna Park!

name: Intermediate Sailing: February 21 & 22
description:
Two-day adult sailing classes are offered most weekends from 9 am to 4 pm at Fiddler's Cove Marina. Classes are open to all eligible MWR patrons and sponsored guests. Minimum age requirement is 16 years or older with a parent or guardian.  

**A minimum of 5 hours of sail time is required post beginner sailing course. 

Class fees per person vary by military affiliation and rank. Dependent fees are calculated at the sponsoring active duty or retiree rate. Pre-registration is required as classes can fill up quickly.

Registration includes boat rental, instruction, and textbooks. Students per boat will be kept to the minimum amount possible in order to maximize learning potential, and will range from one to four. Number of students per boat is dependent on the boat size, sailing conditions and the skills being developed in the class. On completion of the course, participants receive a Navy Sailing Qualification Card.

A valid California Boater Card and/or a course completion certificate is required before attending the first class. California Boater Cards and/or course completion certificates will be checked at the start of the first class. A free online course is offered through BoatU.S.. name: Ironstone Vineyards Wine Run 5k
description:
Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Sunday, March 29, 2026 starting at 10:00am for an exciting new event that features Ironstone Vineyards. Ironstone Vineyards is a premier Calaveras County destination with Wine Tasting, Dining and Estate Tours. So, whether you are looking to run, walk or just enjoy the wine and camaraderie this race is a sure thing for a great time and an incredible experience! This race is timed and scored by J3 Timing.  Results will be posted at www.J3Timing.com. 

Registration Includes:

  • T-shirt:  Super Soft Ring Spun Cotton t-shirt included! 
  • Wine Glass: Shatterproof, Collapsible, and Portable!
  • Finisher Medal: Doubles as a Wine Stopper!
  • Race Bib: Chip timed 5k run/walk
  • Results Posted Online
  • ...and of course, a pour of wine!

name: IRVINE 4th of July-Red, White, & Blue 5k & 1 Mile
description:
Click here to LOOK UP your bib number that you got assigned

https://runsignup.com/Race/FindARunner/?raceId=60114

 

So Cal’s 4th of July RED, WHITE, & BLUE 5k & 1 Mile

Saturday, July 4, 2026 | 8:30 AM
Irvine Valley College – Lot 5
5500 Irvine Center Dr., Irvine, CA 92618
(Entrance off Jeffrey. All other campus entrances will be closed.)

 
Flat and fast out-and-back course entirely on the Irvine Valley College campus
8:30 AM Mass Start, following a live National Anthem performance
Professional National Anthem singer will kick off the race
Live Fife & Drum Corps will entertain before the race and be available for fun photo ops
(Insider tip: ask them about their running times—they're cross-country athletes under those uniforms, adding authentic talent to this historical tribute!)
Patriotic atmosphere with live music, great selfie moments, and a vibrant community vibe
Bring your best FREEDOM energy and come ready to race, run, jog, or walk this healthy, high-spirited way to start your 4th of July
Custom shirts, huge finisher medals, chip timing, and age group awards
 

Bib & Shirt Pickup
Race Morning Pickup:
Begins at 6:30 AM in Lot 5
– Includes music, a selfie booth, and the awards area
– You may pick up for others; no ID required

Optional Early Packet Pickup:
Friday, July 3 | 2:00–5:00 PM
Location: Manassero Farms at Irvine Valley College (enter off Jeffrey)
33 Irvine Valley, Irvine, CA 92618

Race Day Schedule
6:30 AM– Race Day Registration & Bib/Shirt Pickup Opens
7:00 AM– Live Fife & Drums + Heritage Song Performances
8:00 AM – Diaper Dash (50 yards out & back)
8:05 AM – 1-Mile Fun Run (Can run with kids or as part of the combo option)
8:15 AM – Opening Ceremony + “Born in the USA” Singalong & Warm-Up
8:30 AM – 5K MASS START
9:15 AM – Overall Winners Announced
9:30 AM – Age Division Awards Begin

 

Food & Refreshments
Bring cash for fun food options at the finish line! Here's what to expect:

Specialty coffee drinks from a local coffee vendor
Delicious cookies from Galletina’s
Fresh fruit to refresh post-race
Our FAMOUS Street Tacos and Tamales—a crowd favorite!
You can pre-purchase food vouchers as an add-on during registration.

 
🎖 What’s Included with Registration🎖
Custom 4th of July themed race shirt (front and back design)
Huge 4-inch custom-cast finisher medal
Chip-timed results with a custom race bib
Water and fruit at the finish line
Eligibility for age group and overall awards
 
🏆Awards
Top 3 Male & Female Overall
5K & 1-Mile Age Group Awards (3 deep in 5-year increments):
1–10, 11–14, 15–19, 20–24, 25–29, 30–34, 35–39, 40–44, 45–49, 50–54, 55–59, 60–64, 65–69, 70–74, 75–79, 80–84, 85+
 
Strollers
Strollers are welcome! Please stay to the right and use at your own risk. Only registered participants with a bib will receive a finisher medal. Be sure your bib is worn on the front and visible to finish line staff.

Important Note for Combo Runners (5K + 1-Mile)
If you are running both the 5K and the 1-Mile:

Use only one bib at a time
Stash your unused bib away from the start/finish mats
If doing the 1-Mile Fun Run with your kids, wear your Fun Run bib and leave your 5K bib at the first aid/water station tent near the finish line
Following these steps helps avoid timing issues and ensures your results are accurate. Thank you!


Weather
Rain or shine—the event will go on! Celebrate your freedom and fitness this 4th of July.

 
🚗 Parking
Irvine Valley College requires a $5 parking fee per vehicle
You can purchase online during registration or pay on race day
Display your parking pass on the driver's side dashboard
Entrance allowed only from Jeffrey Road (Irvine Center Dr. entrance will be closed for the course)
Race staging takes place in the southeast corner of Lot 5, between the Manassero Farm Stand and the two-story Performing Arts building. We are the only event on campus that day.

 
Hosted by Caren Ware Events
Professionally chip-timed by Itz About Time
Offering fun, fitness, and community for everybody—and every BODY!

Custom shirts, huge finisher medals, chip timing, and age group awards
 

Bib & Shirt Pickup

Friday, July 3 | 2:00–5:00 PM

Race Day Schedule

8:00 AM – Diaper Dash (50 yards out & back)

Food & Refreshments

Specialty coffee drinks from a local coffee vendor

Custom 4th of July themed race shirt (front and back design)

name: Irvine Dream Run
description:
Lace up and dream big at the 2026 Irvine Dream Run! 🎉 Join us at the Great Park in Irvine for this can’t-miss, family-friendly race kicking off beneath the iconic Great Park Balloon. Choose a 5K, a 3K, or double the fun and run both—either way, you’re in for an unforgettable morning!

Every registration includes a race shirt, finisher medal, finish-line photo, and full access to our post-race expo, featuring a bouncy house, live music, food trucks, vendor booths, and plenty more to keep the celebration going.

Best of all, every step you take supports a great cause. 💛 All proceeds benefit the Sunstone Community Fund, helping fuel startups and entrepreneurship right here in Irvine. Our goal is to raise $50,000 for local founders and innovators—and we need you to help make it happen.

👉 Register by April 27, 2026, to guarantee your shirt size. Don’t wait—spots are filling fast!

🔥 Bonus: Refer five friends and score a $20 refund on your registration.

Stay connected—follow the Sunstone Community Fund on Instagram.

Let’s run, celebrate, and invest in Irvine’s future together! 🏃‍♀️🎈✨

name: Irvine/Orange County Turkey Trot 5K & 1 Mile
description:
Irvine/Orange County Turkey Trot 5K & 1 Mile
Thursday, November 26th, 2026
Thanksgiving Day
Irvine Valley College

THERE IS AN AWESOME CUSTOM CAST FINISHER MEDAL awaiting ALL you!  Choices of designs when you finish. A great race bib.  And the perfect Turkey designed, fun event shirt. 

7:30 am Turkey Feast Combo 1 Mile and 5k

8:00 am 5k Turkey Trot Race   

9:10 am Kids Gobble Wobble Races Start

(DO NOT MISS THESE START TIMES! Plan to arrive early as it takes time to park.

You MUST pass under the start arch by 8:12 .  

Two New Race Choices!  Choose the best race for you and earn a custom finishers medal and slice of fresh pumpkin pie!
Run fast, jog, trot, walk, or enjoy a nice stroll on this flat scenic course.  A scrumptious SLICE OF PIE awaits you at the finish. Along with So Cal's best custom cast finisher medal, you get an awesome shirt and CHIP TIMED.  Get your friends and family together and kick off the holidays together!   Guaranteed to be a picture perfect way to start celebrating THANKSGIVING DAY!

Run up a mini appetite with our family friendly 1 Mile or kick it up a notch with our 5k.  For those who plan to really indulge your can double down and enter our Turkey Feast Combo and run the 1 Mile and the 5k back to back!  This flat, friendly course is walker friendly and stroller ready.  Come out and see why it's become a holiday tradition for thousands of people !

We'll DECK out your Thanksgiving trimmings with:

*. Awesome Custom Cast Medals.
*. Soft Comfy event shirts for all.
*. Tasty pumpkin pie at the finish.
*. Custom Race bibs.
*  Chip timing by Itz About Time. 
*. Division awards for top three male and female in each age division. 5 year age spans from 10 & under to 80 & over!
*. Trophies for top three overall finishers male and female.
*. Holiday Expo to jump start your shopping.

1 Mile Turkey Dash:  7:30am Start.  This division is a fun run/ walk and non timed event.  This is great start for those who want a shorter distance to keep their whole tribe together.  It’s and out and back course so you’ll see everyone both directions!   If you skip ogot to skip out quick then come on out for this one and earn some fast bling with a fantastic medal for everyone who finishes.  ALL ONE MILERS MUST WEAR ONLY the 1 Mile bib while running the 1 Mile.  DO NOT WEAR the 5K BIB. 

IRVINE/OC 5k Turkey TROT:  8:00am Start.  This is open to all ages and takes place around the perimeter of the college campus.  It's a speedy course that swings by citrus grove tree's and some pumpkin patches!  it starts and finishes in the same spot so you won't miss seeing your friends somewhere along the way!  

Turkey Feast Combo:  7:30am Start.  This is for the those who like extra helpings at Thanksgiving!  We love this challenge!  Each participant will start at 7:30 with the 1 mile race.  You'll need to complete the 1 mile in 30 minutes so you'll have time to line up for your second race, the 5k at 8am.  You’ll receive 1 shirt and two medals if you complete both races!  Rally up!  You may pick up your 1 mile medal after your 5k race so you don't have to run with it!

Gobble Wobble Kids Event:  These kids races offer shorter distances if they don't want to do the 5k.

 9:15 A.M:  Diaper Dash - 50 yards (3 and under)
9:20 A.M:  Tot Trot  - 100 yards (4 to 5 years old)
9:25 A.M: Youth Race -1/4 Mile (6 to 10 years old)
9:28 A.M: Youth Race - Half Mile (11 to 12 years old) 

 Adults, you may run along with your child.

Kid's Gobble Wobble Race Details

All participants receive a race bib, custom cast medal, event t-shirt, and slice of pie!   5k is chip timed and kid's runs are for fun.  We will start lining the kids up at 9:05 per age group.  All the kids races are on a out and back loop and start and end in the same spot.   The course will be closed and lined with volunteers to direct all kids to the turnaround spot. They can turn early if they want with no penalty if they think it's too far.  One adult per child can run with their participant and the parent does not have to register but will not receive the shirt, medal, bib or pie. 

If you have a child that just wants to ride in a stroller with you on the 5k course, they can do so without registering.  They will not receive a medal, bib, shirt or pie but they can share yours! 

Awards

Professional Chip timing and results for all 5k participants. Age Division awards will be given 3 deep in the following age categories: 1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, *70-74, *75-79, *80 and over. Yes!  We split the final divisions to celebrate our 70 and over rock star field!  We're happy to celebrate this growing category and look forward to seeing everyone earn their race bling! 

Costume Awards will be given for Best Dressed so come decked out and you may take home a prize! Win as an individual or a group (6 people max)!

Early Packet Pick Up: Optional

Packet Pick up will be held on Wednesday, November 25th from 12 pm to 4pm at Road Runner Sports in Laguna Hills.
24291 Avenida De La Carlota; Suite P-5; Laguna Hills, CA 92653  (plan on this day to being a heavy traffic day, give extra time to arrive)

Pick up your bib and shirt  at packet pick up or on race morning at the race from 6:30am to 7:30am
One person can pick up for others.  No confirmation required.  Just know the last and first name they signed up under. 
Walk up registration accepted at early packet pick and on race day morning.
Shirts and Shirts sizes are not guaranteed for race day late registration.

Race Day Pick Up:

You may pick up your race bib and t-shirt on race day from 6:15 am to 7:30 am. In the quad, in front of the performance arts theater. That's the big two story orange building on the Irvine Valley College campus.

Parking:  Cost is $5.  Entrance is off of Irvine Center and  allowed on Jeffrey .Entrance closed on Irvine Center Drive at 7:55am. It's part of the course).  Only the entrances on Jeffrey stay open during the run . If parking in the solar lot, you will not be able to leave the lot until 9am. You will need to exit off Lasar Way and wait until directed to cross the race course as stragglers will still be coming in.

YOU MUST purchase a  PARKING PASS.  PUT ON YOUR DASH.  THIS CAN BE DONE ONLINE, AT PACKET PICK UP, OR b y buying at the PARKING PASS BOTH at registration on RACE MORNING.  THE CAMPUS PD charge  for every vehicle and look for the passes.  ( This parking fee is required on entering and parking at any local college).

Takes place wind, rain, or shine.

FAQ's
 Are dogs allowed? Due to college's policy, dogs are not allowed on the run course.

name: Island Spring Half Marathon
description:
Event Date: April 26th, 2026
We kick off the Island Race Series with a fundraiser for the Alameda Hospital Foundation. 2026 is special because we have added a Half Marathon to this event
Run both the Spring Half and the Island Festival Half and receive a customer "half and half" hoodie. 
This race will take place at Faction brewery and feature all the beautiful views, flats course and post race expo that you are used to at our September event.

 

Event Schedule:
  • 4/23 - 4/25/26 ~ Packet pick up: Lauren's Closet 1420 Park St. Alameda. Ca. 10:00am - 5:00pm
  • 4/26/26 ~ Race morning registration opens at 6:45am: 950 West Mall City Hall West / Alameda Point
     
General Overview: 
All of the runs will showcase parts of Alameda point, new parks on the west end of Alameda, the USS Hornet and coastal trails. the course is flat and fast with the 10k returning to be part of the USATF 10K circuit. 

 

there will also be music from DJ Mike, food and and age group winner awards presented by Burneikis law. Come enjoy a fun local race with a community feel, and support a great beneficiary in the Alameda Hospital Foundation. 
 
Race Details

Race times are as follows:
  • Half Marathon - 7:45am
  • 10K - 08:00am 
  • 5k - 08:15am
  • Family fun run time TBD 9:45am

name: Jingle All the Way - Christmas Day 5K, 10K, Half Marathon, Kids Dash by Califlow Runs

Cooler weather. Extra vibes. Free splash zone.
Rain or Shine, always.

name: Jolly10K
description: Join us for another year of fun in the sun! At the Jolly10k you'll take a 10K or a 5K run or walk, through stunning Los Gatos mountain trails and arrive back at the finish line to enjoy fun, food and fellowship. We have informational booths, a variety of resource tables, CPR training and as always the Los Gatos Fire Dept. joins us for a group photo with the Fire Engine. We definitely have fun, but the reason we gather for the Jolly10k is to create a safe environment to have the difficult conversations about addiction and the deadly epidemic of Fentanyl that has flooded our country and stolen far too many young lives. But together, we can remember our loved ones and share life-saving information on how to prevent the next life lost from being someone in your family.                       Excercise, Information & Education!

name: JP's Backyard Ultra/Hike, The Final Edition
description:
Join us for JP’s Backyard Ultra, a one-of-a-kind ultramarathon and hike set in the scenic trails of Skyline Wilderness Park in Napa, CA. Now in its fourth and final year, this grassroots event is more than just a race, it’s a celebration of life, resilience, and community.

Born from my personal journey with Stage IV mediastinal paraganglioma, JP’s Backyard Ultra is a fundraiser for the Pheo Para Alliance, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN 26-1510652) dedicated to empowering patients, families, and medical professionals affected by pheochromocytoma and paraganglioma through education, advocacy, and global support. Learn more at www.pheopara.org.

Whether you're in it for one loop or ten, come run or hike in solidarity, to honor those facing rare diseases, to challenge yourself, and to stand as part of a growing force for good.

~Jonathan Pascual

  • The course features a 3.3 mile loop with 550+ feet of climbing, offering a mix of terrain from steep rocky sections to shaded paths. Scroll down for map below.
  • Participants can choose anywhere from 1 to 10 loops.
  • Runners and hikers alike start at the same time every hour going clockwise on the even hours and counterclockwise on the odd hours. So it doesn't matter if you finish your loop fast or slow because everyone starts again at the same time in the next hour. Those attempting 10 loops should pace themselves for a final race on the 10th loop making 33.3 miles. You can do as many or as few loops as you wish however.
  • Timed Event: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM. Please arrive by 0730 for course description, announcement of run prize categories & fundraising prizes.
  • Aid Station: Main camp has various caloric options and drinks with water only at the bridge and mile 2.3.
  • Food & Beverages: Provided, including lunch for participants and volunteers.
  • Cupless Event: Bring your own water bottle or hydration pack. HYDRAPAK, our Sustainable Racing Partner will provide limited 300 Limited Edition HydraPak Graphic SpeedCups & 8 SpeedFill Pitchers for use at aid stations.
  • Awards:
    • Medals to all registered hikers and runners.
    • Medal & wine (non-alcoholic option for under 21) for top three male and female finishers of the 2, 4, 6, 8 loops.
    • Medal, wine, and trophy for the fastest 10th loop goes to the top three male and female finishers and special Vinerunner 4th place trophy.
    • Medal, wine, and trophy for the fastest cumulative time for 10 loops goes to the top three male and female finishers.
  • Raffle Prizes: buy tickets on day of event to win raffle baskets, gift certificates, and other special prizes. Proceeds benefit the Pheo Para Alliance.
  • Silent Wine Auction: place your bids on exceptional wines generously donated by local Napa Valley wineries, starting at an unbeatable buy-now price. Proceeds benefit the Pheo Para Alliance.
  • Registration "Fee": Donation Link
    • JP's Backyard Ultra has always been a free event. Suggested donation to register starts at $30. 
    • Participants get a medal, a variety of snacks and drinks at the aid station, and lunch.
    • To streamline registration, we are using runsignup.com. 100% of suggested starting donation of $30 goes directly to the Pheo Para Alliance. The processing fee of 6% per $1 of transaction (cart). This fee is charged per transaction, not per individual participant, meaning that if a user registers multiple people to a single cart, the $1 fee is only charged once, lowering the overall cost per person. 
    • If you cannot attend or want to donate beyond the suggested amount, consider giving an additional donation at the donation link.
  • Parking:
    • Do not park at Skyline's main parking lot to avoid parking fee. Parking opens at 0600.
    • Follow signs for "JP's Backyard Ultra Parking" for free parking for registered participants at the Westside parking lot of Skyline Wilderness Park.
  • Childcare: We have volunteers to watch your kids from 0800-1200.
  • Park Rules: No dogs on trails, stay on marked trails, carry out your trash & put in appropriate bins at the main aid station, trails close at sunset.
  • Camp with us: reservations at Skyline's Website: Reserve Camp Site. Mention JP's Backyard Ultra to reserve your spot in our campsite on Friday 9/25 & Saturday 9/26. Camping reservation with vehicles is nearby but will be separate from the tent only camping.

name: Judgment Day Half Marathon, 10K & 5K Run/Walk
description:
THE LAST RACE IN OUR SERIES, JUDGMENT DAY...ONE OF THE BEST COURSES IN THE VALLEY!

HALF MARATHON DESCRIPTION:

A VERY SCENIC COURSE. IT STARTS & FINISHES AT THE HISTORIC SAM LYNN BALLPARK. YOU WILL RUN OUT THE BACK GATE TO THE PAVED KERN RIVER PAVED TRAIL (EAST) INTO THE PANORAMA VISTA PRESERVE (DIRT TRAILS) FOR A 3.5 MILE LOOP, AND THEN BACK ONTO THE KERN RIVER PAVED TRAIL TO CHINA GRADE ROAD.  RUNNERS WILL TURN RIGHT ONTO THE ALFRED HARRELL HWY/CHINA GRADE LOOP (CLOSED ROAD) - YES THAT'S A CHALLENGING 1 MILE CLIMB UP TO THE PANORAMA BLUFFS, BUT EVERYONE LOVES IT, AND JUDGMENT DAY WOULDN'T BE THE SAME WITHOUT IT! ONCE AT THE TOP, YOU WILL CONTINUE THROUGH PANORAMA PARK ALONG THE BLUFFS WITH AWESOME VISTA VIEWS, BEFORE SWEEPING BACK DOWN (CLOSED MANOR STREET EXIT) TO THE PAVED RUNNING TRAIL ALONG THE KERN RIVER, AND FINISHING BACK INSIDE THE BALLPARK. 

10K COURSE DESCRIPTION:

OUR 10K WAS INTRODUCED IN 2025, AND IT DID NOT DISSAPPOINT!

YOU WILL START WITH THE HALF MARATHON RUNNERS, STARTING INSIDE THE HISTORIC SAM LYNN BALLPARK, AND RUNNING OUT THE BACK GATE TO THE PAVED KERN RIVER PAVED TRAIL (EAST). AT MILE 2.8, THERE WILL BE "SPLIT" WHERE THE HALF MARATHON GOES LEFT, AND THE 10K COURSE GOES RIGHT, AND UP THE 0.40 MILE DIRT TRAIL, ABOUT 190' ELEVATION GAIN (STRAVA CALLS IT BLUFF HILL). ONCE AT THE TOP, YOU WILL JOIN THE PANAROMA PAVED TRAIL, AND CONTINUE THROUGH PANORAMA PARK ALONG THE BLUFFS WITH AWESOME VISTA VIEWS, BEFORE SWEEPING BACK DOWN (CLOSED MANOR STREET EXIT) TO THE PAVED RUNNING TRAIL ALONG THE KERN RIVER, AND FINISHING BACK INSIDE THE BALLPARK. 

THESE COURSES HAVE EVERYTHING! START/FINISH INSIDE THE BALLPARK ON GRASS, PAVED TRAILS, DIRT TRAILS, PAVED (CLOSED) ROADS, AN UPHILL, A DOWNHILL, AND LOTS OF FUN!!  

5K COURSE DESCRIPTION:

START & FINISH FROM INSIDE SAM LYNN BALLPARK, IT'S AN OUT & BACK, ALL ON THE KERN RIVER (PAVED) TRAIL. IT IS FAST & FLAT!!

HALF MARATHON & 10K START TIME: 7:30AM
5K START TIME: 7:40AM

Aid Stations at Miles: 1.4, 3.6, 6.1, 7.1, 9.1, 10, and 11.6.

Porta Potties at Miles: 1.5, 3.6, 6.1, 7.1, 10, and 11.5

Celebrate America’s independence with the July 4th Freedom Run — where every stride honors liberty, courage, and the spirit of freedom.
Whether you walk, jog, or race your heart out, come together to move for what unites us all.

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount!

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!

Be part of the Journey!

name: Juneteenth Freedom Run/Walk
description:
The Juneteenth Freedom 5K/5 Mile Run is an event that goes beyond just a race. Juneteenth commemorates the day when 250,000 slaves in Texas, which became the last bastion for slavery during the final days of the Civil War, were declared free.

All participants in the live and virtual race will receive a tech shirt and medal. The live 5K/5 Mile race will have placement awards.

NEW THIS YEAR: Kids' age group awards and cash prizes for breaking the course record for the 5K and 5 mile races.

The 5 Mile race is a 20-point race in the Central Valley Runner of the Year series.
