name: Mile Madness Endurance Run
description:
Join the Ultimate Loop Adventure in the Heart of Trail Country!

Mile Madness is more than a race—it's a vibrant celebration of endurance, community, and personal triumph. Set against the stunning backdrop of Auburn, California, this looped trail event invites runners of all paces to push their limits (or simply enjoy the journey) on a meticulously designed 1-mile course, mainly paved bike path, blending a beautiful pond, shaded paths, and much more for an unforgettable experience.

Event Details:

Dates: September 18-21, 2026

Friday:

9:00 am 72 Hour Run and 72 Hour Team Relay 

6:00 pm: 48 Hour Run and 48 Hour Team Relay

Saturday:

9:00 am 100 Mile Race

Noon: 12 Hour and 24 Hour

6:00 pm: 6 Hour Glow Run

Location: Regional Park, 3770 Richardson Dr, Auburn, CA 95602

Race Options: Choose your challenge from 8 timed events, ranging from a beginner-friendly 6-hour run to the epic 72-hour ultra. With exceptionally long cutoffs and no strict time pressures, whether you're walking, running, or crawling, there's space for everyone to shine and even earn one of the coveted Mile Madness Buckles.

Course Highlights: A compact 1-mile loop means continuous laps with easy access to aid stations, festive decorations, and upbeat music to keep your spirits high. Aim for that first ultra milestone or chase elite goals—many of our runners discover untapped potential here. The course will be professionally measured prior to the race (Coros had it at 1.0 miles, the Stava tax took some away).

Why Mile Madness?

Inclusivity for All: We had runners from ages 10 to 82, with a balanced mix of 52.8% male and 47.2% female participants. In 2024, we welcomed 115 runners with a remarkable 72% buckle completion rate (applies to 48- and 72-hour runners); 2025 was 140 strong, and we're projecting 200-250 for 2026. Beginners who've never run an ultramarathon often surprise themselves with distances they never imagined.

Top-Notch Support: Fully stocked aid station featuring a rotating menu of hearty meals, electrolytes, all the typical aid station food, and endless encouragement from what might be the best volunteers in trail running. Other amenities include on-site massage therapists, family cheer zones, glow run, food trucks, and more...

Bling & Bragging Rights: Earn the coveted Silver 100-Mile Buckle (35 awarded in 2024, many to first timers!) or challenge yourself for the stunning Gold 150-Mile Buckle or the brand new 200-Mile buckle. Plus, a 100% rollover policy up to 24 hours before race start means zero risk if life throws a curveball.

SWAG: Every registered runner will get a race shirt or jacket. Our current plan is to provide gender-specific, packable, puffy jackets. We cannot guarantee sizes for registrations after 9/1/26, but we will do our best to accommodate requests. All runners will also get additional SWAG that will be announced closer to race weekend.

Bib Raffle: We will hold a bib raffle at regular intervals during the race. Registered runners will be entered into the raffle. It's a bonus: you might walk away with fantastic prizes, including shoes, handheld bottles, an antichafe stick, and more. Why should podium winners get all the bling?

Family & Community Focus: Bring your crew! Our expansive 20x30 Cheer Zone offers shaded comfort, music, free snacks and water, games, festive decorations, S’mores, and a DIY sign-making station to fuel the fun. Come solo or with friends—you'll leave with new bonds, shared stories, and memories that last a lifetime. Runners rave: "The highlight of my year!" (Summer W.) and "My favorite race ever!" (Shawnee).

Worry-Free Guarantee: We will roll over your race entry to the next year if you can't run due to injury or training challenges. We want you to enjoy the race you pay for, and we understand that life happens.

Extra Perks: Plenty of clean restrooms, and a commitment to giving back through the Run Free Foundation, whose mission is to empower at-risk youth and runners facing financial barriers by providing access to quality running gear and race registration scholarships, enabling them to pursue their athletic dreams and enhance their well-being. 

Mile Madness isn't just about the miles—it's about the madness of joy, grit, and connection that turns strangers into trail family. Whether you're chasing a PR, your first buckle, or just the thrill of the loop, we're here to support you through every step. We may have the best volunteers in the business.

Relay Option: We have a 72-Hour Relay and 48-Hour Relay 

  • Each relay team can have 4-10 runners.  Each runner will register and pay a separate registration fee (which covers food, SWAG, and more) and select their relay team.  Each team will share a single team bib with one runner at a time on the course.  Other team members can use a Pacer bib to support their team member running with the team bib.
  • Podium awards will go to the top three teams.  
  • Relay runners are not eligible to earn a 100-mile buckle (relay laps should be shared somewhat evenly between team members, so achieving 100 miles per runner is unlikely).

Ultra Lounge: The family cheer zone is getting a more fitting name. We are borrowing the Ultra Lounge name and will have our 13x26 wedding tent with fun activities that will keep your crew going so they can keep cheering you on.  We will have food and water, a poster-making station, a glow party, cornhole, and more...

Referral Rewards: We want to reward you for referring other runners to Mile Madness.  When you register, you will get a referral code to share.  Have your family, friends, or social circle use that code, and you will receive a refund for every referral.

Earn $10 for any 6-Hour or 12-Hour referral.  Earn $20 for each referral to the 24-Hour or longer races.  The refund will happen automatically, and the referral code must be used by the person registering. 

Questions? Email Race Director Brian Goldman at brian@everydayenduranceraces.com. Let's make 2026 your most memorable madness yet!

description:
Join the Ultimate Loop Adventure in the Heart of Trail Country!

Mile Madness is more than a race—it's a vibrant celebration of endurance, community, and personal triumph. Set against the stunning backdrop of Auburn, California, this looped trail event invites runners of all paces to push their limits (or simply enjoy the journey) on a meticulously designed 1-mile course, mainly paved bike path, blending a beautiful pond, shaded paths, and much more for an unforgettable experience.

Event Details:

Dates: September 18-21, 2026

Friday:

9:00 am 72 Hour Run and 72 Hour Team Relay 

6:00 pm: 48 Hour Run and 48 Hour Team Relay

Saturday:

9:00 am 100 Mile Race

Noon: 12 Hour and 24 Hour

6:00 pm: 6 Hour Glow Run

Location: Regional Park, 3770 Richardson Dr, Auburn, CA 95602

Race Options: Choose your challenge from 8 timed events, ranging from a beginner-friendly 6-hour run to the epic 72-hour ultra. With exceptionally long cutoffs and no strict time pressures, whether you're walking, running, or crawling, there's space for everyone to shine and even earn one of the coveted Mile Madness Buckles.

Course Highlights: A compact 1-mile loop means continuous laps with easy access to aid stations, festive decorations, and upbeat music to keep your spirits high. Aim for that first ultra milestone or chase elite goals—many of our runners discover untapped potential here. The course will be professionally measured prior to the race (Coros had it at 1.0 miles, the Stava tax took some away).

Why Mile Madness?

Inclusivity for All: We had runners from ages 10 to 82, with a balanced mix of 52.8% male and 47.2% female participants. In 2024, we welcomed 115 runners with a remarkable 72% buckle completion rate (applies to 48- and 72-hour runners); 2025 was 140 strong, and we're projecting 200-250 for 2026. Beginners who've never run an ultramarathon often surprise themselves with distances they never imagined.

Top-Notch Support: Fully stocked aid station featuring a rotating menu of hearty meals, electrolytes, all the typical aid station food, and endless encouragement from what might be the best volunteers in trail running. Other amenities include on-site massage therapists, family cheer zones, glow run, food trucks, and more...

Bling & Bragging Rights: Earn the coveted Silver 100-Mile Buckle (35 awarded in 2024, many to first timers!) or challenge yourself for the stunning Gold 150-Mile Buckle or the brand new 200-Mile buckle. Plus, a 100% rollover policy up to 24 hours before race start means zero risk if life throws a curveball.

SWAG: Every registered runner will get a race shirt or jacket. Our current plan is to provide gender-specific, packable, puffy jackets. We cannot guarantee sizes for registrations after 9/1/26, but we will do our best to accommodate requests. All runners will also get additional SWAG that will be announced closer to race weekend.

Bib Raffle: We will hold a bib raffle at regular intervals during the race. Registered runners will be entered into the raffle. It's a bonus: you might walk away with fantastic prizes, including shoes, handheld bottles, an antichafe stick, and more. Why should podium winners get all the bling?

Family & Community Focus: Bring your crew! Our expansive 20x30 Cheer Zone offers shaded comfort, music, free snacks and water, games, festive decorations, S’mores, and a DIY sign-making station to fuel the fun. Come solo or with friends—you'll leave with new bonds, shared stories, and memories that last a lifetime. Runners rave: "The highlight of my year!" (Summer W.) and "My favorite race ever!" (Shawnee).

Worry-Free Guarantee: We will roll over your race entry to the next year if you can't run due to injury or training challenges. We want you to enjoy the race you pay for, and we understand that life happens.

Extra Perks: Plenty of clean restrooms, and a commitment to giving back through the Run Free Foundation, whose mission is to empower at-risk youth and runners facing financial barriers by providing access to quality running gear and race registration scholarships, enabling them to pursue their athletic dreams and enhance their well-being. 

Mile Madness isn't just about the miles—it's about the madness of joy, grit, and connection that turns strangers into trail family. Whether you're chasing a PR, your first buckle, or just the thrill of the loop, we're here to support you through every step. We may have the best volunteers in the business.

Relay Option: We have a 72-Hour Relay and 48-Hour Relay 

  • Each relay team can have 4-10 runners.  Each runner will register and pay a separate registration fee (which covers food, SWAG, and more) and select their relay team.  Each team will share a single team bib with one runner at a time on the course.  Other team members can use a Pacer bib to support their team member running with the team bib.
  • Podium awards will go to the top three teams.  
  • Relay runners are not eligible to earn a 100-mile buckle (relay laps should be shared somewhat evenly between team members, so achieving 100 miles per runner is unlikely).

Ultra Lounge: The family cheer zone is getting a more fitting name. We are borrowing the Ultra Lounge name and will have our 13x26 wedding tent with fun activities that will keep your crew going so they can keep cheering you on.  We will have food and water, a poster-making station, a glow party, cornhole, and more...

Referral Rewards: We want to reward you for referring other runners to Mile Madness.  When you register, you will get a referral code to share.  Have your family, friends, or social circle use that code, and you will receive a refund for every referral.

Earn $10 for any 6-Hour or 12-Hour referral.  Earn $20 for each referral to the 24-Hour or longer races.  The refund will happen automatically, and the referral code must be used by the person registering. 

Questions? Email Race Director Brian Goldman at brian@everydayenduranceraces.com. Let's make 2026 your most memorable madness yet!

SWAG: Every registered runner will get a race shirt or jacket. Our current plan is to provide gender-specific, packable, puffy jackets. We cannot guarantee sizes for registrations after 9/1/26, but we will do our best to accommodate requests. All runners will also get additional SWAG that will be announced closer to race weekend.

Bib Raffle: We will hold a bib raffle at regular intervals during the race. Registered runners will be entered into the raffle. It's a bonus: you might walk away with fantastic prizes, including shoes, handheld bottles, an antichafe stick, and more. Why should podium winners get all the bling?

Family & Community Focus: Bring your crew! Our expansive 20x30 Cheer Zone offers shaded comfort, music, free snacks and water, games, festive decorations, S’mores, and a DIY sign-making station to fuel the fun. Come solo or with friends—you'll leave with new bonds, shared stories, and memories that last a lifetime. Runners rave: "The highlight of my year!" (Summer W.) and "My favorite race ever!" (Shawnee).

Worry-Free Guarantee: We will roll over your race entry to the next year if you can't run due to injury or training challenges. We want you to enjoy the race you pay for, and we understand that life happens.

Extra Perks: Plenty of clean restrooms, and a commitment to giving back through the Run Free Foundation, whose mission is to empower at-risk youth and runners facing financial barriers by providing access to quality running gear and race registration scholarships, enabling them to pursue their athletic dreams and enhance their well-being. 

Mile Madness isn't just about the miles—it's about the madness of joy, grit, and connection that turns strangers into trail family. Whether you're chasing a PR, your first buckle, or just the thrill of the loop, we're here to support you through every step. We may have the best volunteers in the business.

Relay Option: We have a 72-Hour Relay and 48-Hour Relay 

  • Each relay team can have 4-10 runners.  Each runner will register and pay a separate registration fee (which covers food, SWAG, and more) and select their relay team.  Each team will share a single team bib with one runner at a time on the course.  Other team members can use a Pacer bib to support their team member running with the team bib.
  • Podium awards will go to the top three teams.  
  • Relay runners are not eligible to earn a 100-mile buckle (relay laps should be shared somewhat evenly between team members, so achieving 100 miles per runner is unlikely).

Ultra Lounge: The family cheer zone is getting a more fitting name. We are borrowing the Ultra Lounge name and will have our 13x26 wedding tent with fun activities that will keep your crew going so they can keep cheering you on.  We will have food and water, a poster-making station, a glow party, cornhole, and more...

Referral Rewards: We want to reward you for referring other runners to Mile Madness.  When you register, you will get a referral code to share.  Have your family, friends, or social circle use that code, and you will receive a refund for every referral.

Earn $10 for any 6-Hour or 12-Hour referral.  Earn $20 for each referral to the 24-Hour or longer races.  The refund will happen automatically, and the referral code must be used by the person registering. 

Questions? Email Race Director Brian Goldman at brian@everydayenduranceraces.com. Let's make 2026 your most memorable madness yet!

name: Miles for Mayo 5K
description:
Welcome to the Miles For Mayo 5K walk/run, a family-friendly event supporting local schools and running programs, representing the passion and values of Matías “Mayo” Rogers. In a short time, Matías ingrained himself in the local community as one of the best runners in Liberty High School history. He was also an honors AP student who lived the values of being kind, generous and helpful.

The race begins at Veteran's Park on Saturday, June 20 at 9 a.m. A virtual option is available for those who can not attend in person, but still want to be part of this special event.

Race fees before June 1, are as follows (children age 3 and under are welcome, no registration necessary):
Ages 4-9 $15
Ages 10-18 $20
Ages 19 and up $35

June 1 and after they are as follows:

Ages 4-9 $15
Ages 10-18 $25
Ages 19 and up $40

Additionally, starting June 1 shirt sizes are not guaranteed.

name: Military Baby Shower
description: Calling all new moms! MWR is hosting a special Baby Shower just for you, packed with fun, support, and great memories. Enjoy a delicious breakfast buffet, informational talks, games, a photo keepsake, and a variety of vendors on hand to answer all your baby-related questions and provide helpful tips. Every mom will also receive a baby diaper bag to take home. It’s a day of celebration, learning, and pampering—you deserve it!

name: Millerton Lake Crows Nest Triathlon, 5k & 10k
description:
What will you find at the "Crows Nest" Triathlon?

+ Finisher's Medal
+ Prizes and Giveaways
+ Free Race Photos
+ Get an Event T-Shirt included in the price of the triathlon

The Millerton Lake Sprint Triathlon has long been known as a great "first lake swim" triathlon, and a warm up for the upcoming season. But don't let the bike and run distances fool you, there are a few steep hills on the ride, and the trail portion of run is a challenge.

More of a good thing... The Olympic Distance has a more challenging swim, two loops of the bike course, and two loops of the run course with a trail run heading out, a paved road coming back and beautiful Millerton Lake as the backdrop.

Note:

A USAT membership is required for the Triathlon, (but not the 5k/10k)  If you do not have one, you can purchase one during the registration process.  Per USAT rules, multisport participants must present ID and USAT membership card at packet pickup.

Total participation at this event is capped at 200.  Register before it is sold out.

There is a $10 vehicle entrance fee.

name: Millerton Madness Triathlon
description:
USAT Sanctioned Super Sprint Triathlon.  

Perfect for beginners, or a tune-up before your next big race.

400 yd swim | 5.4 mile bike | 2.2 mile run

Swim: Starting in the water at Millerton, athletes will utilize Millerton Lake Boat Launch. Athletes will swim 400 yards around buoys, back to the boat ramp, exit the water and proceed to the Transition Area.

Bike: Starting at the Transition Area, athletes will make their way north towards the Millerton park entrance, to the turnaround at the top Millerton Lake SRA sign. The bike is out and back with rolling hills. Returning to the transition area.

Run: Run is all asphalt road. Starting at the Transition Area, athletes head north from the parking lot along the street for approximately 1.1 miles towards the Millerton park entrance to the turn around, (at the crosswalk), and back to the finish line.

name: Minarets Endurance Classic Mountain Bike Events
description: The Minarets Endurance Classic is a bike race at Tesoro Viejo for mountain bikers and gravel grinders to enjoy with family and friends. Racers can choose from a 3 or 6-hour format. If 3 or 6 hours is too long to race by yourself, put together a two to four person team. Teams will send out one rider at a time and trade off completing loops however they choose and complete as many loops as possible in the allotted time. Any team with at least one member who rides an E-Bike will race in the E-Bike category. Costume Contest for youth and adults!!

name: Mindful Miles 5K Run/Walk
description:
Mindful Miles 5K Run/Walk aims to support mental health awareness.  With support from a grant provided by the California Mental Health Services Authority (CalMHSA), we aim to promote understanding of mental health, how to support a healthy mind, and to promote the importance of physical activity, social engagement, and connections with community resources that support positive mental health.  
Start and Finish will be on the Yuba College track with an 8:30am warm-up and announcements and a 9:00am start.  Breakfast will be served at 7:30am and awards at 10:00am. Same day registrations are open and available on the day of the run; however, T-Shirts are not guaranteed if registrations are on race day.

Early Packet Pickup will be available at the Yuba County Office of Education Prevention Support and Services, 1010 I street, Marysville, California, 95901.  If you are unable to make it, you may pick up your race packet in the morning from 7:30am - 8:30am at the Yuba College Track Field.

name: Miss Winkles Fast & Furriest 5k/2mi
description: Join us for our annual 5k / 2 mile race to support the pets at Miss Winkles Pet Adoption Center! Choose our competitive chip-timed 5k race for our racers who want a little bit of friendly competition, choose our non-competitive 2 mile walk great for your pets, kids, and friends, or register for our Virtual 5k where you can do your race anywhere and still get the benefits of our shirt and finisher medal!  All festivities will take place on the Clovis Trail starting at the 120 N. Clovis parking lot and the race will primarily be on paved asphalt. Dogs are permitted provided they are on a leash or strapped into a stroller or backpack.

name: Mission Hills 5K
description:
The 11th Annual Mission Hills 5K — Voted San Diego’s Best 5K!

Get ready, runners! The Mission Hills 5K returns on Saturday, March 21, 2026, at 8:00 a.m., and you won’t want to miss it. Voted “San Diego’s Best 5K” by readers of San Diego Magazine, this community favorite brings families, friends, and neighbors together. Run or walk through the streets of San Diego's historic Mission Hills neighborhood!

All proceeds benefit educational programming at Grant TK-8, helping to enrich the learning experience for every student.

Registration Details

  • Early bird registration ends December 31, 2025 — sign up early and save!
  • Online registration closes March 18, 2026.
  • Register by March 7, 2026 to guarantee your official Mission Hills 5K t-shirt!

Please note that for safety reasons, pets, roller skates, and other wheeled devices are not allowed on the 5K course. Jogging strollers and race wheelchairs / Duos are permitted.

After you cross the finish line, stick around for our Finish Line Fun Fair in Pioneer Park, featuring family activities, community booths, and post-race celebrations.

Let’s make the 11th Annual Mission Hills 5K the best one yet — see you at the starting line!

Mission Hills 5K

name: MISSION INN RUN
description:
The 49th Annual Mission Inn Run returns to downtown Riverside on October 18, 2026! 

The Mission Inn Run, a signature Riverside event and key fundraiser for the Mission Inn Foundation, has been a Southern California Tradition for nearly 50 years. This historic race has traditionally launched in downtown Riverside, winding through the parks, landmarks and historic neighborhoods of our town. Proceeds support the nonprofit Mission Inn Foundation and Museum.

Races include the 5K, 10K and ½ Marathon with dedicated 5K Walk (perfect for the kids and pups!) Everyone from competitors to casual strollers are invited to join us!

•      All participants will receive the 2026 limited edition dry-tech T-shirt 
•      All participants will receive 2026 finisher medal 
•      All participants will receive limited edition non-woven reusable tote bag
·      Walk & Wag partnership with Mary S. Roberts Pet Adoption Center w/ pet bandana, pop-up dog park and more
•      All teams of 5 or more receive a $5/discount per member
•      Earn up to $20 off your registration by referring 5 or more friends (codes available after registration)

The Mission Inn Run, a Riverside tradition since 1977, is the primary fundraiser for the Mission Inn Foundation, a 501c3 non-profit museum organization. The Mission Inn Run is the trademarked intellectual property of the Mission Inn Foundation.  There is no affiliation with the Historic Mission Inn Corporation, nor does the Historic Mission Inn Corporation benefit from or support this event.  All funds raised go to the Mission Inn Foundation, a 501c3 non-profit organization.  For more information about the Mission Inn Foundation, please visit www.missioninnmuseum.org

name: Mojave Half Marathon
description:
This is a "Closed Gate" event and Military Installation access is a requirement.

Marine Corps Community Services (MCCS) is proud to announce the Mojave Half Marathon, taking place on Saturday, 14 March 2026 aboard Marine Corps Air Ground Combat Center.  Military Installation access is required.  

This half marathon will challenge runners to test their stamina, determination, and grit. Whether you are a seasoned distance runner or preparing for your next major fitness goal, now is the time to start training!

Registration fee:  $50

ATTENTION:  Please be aware.  There is a cut off time for this event.  Runners must accomplish the 7-mile mark within 2 hours, or they will be removed from participating.  The overall limit for the half marathon is 4 hours.  Runners who do not meet these cut off times will be pulled from the event.  This is standard and due to the requirement to reopen closed roads to the MCAGCC community.

REMINDER:  This is a "Closed Gate" event and Military Installation access is a requirement.

For questions or additional information, please contact MCCS Athletics at 760.830.6857 or email 29athletics@usmc-mccs.org.

description:

Montara Mountain features the only undisturbed Coastal Mountain Habitat found over 100 miles of coastline. Experience groves of Huckleberry, Honeysuckle, Lilac, Chinquapin and Manzanita, with beautiful views of the Pacific Coast as you climb.

name: Morgan Hill AAUW Wildflower Run
description:
The AAUW Wildflower Run raises money for scholarships and leadership programs for women & girls and community grants. (For information about our organization, go to www.aauwmh.org.) 10K Run, 5K Run, 5K Walk, and 5K stroller/baby jogger category are all on country roads with chip timing. The Kids' 2K  Run (ages 5-11) and our "all inclusive, non-competitive" 2K Fun Run/Walk (for ages 2-102) are both on a school track.  
Our new 5K and 10K routes are in a country setting surrounding Morgan Hill with flat terrain on paved roads. Flat and fast for runners wanting to improve their personal record times. Water available at start and finish of race, with multiple water stops along the routes. Strollers are welcome everywhere except on the school's track. No pets permitted on school grounds.
NOTE: The event is an "open course", so you will need to stay to the side of the road as some vehicular traffic is expected.
Register early to be guaranteed a unique, 2026 T-shirt in your size.  In addition to your limited edition T-shirt, we offer bonus baby-T's for the stroller event (while supplies last) and themed medals for youth. See wildflowerrun.org for details.
We offer discount pricing for groups, as follows:
  • groups of 10 or more (request a $5 off per person “coupon code” for your group in advance of registering; enter the code at checkout).
  • school teams (within boundaries of MHUSD) – if your principal has agreed to sign up your school for the "school competition", your school will have a unique school "coupon code" for $5 off any race for student/family/staff; enter the code at checkout.

name: Mother's Day Run
description:
The Greater Madera Kiwanis Club presents the 22nd annual Mother’s Day Run on  Sunday May 12th at Woodward Park, Fresno Ca. We added a 5k run to our traditional 10k run and 2 mile run/walk along with the kids dash which is less than a 1/4 mile. Adult registration will earn you a coveted Mother’s Day run shirt. Youth pricing does not include a shirt, but can be added for an additional $5.  Complete an event to earn a finishers medal. Place in the top three of your age group, get an age group award.

The race will be in the Woodward Park North East 12 Acres, (first parking lot when you enter from the Friant/Ft Washington entrance)  

10k, 5k, 2Mi and kids race start times will be announced soon.

The 10k is a 20-point CENTRAL VALLEY RUNNER OF THE YEAR event

name: Mother's Day Run & Walk
description:
Celebrate Mom while making a difference!


Join the 42nd Annual Mother’s Day Run & Walk, benefiting Pajaro Valley Shelter Services, and enjoy a beautiful morning on the scenic trails of Pinto Lake County Park.

 

There’s something for everyone, including a 1K Kids Fun Run, a 5K run or walk, and a 10K run. Bring the whole family, honor the women who inspire you, and support vital services for families experiencing homelessness.

Move with purpose. Celebrate with heart.

name: Mother’s Day Weekend Autism Awareness 5k -10K  Run/Walk
description:
Celebrating Togetherness this Mother's Day Weekend 

Join us for a fun and challenging 5K - 10K Run/Walk at Hansen Dam, or wherever you are, to show your support for children and adults on the autism spectrum. Your fundraising efforts will empower our work to promote a more inclusive world for individuals with autism, in support of Assistant programs for people & children with developmental disabilities (including but not limited to Autism, Behavior disorders and Down Syndrome). 

While the last year was really challenging for all of us, our commitment to the autism community remained unwavering. 1 in 54 children and 1 in 45 adults in the U.S. are on the autism spectrum. The autism community has so many unique sets of strengths, challenges, goals, accomplishments and needs.

Registration Perks:

All participants receive

Custom PACE Finisher Medals
PACE Race Day T-Shirt
Reusable Swag Bag with goodies  
Post-Race Munchies
Chip timing for in-person runners

Prizes include:

Top Finishers: Celebrate your achievements! Awards for the top 3 male and  3 female finishers in both 5K and 10K categories.

In Person Race day registration is available until 7:30am, May 9, 2026. (Note: Swag bag may be delayed)

If Running Virtual Anywhere! Your local safe running route (since your run is virtual you can run anywhere you like, please follow all local laws).

Virtual Race registration is available until May 31 2026 11:59 PM.

When: May 9, 2026 (Saturday)

Start Time: 

10K  8:00 AM 
 5K   8:15 AM
 1K  10:00 AM 

Event Location: Woodley Park Section 1 6350 Woodley Avenue Van Nuys Ca 91436

In Person Race day registration is available until 7:30am, May 9, 2026. (Note: Price increase $20 Day of event & Swag bag may be delayed)

Virtual Fun: Even if you can't join us in person, you can still be a Shero! Participate virtually and get a race bib and finisher medal mailed to you. Virtual Race registration is available until May 31 2026 11:59 PM.

EVERYONE IS A WINNER!
Come Enjoy a FUN time with Family & Friends!!

Live DJ, Coach Kody, FREE Bounce House, FREE kid fun art station, Food Truck, and More...!

PACE RUN for a Cause is.a 501(C)(3) NON-PROFIT ORGANIZATION BASED IN SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA. TAX ID 87-1848548

Share the event with your friends and family! Spread the word and help us build a brighter future for individuals on the autism spectrum.

name: Mountains 2 Beach Marathon and Half
description: Uniquely situated and completely surrounded by beautiful mountains, the city of Ojai holds the start of the Mountains 2 Beach Marathon while the half starts closer to the beach. This point to point race winds through the Ventura River Valley as it makes its way to the pristine beaches of the last great surf town in California, Ventura. Runners will love the gradual downhill nature of the race, which is prime to make you faster but not hurt the knees, and the amazing weather of the area. After a final tour of beach front Ventura, runners and their families are treated to a finish line party only steps away from the surf and the shops and restaurants of Historic Downtown Ventura. As a certified Boston Qualifier, the courses, the race and the surrounding communities make for the perfect destination marathon and half.

name: Move4U 5K Run/Walk for Parkinson's, Dystonia, & Movement Disorders
description:
The Parkinson's and Movement Disorder Foundation (PMDF) and the National Spasmodic Torticollis Association are hosting the MOVE4U 5K Walk/Run Fundraiser at Mile Square Park in Fountain Valley, California. The proceeds will empower the PMDF and the NSTA to significantly further their mission of advancing crucial research into the causes, treatments, and cures of Parkinson's disease and other movement disorders like dystonia. Your support will improve the lives of patients and also play a vital role in raising awareness.

REGISTRATION INCLUDES

– Free hat provided for attendees

– Raffle Prizes

– Buffet of Sandwiches and Cookies from Katella Deli in Los Alamitos

– Water

 

5K Run Top Three Prizes

1st place prize $300

2nd place prize $ $200

name: Music in May Pop-Up Concerts
description:
What better way to launch Music in May’s 19th season than by launching a new festival event hosted by the legendary Bookshop Santa Cruz? Think of these string orchestra community pop-up concerts as an impromptu classical “reading party” among new and old friends. There will be 2 performances on May 27, 2026. The first pop-up concert is from 11:00-11:30 a.m. and the second is from 12:00-12:30 p.m. featuring members of the Ensemble San Francisco String Quartet alongside local talent, each with a distinct program for strings and a different 19-member ensemble of musicians. A 30-minute “intermission” provides an opportunity for musicians and friends to connect and engage with one another.

It’s a reading party [no conductor], so there will be no ensemble rehearsal but individual advance preparation will surely make this a memorable “on stage” adventure! 

All of the music and concert notes are posted under the tab REPERTOIRE. There are parts for Violin 1 and 2, Viola, Cello and Bass. That will allow you to review the music and determine whether or not you are comfortable with the selections.   In total we will be selecting musicians as follows for each concert:

  • 1st Violin  - 5
  • 2nd Violin - 3
  • Viola -  3
  • Cello   - 3
  • Bass - 1

There is no cost to participate other than your time.  So review the musical scores posted above and decide if you have the time and skill to devote to the repertoire.  Remember - this is supposed to be fun and community "pop-ups" are almost never "perfect". 

If you are interested in participating please complete the registration form with your personal contact information and instrument selection. Selection of participants for each concert will be via lottery for each instrument.  

Sign up by April 5th and we will notify selected players by mid-April. Registering for the concert does not guarantee participation. You will be notified of the lottery results to guarantee your participation.

name: NAHC - Running Is My High 2026
description:
Native American Health Center (NAHC) is excited to announce our 25th Running Is My High (RIMH) 5k/10k Fun Run and Walk themed "25 Years in Motion" on Saturday, June 6th, 2026 at the Fairy Land area of Lake Merritt; 699 Bellevue Ave., Oakland, CA 94610.  

NAHC created Running is My High to engage community from all walks of life in an event promoting physical, mental, and cultural health. Annually, our 5K/10K draws over 400 runners and walkers from across the San Francisco Bay Area and beyond. This special event will feature programming that honors Community Health and Native American cultural practices; includes guest speakers; and features outreach tables to connect our community to helpful resources.

Online registration closes on June 5th and costs $30 for adults and $15 for youth, in-person registration on the day of the event (6/6) is $35 for adults and $20 for youth. 

We will see you at the starting line!

name: Nail the Rail Half Marathon, 10K & 5K
description:
Join us for a stroll along the Sacramento Rail Trail.  A converted Southern Pacific Railroad track that starts at the base of Shasta Dam and runs for over 11 miles.

Enjoy a the view along the Sacramento River/Keswick Lake in the cool of the morning.  Trail is very flat and fast.

Field is limited to 400.

Races include a half marathon, 10K and 5K.

Finisher awards to Half marathoners.  Awards 3 deep in age groups, plus overall awards.

Start/Finish will be from the Chappie OHV area at the base of Shasta Dam.  Once you cross Shasta Dam you will follow the road down to the OHV area.

Race day registration and packet pickup opens at 7am at OHV area.

Packet pickup and registration on Friday the 25th from 11am to 3pm at Redding Fleet Feet Store at 1376 Hilltop Dr.

Start times:

Half Marathon - 8am

5K & 10K - 8:15am

Cutoff time of 3hrs 15 minutes for half-marathon.

name: Napa MPS Race for a Cure
description:
2026 Napa Race for a Cure 5K Run and 1 Mile Walk

The National MPS Society will host a timed 5K run and 1 mile walk, beginning at 10:30 AM on Sunday, April 26.  The 1 mile walk will begin at 10:40 AM.  Packet pickup and day of registration will open at 8:30 AM.  A picnic for attendees and volunteers will be held after the race!

This event is open to individuals of all ages and abilities. Once you register, either as an individual or as part of a team, you are set. We would love to see the posts of pictures participants on their 5K route. This is completely optional – but since our goal is to bring awareness to MPS and ML, we want to do just that. And by using #MPSAwareness on your social media posts, we will be able to keep up with the fun.

Not able to join in person? Participate virtually!

It is just like any other 5K, except there is no official race location.  You get to choose where, with whom, and even how you want to complete the 5K.  by participating virtually, you can run the 5K at any time leading up to April 26th.  It can even be done in increments, keep track of your distance until you hit the 5K!

Sponsorship Levels

Platinum Corporate Sponsorship - $2,000 (Platinum Sponsorship includes corporate name and logo on back of t-shirt, website recognition, banner at the event and up to 25 participants)
Gold Corporate Sponsorship - $1,500 (Gold Sponsorship includes corporate name and logo on back of t-shirt, website recognition, small sign at the event and up to 20 participants)
Team Sponsorship Level 1 - $500 (Team Level 1 sponsorship includes corporate name and logo on back of t-shirt, website recognition, and up to 5 participants)
Team Sponsorship Level 2 - $300 (Team Level 2 sponsorship includes corporate name and logo on back of t-shirt, website recognition, and up to 3 participants)
Please reach out to Angela Guajardo at angela@mpssociety.org or 956-207-7980 if you are interested in sponsoring the event.

Information on T-Shirts

In-person runners: Shirts guaranteed for participants who register before March 27th!
Virtual runners: Register by March 27th to receive your shirt in time!

Start your Team Fundraiser!

  • At the top, hover over "Donate"
  • Select "become a fundraiser"
  • Create your team page - Choose your photo, team name, bio and fundraising goal!
  • Share the link for people to donate directly to your fundraiser!
  • You can do this before or after you register

Race Details

8:30 AM: Onsite registration and packet pick-up
10:30 AM: 5K Run
10:45 AM: 1 Mile Walk
11:45 AM: Awards
12:00 PM: Family Picnic

Race Contact Info

If you have any questions about this race, please contact the race director at angela@mpssociety.org

Want to volunteer?

Please fill out this form and we will be in touch! Volunteer Form

Lunch is included in the costs. Come out and enjoy a family day with a chance to win some fantastic items! The family day will include face painting, photo booth, caricature artist and more!  

 

A BIG THANK YOU to our Sponsors!!

name: National Chocolate Day: Run for Chocolates 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🍫🏃‍♀️ Ready, Set, Chocolate! 🏃‍♂️🍫
Join Us for the Sweetest Run of the Year – The Chocolate Run!
Lace up your running shoes and bring your sweet tooth—because this isn’t your average race.
It’s a deliciously fun event for all ages and fitness levels!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

🍫🏃‍♀️ Ready, Set, Chocolate! 🏃‍♂️🍫
Join Us for the Sweetest Run of the Year – The Chocolate Run!
Lace up your running shoes and bring your sweet tooth—because this isn’t your average race.
It’s a deliciously fun event for all ages and fitness levels!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Navy Ten-Miler Presented by USAA
description:
Run with Honor. Endure with Courage. Finish with Commitment.

The Navy Ten-Miler Presented by USAA brings together athletes, service members, veterans, and civilians to honor the Navy’s core values of Honor, Courage, and Commitment. Whether you're a seasoned runner or searching for your next challenge, this is your call to RUN NAVY.

Navy Races are more than a finish line. They celebrate the strength, resilience, and unity of our community. Proceeds benefit Navy Morale, Welfare, and Recreation (MWR) programs that enhance the lives of Sailors and their families.

Key Benefits:

  • Support Navy personnel and families
  • Run along San Diego Bay’s iconic waterfront
  • Experience naval history and patriotism
  • Connect with the veteran and civilian running community
  • Be part of a race with purpose and impact

Who Can Participate?

Everyone is welcome. Whether you are active duty, a veteran, a military family member, or a civilian who wants to support a meaningful cause, Navy Race events are open to all fitness levels.

Join a race with purpose.

#RunNAVY

name: Nelson Family Vineyards Wine Run 5k
description:
Like Running or Walking?  Love Wine?  This race is for you! 

Join us on Saturday, April 18, 2026 at 11:00am for a super fun annual event that features the amazing hospitality and scenery of Nelson Family Vineyards! For 70 years the Nelson family has farmed the land they live on, with the traditions of farming passed on to four generations. Through many seasons of tending and harvest, Nelson Family Vineyards has embraced the truth that great wines are born in the vineyard. So, whether you are looking to run, walk or just enjoy the wine this race is a sure thing for a great time and an incredible experience! This race is timed and scored by J3 Timing.  Results will be posted at www.J3Timing.com. 

Registration Includes:

  • T-shirt:  Super Soft Ring Spun Cotton t-shirt included! 
  • Wine Glass: Shatterproof, Collapsible, and Portable!
  • Finisher Medal: Doubles as a Wine Stopper!
  • Race Bib: Chip timed 5k run/walk
  • Results Posted Online
  • ...and of course, a pour of wine!

name: New Haven Fun Run
description:
New Haven Schools Foundation (NHSF) Fun Run -- raising funds for education enhancement and scholarships for New Haven Unified School District (Union City/South Hayward) public school students.  5K / Race, chip-timed, designed for serious runners, walkers, fitness-minded people, outdoor enthusiasts, and just for FUN!!! In addition to serious runners, the 5K is historically popular with walkers, and those with baby strollers. No dogs this year, due to proximity to New Haven Day. Serious runner are positioned near the starting line, ahead of more casual participants.

 

Register now!  Early bird registration ends April 12th.  T-shirt and swag bag guaranteed with early bird 5K registration, and t-shirt included with early bird Kid Race registration.  Giveaways are not guaranteed after April 12th.

name: NIGHT NATION RUN - ORANGE COUNTY
description:
The Night Nation Run is the World’s first Running Music Festival the ultimate blend of a Music Festival and a Fun Run. Experience a music filled course with Live DJs, Bubble Zones, Light Shows, Neon, and Black Lights! Cross the finish line into an Epic Main Stage After Party featuring Top Headliner DJs!

To date, over 2 MILLION people across the World have become a member of the Night Nation™!

The Night Nation Run is proud to support Stand Up To Cancer (SU2C) as their official charity. Stand Up To Cancer (SU2C) is a groundbreaking initiative created to accelerate innovative cancer research that will get new therapies to patients quickly and save lives now.

Celebrate Life. Celebrate friends and family. Celebrate Music. Run with the Night Nation™!

  • Night Nation T-shirt (Premium & VIP Registration)
  • Race Bib
  • Glow Necklace
  • Free Giveaways
  • Pre and Post Race Concerts
  • Admission into the Night Nation after party
  • The best night of your life!

name: Nixon 5K for Title IX
description:
Celebrate the women and girls in your life in this family-friendly event to commemorate the achievements of Title IX, the landmark equality legislation signed by President Nixon fifty-three years ago.

Bring your family, friends, sports teams and community groups to the NIXON 5K FOR TITLE IX and run (or walk) this moderate course following Yorba Linda’s El Cajon Trail. Athletes are encouraged to wear their favorite team gear supporting female sports! This is accessible for runners of all levels; strollers are welcome and dogs are allowed. Following the race, guests are invited to stop by the vendor fair in the Library parking lot!

name: No Foolin' Foot Race
description:
Explore San Carlos' outstanding trail system as a runner in the fourth annual No Foolin' Foot Race! There's something for everyone with four challenging events through Big Canyon, Eaton and Pulgas Ridge. 

  • 1K (~350ft of climbing) - Perfect for adventurous kids age 5-10

  • 5k (~530ft of climbing)

  • 10k (~1,500ft of climbing)

  • Long Course NEW this year! (15K with ~2,300ft of climbing)

Early bird pricing available through March 18, 2026.

Consider yourself warned: This race is no joke! Our courses are technical, grueling and loads of fun.

We will be hosting course previews on Sunday, March 8 (5K and 10K routes) and Saturday, March 28 (5K and 15K routes) in partnership with A Runner's Mind and Brooks. RSVP on Strava, and join our Strava Club for updates.

Start and Finish Festival at Crestview Park. Professional timing; Tech-Ts and free runner photos for all participants; Awards in multiple categories. 

All proceeds benefit maintenance and improvement of San Carlos open space trails. 

Presented by Kaiser Permanente in partnership with the Parks and Recreation Foundation of San Carlos and the City of San Carlos.

name: Novato Lucky Run 2026
description:
This year’s annual Lucky Run will include a 5K walk/run option and a 10K run option, held on the beautiful Hamilton Bay Trail in Novato. 5K and 10K runners will receive official finish times that they may share with coaches or use for other purposes.

Early registration includes a race day T-shirt. Don't miss out…register today!! Don't forget to add your shirt-size at check out. 

Late registration on race day is possible from 08:00 am - 08:30 am. Shirts may be available for purchase on race day, though not guaranteed.

This is a great family-friendly community event benefitting Novato High School Safe & Sober Grad Night and anyone can register to participate. Awards and giveaways will take place after the event. Top three finishers of each division will win a prize. Special drawings for all participants. Make sure to stay after the race to claim your prize. You must be present to win.

name: Noyo Headlands Race
description:
Join us on Saturday, August 8, 2026 for the 10th annual Noyo Headlands Race. This year we'll have a half marathon, 10K run, 5k run, 5k fun walk, and half-mile kids' run along the stunning coastal trail in Fort Bragg, CA. Enjoy some of the most remarkable scenery Northern California has to offer and have a great time running with your friends! The oceanfront trail consists of asphalt and soft track, is fairly flat, well maintained, and commonly used by runners year-round.

This race benefits Mendocino Land Trust in its mission to conserve and restore habitat, scenic areas and working lands while also providing public access to beautiful places in and around Mendocino County.

name: NURSES ROCK Run/Walk
description:
Will you run and be their heroes by joining the Nurses Rock Run-Walk 5K-10k & BONNIE CHALLENGE?

We have all learned how incredibly valuable our nurses are to our health care system.  Help us give back to those aspiring nurses through supporting the Bonnie Fang Foundation in our search to support those to keep us alive.  In 2026 we will be offering the live experience and a virtual run to provide the perfect opportunity and flexibility to participate safely while interacting with our nursing and running community live & online to support a great cause.  

Sign up TODAY and join us as we culminate your work on running and our audience of future nurses.

name: Nutty Cutters 5k
description:
Welcome to the 2nd annual NUTTY CUTTERS 5K. 

This may be the nuttiest 5k race ever. We will have a 5k course set up at Marie Kerr Park consisting of two laps around the park. On each lap, however, there will be two places where you may randomly sent on a shortcut and two places where you might randomly be sent on a long cut - think "Chutes and Ladders!"  Come prepared for a little extra distance just in case.

You will have the option to choose the "NO CUTTING" option. If you choose this you will not be sent on any short cuts or long cuts. You will run exactly 5k. Note however, that since most runners will be doing long cuts and short cuts, all the prizes given are random.

All participants will receive a free shirt until supplies run out. Sizes will be chosen at registration.

$100 GRAND PRIZE!! This will be given to a randomly selected race finisher. Last year it was the runner who finished 96th place!

There will be other PRIZES as well, so you just might get lucky! or unlucky! Either way this will be lots of fun!

name: Oakland Tech 5km/1 mile Race/Run/Walk Fundraiser
description:
Support Oakland Tech Students and Programs
Join us for a 5K trail race or 1-mile fun run/walk in beautiful Joaquin Miller Park on November 2, 2025 (end of Daylight savings time.) The course winds through towering redwoods and offers both a scenic stroll for casual participants and a challenging route for competitive runners.

This event is a fundraiser for the Oakland Tech PTSA, which provides invaluable funding for student programs and activities. Every dollar makes a difference for our students. The PTSA supports the Oakland Tech Cross Country team by covering costs for meet entry fees, training equipment, nutrition, and travel — all essential for helping our runners perform at their best.

Oakland Tech Cross Country athletes have a proud tradition of success, with varsity cross country teams winning the Oakland League Championship for three of the past four years. Your participation helps continue this tradition of excellence.

Sign up for the race or make a tax-deductible donation to show your support for Oakland Tech students.

Bib pick-up: Saturday, October 31, 2pm-4pm @ Transports or Sunday, November 1rd, 8:30am @Joaquin Miller Meadow

Date: November 1, 2026

  • 1 mile Fun Run/Walk Race Start: 9:00 am
  • 5 km Trail Race Start: 9:30 am

Can't run but want to support us? Donations are tax-deductible. Tax ID: 94-6174624

name: Oceanside Pier Swim  - 2026
description:
The 97th Annual Oceanside Pier Swim is set to take place on September 7, 2026, continuing a cherished tradition that began in 1929. Swimmers of all ages are invited to participate in this one-mile swim around the iconic Oceanside Pier, the longest wooden pier on the West Coast. 

Hosted by local organization, Oceanside Masters Swim Club, the club hopes to grow Oceanside Aquatics and community from youth to adulthood. Proceeds from the swim will benefit youth swim programs, high school swim teams, adult swim teams and our local first responders.

name: Oh! The Places You'll Run – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Congratulations, today is your day, you're off to grab miles, you're off and away! This weekend we run in honor of Read Across America Day!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Friday
4-6:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)
2100 N Bellflower Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90815

Saturday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens 
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners and 10-milers only, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located along the course. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Old Zoo Half Marathon
description:
Join us for the 2nd annual Old Zoo Half Marathon! This event starts and ends at the Old Los Angeles Zoo area and features a half marathon and a 12K course. Both courses are relatively flat and lead you through scenic trails. Grab your running gear and join us!
 
This year's commemorative animal medal will be an elephant . Join us and collect your unique finisher medal!


Given that last year's registration sold out completely, we strongly encourage you to register early to secure your spot, as space is limited.

name: Om Run
description: Om Run was launched in 2009 to bring the Bay Area Chinmaya Mission Family together. It is a fun filled day of outdoor activities for people of all ages. Om Run hosts more than 2000 people annually. It is the largest community building event organized by CMSJ.  Om Run has evolved into a unique running event, in that, the focus is on community building with attractions such as pony rides, inflatable games, music and food  along with a 5K, 10K and a 1/2 marathon race. Beautiful Vasona Park has breathtaking vistas and has hosted Om Run for the past several years.

name: OneLegacy Donate Life Run/Walk 2026
description:
OneLegacy Donate Life Run Walk is back!

 

Join us for our 2026 OneLegacy Donate Life Run Walk  to run or walk with your team and celebrate the power of organ, eye and tissue donation. 
Founded in 2003 by local organizers Craig and Kathleen Hostert of Fullerton, the annual OneLegacy Donate Life Run/Walk is the largest event of its kind in the nation. The event features an inspiring opening ceremony, competitive 5K run and healthy 5K/1K walk, followed by a Family Festival with food vendors, live entertainment, special activities for children and a raffle drawing.
A non-competitive 5K/1K Run/Walk to educate and inspire the community about organ, eye, and tissue donation with proceeds benefiting the OneLegacy Foundation.
LOCATION: Azusa Pacific University, 701 E Foothill Blvd, Azusa, California 91702
DATE: April 25, 2026
EVENT SCHEDULE:                 
  • 7:00 am Registration 
  • 8:30 am Opening Ceremony
  • 9:20 am 5K Run/Walk starts
  • 9:40 am 1K Run/Walk starts
  • 7:00 am to 12:00 pm Family Festival with food, opportunity prizes, children's activities, vendors and more!
Please practice social distancing as best you can; we want everyone to be safe and healthy.

name: Operation Megaphone
description: Operation Megaphone, also known as "OMP", is an annual worldwide event designed to connect military teens from around the world to discuss key issues that affect military teens, promote communication across all military services, and provide opportunities for teens to give back to their communities. Teen led and adult supported, OMP is a great opportunity for your teens! A fun filled night of games, activities, movies, sports, dinner and more!

name: OPTIMIST CLUB OF CORONADO SUMMER FITNESS CHALLENGE
description:
HAVE FUN, BE FIT, HELP YOUTH!

From July 4th through Labor Day, participants will log the amount of time each selected activity is performed, from a large list of activities available, via a Submit Activity web page -- biking, walking, running, tennis, swimming, and more.   The goals are to enhance physical fitness, build community spirit, have fun, and support the youth of Coronado.  Hours-per-week targets are:  Bronze: 1 hr; Silver: 2 hr; Gold: 3 hr; Diamond: 4 hr.   An awards celebration will be held the Saturday morning after Labor Day, 9AM at Spreckels Park. Coronado, CA    Teams encouraged.  Perfect event for dispersed family participation. Hosted by the Optimist Club of Coronado, CA.

description:
This event is a fun-family event with a 5K Run/Walk, Health & Safety Expo, Food & Entertainment, and fund-raising opportunity to help support programs and direct services at the Crime Survivors Resource Center. Awareness. Prevention. Advocacy. Healing. 

Awards

Top Male/Female in the following age group. 12-UNDER, 13-19, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, and 60+              

Contact: info@superherorunwalk.org | (844) 853-HOPE | (949) 872-7895 | www.superherorunwalk.org

Photos from previous years event: Click Here

WHAT IS A VIRTUAL RACE REGISTRATION? A virtual race is a race that can be run (or walked) from any location you choose. You can run, jog, or walk on the road, on the trail, on the treadmill, at the gym or on the track (or even at another race). You get to run your own race, at your own pace, and time it yourself. Run on your own, or with friends! Your race bib, shirt and medal will be shipped directly to you. And your registration fee and fundraising efforts will go directly to help support victims of crime through our survivors hope fund. Register Today!

Event Fee

$40.00 Pre Registration | $50.00 Day of Registration -- Includes Shirt, Medal, Goody Bag to First 500 Pre Registered, Food ,Drinks, and Entertainment

description:
For 47 years, the Palisades Will Rogers 5 & 10K Run and Kids’ Fun Run has been a centerpiece of the Palisades’ 4th of July celebration.   The Palisades Will Rogers 5&10K Run Foundation and it’s Presenting Sponsor, Providence Saint John’s Health Center, is doing everything they can to support the recovery effort in the aftermath of the unprecedented fire.   Although the fire destruction and residues have made it unfeasible to hold the event at our traditional location, we are holding a 5K Run and Kids’ Fun Run at Venice Beach this year.  We look forward to neighbors and friends joining us to celebrate all that makes the Palisades such a special community, and enjoy a healthful start to the 4th of July in a safe environment.

Race proceeds this year will go toward rebuilding the Pacific Palisades Park & Community Center, as the Palisades centerpiece for neighbors of all ages to gather and recreate together.  The Palisades Will Rogers 5&10K Run Foundation is also accepting direct donations toward that effort.  Donations may be made through the Foundation’s website at RunSignUp.com, or by mail to Palisades Will Rogers 5&10K Run Foundation, P.O. Box 601, Pacific Palisades, CA 90272.

Sign up now…See you on the 4th of July!

Race Committee

name: Pallium India Bay Area Walkathon 2026
description:
Walk With Purpose. Walk With Compassion.

Pallium India and VANITHA are bringing you the second annual Pallium India Bay Area Walkathon, a community‑driven event dedicated to raising awareness about palliative care and supporting Pallium India’s mission to provide compassionate care to patients and families facing serious illness.

After a meaningful and energizing inaugural Pallium India Bay Area Walkathon in 2025, we’re excited to return with an even bigger and more impactful event in 2026-bringing together supporters, volunteers, families, and organizations who believe in care with dignity.

Tip

Registration opens on January 31, 2026, with an early‑bird price of $19.99. Prices increase to $24.99 after February 22 and $29.99 after March 7, so register early to save! Please also check out the group pricing options and consider signing up with friends and family to get special discounts of up to $4 per registrant.

Race Options for All Ages & Abilities

Whether you’re a casual walker or an experienced runner, there's a perfect route for everyone:

  • 1K Fun Walk – Perfect for children, seniors, and families
  • 3K Walk – A friendly, accessible distance for all
  • 5K Walk – A great challenge for fitness enthusiasts
  • 10K Walk – For those looking to push their limits while supporting a meaningful cause
Why We Walk

Every step you take helps:

  • Increase awareness of palliative care and why it matters
  • Support Pallium India’s programs that bring comfort, dignity, and essential care
  • Empower volunteers and caregivers through training and community outreach
  • Raise funds for home‑based care, medications, counseling, and support services
Join Us

Bring your energy, your friends, and your heart.

Together, we can build a more compassionate world - one step at a time.

Learn more: https://palliumindiausa.org/, https://vanitha-ca.org/

Co‑Organizer

VANITHA – https://vanitha-ca.org/ - a volunteer‑driven nonprofit supporting communities through education and charitable service.

Our Sponsor

RFC (Relief From Cancer) – https://www.relieffromcancer.org/ - a nonprofit that raises funds and promotes awareness to support cancer prevention, treatment education, and patient assistance.

Our Community Partners

MANCA - https://mancaonline.org/ - a nonprofit founded in 1985, connecting thousands of Malayalee families across Northern California through year‑round cultural, social, and charitable programs - Onam, Christmas, picnics, cultural festivals - preserving Kerala heritage, nurturing bonds, and strengthening community.

Festival of Globe FOGSV.org - https://fogsv.com/ - a nonprofit celebrating global cultures through the “Festival of Globe” in Silicon Valley, combining film, arts, dance, cultural events, and charitable initiatives supporting youth, seniors, hunger relief, and women’s empowerment.

MoHAM - https://mohamfoundation.com/ - a nonprofit community‑service organization for Malayali families in Mountain House/Tracy, CA uniting the community through cultural, educational, charitable initiatives - promoting Malayalam, heritage, festivals, scholarships, social support.

description:
Join us for an unforgettable day of community, celebration, and inclusivity, at the Palm Springs Pride 5K Run & Walk! Whether you're a speedster or a casual stroller, this event welcomes everyone of all ages and abilities to help support our local LGBTQ+ organizations. If you're thinking about joining us, don't wait too long—spots are filling up fast! Register and secure your spot in this year's celebration of love, resilience, and community pride.
Full event details are available on https://palmspringspriderun.com/.

name: Paseo de Mariposa Trail Race
description:
Paseo de Mariposa Trail Race
 

April 19, 2026 – Mariposa, California

 

A Note from the Race Director
 

Hello everyone! My name is Nate Moore, and I’m excited to share that I’ll be directing the 2026 Paseo de Mariposa Trail Race through my company, San Joaquin Running Co.
We love supporting local community events, especially those that celebrate trail running and the unique beauty of our region. Our goal is to carry forward the traditions that make this race special, while adding the same energy and care we bring to our other events.
Through San Joaquin Running, I help organize a variety of races across the Central Valley and Sierra foothills, including the Shadow of the Giants 50K, Pincushion Hill Climb, McKenzie Preserve Half Marathon, Sycamore Island 5K/10K, and others. Each event is built on the same foundation: creating tough, fun, and memorable experiences for runners of all ages and abilities.
I’m truly honored to help guide the Paseo de Mariposa into its next chapter. Together, we’ll keep this race a family-friendly tradition that highlights the heart of Mariposa and the adventure of trail running.

 

About the Event
 

Nestled in the Sierra Nevada foothills, just outside Yosemite National Park, Mariposa is rich in history and natural beauty — the perfect setting for outdoor adventure. On Sunday, April 19, 2026, join us for the seventh annual Paseo de Mariposa Trail Run, featuring 5K and 12K courses that begin at the historic Mariposa Courthouse (built in 1851, the oldest courthouse west of the Rockies still in use).
This family-friendly community event celebrates health, wellness, and active lifestyles. In support of our mission to engage youth in outdoor activity, all children under 18 can participate in any race for free.

 

Race Distances
 

5K – Family-Friendly & Beginner-Friendly

Shortest and most accessible option.
Starts at the courthouse, with sections on paved roads, a short climb past the high school, and a dirt fire road turnaround.
Perfect for families, walkers, and those new to trail running.
 
 

12K – The Big Adventure

Longest and most challenging route.
Features steep descents, a creek crossing, and a tough single-track climb to Slaughterhouse Road and the Flume Trail.
Stunning views along rugged single-track with significant elevation gain.
No strollers permitted; youth under 13 must be accompanied by an adult.
 

Safety & Support
 

Aid stations will be positioned across all distances.
Mariposa County Search and Rescue will be on site for runner safety.
Trails include technical terrain — rocks, roots, and climbs — so please run or hike your route ahead of time if possible. Bringing a buddy is always recommended.
For everyone’s safety: no dogs are permitted on any route.
 

Why Join?
 

The Paseo de Mariposa is more than a race — it’s a celebration of community, family, and the outdoors. Whether you’re chasing a personal best, enjoying a scenic hike with friends, or introducing your kids to trail running, this event is designed for all ages and abilities.

 

✨ Mark your calendars for April 19, 2026!

We can’t wait to see you in Mariposa for an unforgettable day on the trails.

name: Pasifika Rocking The Spectrum - Community Run
description:
Join us for Pasifika Rocking the Spectrum – Community Run, a family-friendly run/walk celebrating Autism Acceptance Month, Pasifika culture, and community connection.

This event was inspired by Paxton, an autistic Pasifika child, and is Pasifika-led, but open and welcoming to everyone, all cultures, all abilities, all paces. Whether you run, walk, stroll with a stroller, or roll, you belong here.

Our goal is to create a safe, inclusive, and joyful space where neurodivergent individuals and families feel seen, supported, and celebrated. This is not about speed or competition, it’s about visibility, acceptance, and community.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 All ages welcome

🏃‍♀️Run or walk at your own pace
♿ Accessibility- and sensory-aware environment

🌺 Pasifika culture, unity, and love at the center

Come rock the spectrum with us for Paxton, for our families, and for a more inclusive community.

name: PB&J Fuel Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
Smooth vibes. Sweet energy. Bold moves. 🥜🍓


PB&J Fuel Run is all about a combo that just works. Mix your pace, spread the fun, and stick with it all the way to the finish. No stress, no expectations, just miles that feel good and a finish that feels even better. Run it your way, enjoy every step, and fuel your finish with good energy and great company. Let’s make this run unforgettable. 🏃‍♀️🏃‍♂️✨

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Peace Officer Memorial Run
description: This race was developed to honor the police officers from Stanislaus County who were killed in the line of duty. In honor of these heroes, the start line, finish line and each mile of the half marathon will be dedicated to one of the 20 fallen officers from Stanislaus County. The officers photo along with the agency they worked for and their “End of watch” date will be displayed at their mile marker.
