name: Run for Austin's Lungs
description:
Run for Austin’s Lungs is a family-friendly 5K walk/run held in honor of baby Austin, who is bravely battling chronic lung disease. Join us to celebrate his first birthday, raise awareness of his Chronic Lung disease, and support his ongoing medical care. Every step taken helps give Austin the breath of a brighter future.

The entire registration fee (minus the $4 processing fee) goes directly to Austin’s care. After you register, the site will ask if you’d like to make an additional donation—this can simply be left at $0, meaning your total charge will be $54 for race registration.

If you’d prefer to support Austin without registering for the race, you can do so by selecting the Donate button instead of Sign Up.

name: Run for Breast Cancer 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🎀 Join the Fight: Breast Cancer Run! 🎀

Lace up and make a difference at our annual Breast Cancer Run! Together, we can raise awareness and funds to support those affected by breast cancer. 

Enjoy a spirited day filled with community, inspiration, and hope. Let’s unite for a cause that touches us all and run for a future without breast cancer! Sign up now and help us make a lasting impact!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

Join Us for the Sweetest Run of the Year – The Chocolate Run!
Lace up your running shoes and bring your sweet tooth—because this isn’t your average race.
It’s a deliciously fun event for all ages and fitness levels!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

🍩 Join the Donut Run! 🏃‍♂️

Get ready for a sweet race! Gather your friends and lace up for our Donut Run, where you’ll run a beautiful course and be greeted at the Finish Line with... donuts🍩! Enjoy a fun-filled day of running, laughter, and Community. 

Don’t miss out on the chance to indulge in your favorite donuts while making unforgettable memories. 

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

Get ready for a sweet race! Gather your friends and lace up for our Donut Run, where you’ll run a beautiful course and be greeted at the Finish Line with... donuts🍩! Enjoy a fun-filled day of running, laughter, and Community. 

Don’t miss out on the chance to indulge in your favorite donuts while making unforgettable memories. 

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: RUN FOR FREEDOM
description:
Join the Movement and break some chains. This is more than just a race—it's a chance to make a lasting impact in the fight against human trafficking.

Lace up for something bigger than a finish line.
Whether you're running, walking, or cheering from the sidelines, the EDEN 5K/10K is more than a race—it's a movement. The Run for Freedom helps raise funds and awareness to support anti-trafficking organizations. Your participation fuels change, provides resources, and empowers those on the frontlines to continue to bring hope to survivors.

Tentative schedule of the day

6:00-7:00 a.m. Vendor set-up

7:00-8:30 a.m. Registration/packet pick up

8:15 a.m. Warm Up

8:30 a.m. Speakers

9:00 am 5K/10k Run/Walk

11:00-11:30 Post race speaker program

7 a.m.-12.30 p.m. Vendor Expo & Entertainment

Scenic Lakeside 5k Course

Our 5K course takes you along a beautiful lakeside road at Bonelli Regional Park, with views of sparkling Puddingstone Lake and rolling hills all around. The route features a mix of flat stretches and a few gentle inclines to keep things fun and challenging.

As you run, you’ll be surrounded by mountain backdrops, lush greenery, and open skies—perfect for an energizing morning on the move. Bonelli Park is a favorite spot for local runners, cyclists, and nature lovers, and you’ll see why: the course combines scenic beauty with a welcoming, race-day atmosphere.

Whether you’re walking, jogging, or aiming for a personal record, this course offers a little bit of everything—lake views, shady sections, rolling terrain, and plenty of inspiration.

Scenic Lakeside 10k Course

Our 10K course begins on the same scenic lakeside road as the 5K, letting you take in the sparkling waters of Puddingstone Lake and the mountain views that make Bonelli Park so special.

At the halfway point, the course branches off to bring you onto park trails and rolling hills, adding a little more adventure and challenge. You’ll experience a blend of paved paths, natural terrain, and inclines that keep things exciting while still being very runnable.

With the combination of lake views, shaded sections, open trails, and mountain backdrops, the 10K is a rewarding course for both seasoned runners and those looking to push themselves a bit further.

Come ready for a mix of beauty and challenge—the 10K at Bonelli Park offers an unforgettable run surrounded by nature.

 

Registration Includes:
Race bib
Event shirt
Finisher’s medal

 

RAIN OR SHINE and NO REFUNDS

name: RUN FOR RIO 5k
description:
The 2026 RUN FOR RIO 5k (3.1 miles) walk/run & Kids 1k (for 10 & under) is a fun community event for the entire family! 

The event will be at Seascape Park (rain or shine!) and we will also have a 'virtual' option for those who don't live in town or would prefer to do it on their own. Sign up a family of 4 or 5 for the 5k and receive discount!

 

Our Presenting Sponsor this year is UBS Financial Services!

 

This event promotes good health & wellness, while also raising funds for Rio Del Mar Elementary School.

The race is hosted by the Rio Del Mar Parent Alliance in support of our amazing students and teachers!

Take advantage of our early bird pricing through Feb 28!

 

Fleet Feet gift cards & Rio gear will be awarded to the top 5 finishers (male/female) in both the 1k and 5k! 

All participants will get a Fleet Feet coupon & we're giving ALL proceeds right back to Rio Del Mar Elementary school. 

Martinelli's apple juice, Pacific Cookie Co cookies & a finishers ribbon will also be waiting for you at the finish line!

Thank you so much for your support & we hope to see you out there!

name: Run for Roots: Heard It Through the Grapevine
description:
Building Community Together

🍇 Heard It Through the Grapevine… Fresno Is Running Like a Raisin! 🍇

Highway City Community Development (HCCD) invites you to the 2nd Annual Run for Roots 5K – “Heard It Through the Grapevine” Edition, where runners, walkers, families, and costumed raisins come together to celebrate West Fresno’s community, culture, and agricultural legacy.

This year’s race honors our area’s deep roots in agriculture—and a fun piece of Fresno history. Participants are encouraged to dress as raisins or “Raisin Eaters,” inspired by Fresno’s first professional baseball team from 1906. Set against the iconic vineyards of Kearney Park, this run is playful, meaningful, and uniquely Fresno.

Whether you’re chasing a personal best, walking with friends, or racing in full raisin costume, Run for Roots is about more than the finish line—it’s about celebrating who we are and where we come from.

Why We Run (It’s Bigger Than the Finish Line)

Since 1998, HCCD has been planting seeds of opportunity and cultivating resident leadership right here in West Fresno and the West of 99 / Central Unified area.

In 2025 alone, HCCD:

  • Served 10,000+ community members through classes, workshops, outreach and community events
  • Supported nearly 1,000 families during moments of crisis
  • Expanded access to food assistance, care navigation, education, housing advocacy, health resources, arts & culture, and community development

Your participation helps sustain a place where community, culture, agriculture, and families can grow—together.

*Note the race will occur rain or shine.

name: RUN FOR THE HEALTH OF IT
description:
REGISTRATION OPENS AT 6:45 AM 

LINE-UP AT STARTING LINE 7:45 AM

BOTH RACE EVENTS STARTS AT 8:00 AM

 

Welcome to the 5th annual RUN FOR THE HEALTH OF IT presented by the Grandview Foundation at the beautiful watershed park, Hamamongna, near Pasadena.

 

The Grandview Foundation has been a part of your community for over 50 years, providing residential and outpatient treatment and recovery support. When physical exercise is included in treatment, we have seen a tremendous increase in recovery. This event is being offered to help raise awareness about our organization and the connection between Physical and Mental Health.

 

We welcome serious runners, exercise enthusiasts, and families and friends who want to challenge themselves in this fun outdoor event.

 

ALL AGES are welcome to RUN or WALK to the finish line to support the essential work and services provided by the Grandview Foundation.

 

Let's run together for Health and a Better Life.

name: Run for the Planet – 5K, 10K, 10M, and Half Marathon
description:
Join us for a thrilling celebration of loving our planet, environmental stewardship, and movement!

Details
Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)
Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Course
5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course
The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located along the course. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

name: Run In The New Year 5k/10K/Half Marathon
description:
It's SoCal's HEALTHIEST LIVE PARTY!  LIVE BAND at  the START/FINISH and  the course! It's YOUR NEW YEAR'S CELEBRATION. WITH New Year's BLING!

Friday, Jan. 1, 2027

  • 8:30 am Half Marathon Start

  • 8:40 am Kid's Dash

  • 9:00 am 5k/10K Mass Start

Early Packet Pick-Up: We encourage you to pick up the day prior

    • TBD

    • Packet pick-up is optional, so if you cannot make it- don't worry. Packets can be picked up on race day starting at 7 am in LOT 25. The gates to the STATE PARK open at 7am.

Write a New Year resolution on the back of your bib and RUN, JOG, or WALK it into the new year. 

The course is the flat and fast, paved, wide State Park path, watching and listening to the surf.! Whether an avid runner, jogger, first-timer, or walker, we are the something for every BODY & EVERYBODY best-themed race! Bring family and friends, or just yourself and shoes! Let's get 2024 off and  RUNNING. 

  Entry comes with a Run In The New Year CUSTOM 5K/10K T-Shirt

  Special LONG SLEEVE DESIGN T-shirt for Half Marathon Finishers

  And, a huge CUSTOM CAST finisher medal to all! HUGE!!

Make it a Post-race 5K/10K resolution party ( New Year's Beanies will be for sale at the t-shirt table.)

GEAR CHECK is available, if needed, at the Caren Ware Events BOOTH.  Put your bib number on a tag and pin to your gear.  

Professionally CHIP timed event by ITZ ABOUT TIME. Age division awards galore!

Entrance to Bolsa Chica State Park.

The event is in the farthest western lot- Lot 25, closest to Warner & PCH, but to enter the park use the following address: 17851 Pacific Coast Hwy.

Race Day Schedule:

  • 6:00 am: Gates Open
  • 7:00 am: Race Day Packet Pick-Up Begins (Lot 25)
  • 8:00 am Half Marathon Start for those that will take more than 3 hours and 45 minutes to finish
  • 8:30 am: Half Marathon Start (Must cross the starting arch by 8:05 am)
  • 8:40 am: Kid’s Dash
  • 9:00am: 5K/10K Mass Start (Must cross the starting arch by 9:05 am)
  • 9:40am: 5K Awards Ceremony begins.
  • 10:00 am 10K awards
  • 10:30 announcing of overall Half marathon awards

8:30 am start for HALF MARATHON.  You have until 8:35 to pass under the arch.  9:00am start for 5k/10K.  You have until 9:05 am to pass under the arch.  All 5k/10K must start before the lead half marathoner finishes.   YOUR START TIME does not start until you cross under the arch. Fastest runners in the front, and those looking to place in their age group division. Wear your bib on the front.  Make sure you run the distance on your bib or exchange it for the correct one of your choice at the Solutions/Late registration table if you decide to change races.

SPECIAL PANCAKE BREAKFAST!!!! You can add pancakes to your registration on the last page...

Visit the Speciality Coffee Booth, Fresh baked cookies (GALLETINAS BOOTH),  fresh cut fruits,  and street tacos and tamales will be there.

Awards:

There are “In It To Win It” age categories 3 deep with 5 year age spans: 1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80-84 and 85 & over.

Course

Flat and fast, or slow and easy, make it the pace you want it. This 5K/10K course runs along the beach bike path at Bolsa Chica, Huntington Beach State Beach. Families can bring strollers but agree to use at their own risk.  Half Marathon Course: Flat, fast, perfect for PRs or training for your next marathon.  It is (2)Two loops of the 10k so you get plenty of aid stations, entertainment, and spectator friendly!! Aid Station Every 1.5 Miles

  • Water/Gatorade
  • Chargel/ Bananas  

FLAT!!! Great for first-time Half Marathoners or those wanting to PR!
Half Marathon Spectators - you can be at the finish line to see runners start then walk about 50 ft towards the runners to see them go on their second loop.

Restrooms:

Restrooms on RACE DAY: are located at each end of the parking lot.  A set by Sea Legs (east) and a set near  Warner Blvd on the west end of the parking lot.

description:
Run into  Summer Vibes 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon – Venice Beach 🌞🌴🏃‍♀️


Get ready to soak up the sunshine and feel the energy of summer at the Summer Vibes Run in beautiful Santa Monica! Whether you’re chasing a personal best or strolling along the beach with friends, this event is all about good vibes, scenic views, and a day of fun under the California sun. Choose from the 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon and join the celebration!

📍 Location: World Famous Muscle Beach – 1 Windward Ace, Venice Beach, CA 
📅 Date: Saturday, May 30, 2026


 ☀️ Run into Summer Vibes – May 30th | Venice Beach, CA
Start your summer the CaliFlow way—with sunshine, good vibes, and a run down the iconic Venice Pier!

Choose from a 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon and soak in the beach views, palm-lined paths, and that fresh ocean breeze. Run, walk, vibe—it’s your miles, your pace.


 
🏅 What You Get:
✔  Finisher Medal for all participants
📸 Free Race Day Photos – Capture your CaliFlow moment!
🎶 Live DJ & Music at the finish line
💧 Water & Electrolyte Stations along the course
 
⏰ Bib Pick-Up & Start Times:
📍 Race Ready Athletics Tent
🕠 Bib Pick-Up: 5:30 AM to 6:15 AM 
🏁 Half Marathon Start - 6:15 AM
🏁 5K 10K Start : 7:15 AM
🕠 Bib Pick-Up: 6:45 AM to 7:30 AM for 3rd Wave Runners

 
🌊 Additional Race Day Info:
✔ Restrooms near the start line
✔ Water & aid stations at both U-turn locations
✔ Stroller & walker-friendly event
✔ Fully marked course
 
☀️ Weather & Safety:
🎭 Rain or Shine Event!
🌊 Extreme weather? (Tsunamis, tidal waves, or zombie apocalypses) – updates will be sent via email & social media.
 
Plenty of free street parking early in the morning. Public parking is available at the City Lot (2100 Ocean Front Walk)—opens at 6 AM. All-day rates range from $5 to $9. 3 to 4 min walk to start line
 
🏃‍♂️ Don’t Miss This One!
Whether you’re chasing a PR, soaking in the Venice Beach vibes, or just here for the full moon magic & leprechaun fun—this race is THE PLACE TO BE! 🌕🍀
👟 Ready to run? Let’s GO! 💨🔥

name: Run Juneteenth Day 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
On Juneteenth, we remember resilience, honor progress, and run toward a brighter future.
Join the Juneteenth Day Run — an event that celebrates freedom, community, and the unbreakable human spirit.
Let’s make every mile matter.

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Run Like a Hero: 4th of July 5k
description:
Join us for a 4th of July celebration, the Run Like a Hero 5k presented by Chico Striders and Chico Running Club. Race proceeds benefit Chico Striders Run Strong Scholarship presented to graduating high school senior athletes. Our theme this year is Run Like a Hero- wear your favorite hero costume or best Independence Day attire!

Date: Saturday July 4th, 2026 @ 7:30am
Registration: Will be available until 11:30pm on July 3rd. No race day registration is available.
Location: Sycamore Field, Bidwell Park - (Google Map)
Parking: At Vallombrosa Way, CARD HQ parking lot on Vallombrosa Ave or Woodland Ave

Bibs and Timing: Bibs will be given to all race entrants. Packet pick-up will be at Fleet Feet Thursday July 3rd between 11am-1pm. Bib pick-up can also be done the day of the race at Sycamore Field, starting at 7:00am. Timing will be performed by Chico Running Club.

Discounted Registration: Chico Striders and Chico Running Club Members receive $10 off race registration, select the Striders/CRC option Team option. For non members please select No Team. Please do not register for the discounted race fee if you are not a running club member.

Refreshments: Drinks and snacks will be provided after the race. Please stay after completing the race to cheer on other participants as they cross the finish.

Volunteers: Not ready to participate? Volunteers are needed and welcome for this race. Please click on the volunteer tab in the RunSignUp menu to sign up.

Race Insurance: Is provided by a RunSignUp partner. Chico Running Club does not provide or administer race insurance should participants elect to purchase it.

name: Run Through the Pines | 5K and 10K
description:
This will be the 47th Run Through the Pines

Save the date and please follow us on our Run Through the Pines Facebook and Instagram page.

The Run Through the Pines is a destination run and a San Bernardino, Rim Mountain Community Event. It is one of the longest "running" runs in Southern California (the first one was in 1979). It features a 10K and 5K run (or walk) around Lake Gregory and through a pine tree forest.  Runners (and walkers) can enjoy a semi-paved course at a 4,720-foot elevation, which makes it a perfect little challenge for mountain locals and especially our friends from down the hill. Race day staging is at the San Moritz Lodge “Meadow” area near the Lake Gregory Company bait and tackle shop. We encourage participants of all levels, children in strollers, pets on a leash, and especially teams/groups.

Lake Gregory is located in Crestline, a charming little town filled with one-of-a-kind shops and restaurants. We encourage all runners to stay the weekend and enjoy the town.

Questions? Email the Rim of the World Recreation and Park District, info@rim-rec.org. 

Featured Events:

10K

5K

 

Registration

We prefer all participants pre-register online for a quicker check-in on the day of the run. Participants may also register on the day of the run. Same-day registration will be open onsite from 6:30 am on August 8.

Registration Dates & Fees: 

Until April 30 - $40 per participant 

May 1 - August 7 - $50 per participant 

Same Day Registration (August 8) - $60 per participant 

Run T-shirts are not included in registration fee. T-shirts are $20 per shirt. 

Timing & Awards 

RFID CHIP TIMED by ITZ ABOUT TIME  Top three overall trophies and age division awards 3 deep in the following categories: 10 & under, 11-14, 15-19. 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39, 40-44, 45-49, 50-54, 55-59, 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80 plus. 

Tentative Schedule of Run Day

6:30 AM     Check-in / Same day Registration

8:00 AM    10K Start

8:30 AM 5K Start

9:30 AM    Awards

Additional Features:

Music, water, post refreshments. 

Sponsors  

The Run Through the Pines is a mountain community event hosted by the Rim of the World Recreation and Park District and the Lake Gregory Company. The run relies on sponsors and/or local businesses and organizations to enhance the runner's experience on race day. If you would like more information on how to become a sponsor, please call the Park District Office, (909) 337-7275. 

Volunteers 

We love our volunteers and honestly, the event couldn't happen without them! We are currently looking for Registration and Race Kit Pick-up volunteers, Water Station Volunteers, Start/Finish Line Volunteers, and lots of course marshals to ensure a safe and fun event for everyone. Contact the Park District Office if you would like to volunteer. 

Parking

Parking is offered onsite at the San Moritz Lodge and in Lake Gregory parking lots. Please do not park directly in the Crest Forest Senior Citizens parking area or near their building, you will be towed. 

Questions? Email the Rim of the World Recreation and Park District, info@rim-rec.org.

6:30 AM     Check-in / Same day Registration

8:00 AM    10K Start

8:30 AM 5K Start

Music, water, post refreshments. 

Sponsors  

The Run Through the Pines is a mountain community event hosted by the Rim of the World Recreation and Park District and the Lake Gregory Company. The run relies on sponsors and/or local businesses and organizations to enhance the runner's experience on race day. If you would like more information on how to become a sponsor, please call the Park District Office, (909) 337-7275. 

Volunteers 

We love our volunteers and honestly, the event couldn't happen without them! We are currently looking for Registration and Race Kit Pick-up volunteers, Water Station Volunteers, Start/Finish Line Volunteers, and lots of course marshals to ensure a safe and fun event for everyone. Contact the Park District Office if you would like to volunteer.

Parking is offered onsite at the San Moritz Lodge and in Lake Gregory parking lots. Please do not park directly in the Crest Forest Senior Citizens parking area or near their building, you will be towed. 

Questions? Email the Rim of the World Recreation and Park District, info@rim-rec.org.

name: Run to FosterHope
description:
FosterHope Sacramento Presents its 5th Annual Run to FosterHope!


Saturday, June 13th  @ William Land Park

Join us at FosterHope Sacramento's 5th Annual Run to FosterHope on Saturday, June 13th, to support our community-based programs that help stabilize and support children and youth in crisis, while providing hope for a better future. Our 5th Annual Run to FosterHope is the perfect opportunity for us to celebrate our 40th anniversary of providing hope and healing in our community! 

 

We're excited to bring back our 5k and free kids run! Scheduled on Saturday, June 13th in beautiful Land Park in Sacramento to celebrate 40 years of FosterHope! Enjoy a beautiful day at the park while helping youth in your community! 

 

The 5K course is flat and will utilize the trails in William Land Park located next to Fairytale Town, Funderland, and the Sacramento Zoo, making it an ideal route for runners and walkers. 

 

There will also be vendors, food trucks, info booths, and kids activities -  Making a fun event for everyone. All paid registrations will receive a T-Shirt and Finishing Medal. (late registrations are not guaranteed a T-shirt on race day). Join us for a day dedicated to Fostering Hope!

 

Race Day Schedule

Registration/ Packet Pickup:  7:30 am - 8:20 am

3k/5k Race Begins: 8:30 am 

Kids Fun Run Dash:  9:45 am 

Family Fun Festival:  10 am - 1pm

During the Family Fun Festival we will host a raffle for some amazing prizes and be joined by some amazing vendors! 

 

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is the race timed?

A: Yes, with chipping and timing run by A Change of Pace!

 

Q: Can I run with a stroller?

A: Yes, and we’ll have activities and games for the whole family to enjoy after the race concludes.

 

Q: What’s the course like?

A:  Runners will run two loops for the 5k on the road inside of William Land Park! The Start/Finish line is located by the Village Green at the corner of Freeport Blvd and Sutterville Rd.

 

Q:What time should participants arrive?

A: Registration opens at 7:30 and the race begins at 8:30. At registration you can pick up your bib and shirt!

 

About FosterHope Sacramento


Since 1985 FosterHope Sacramento has been providing services for El Dorado, Placer, San Joaquin, Yolo and Sacramento Counties. For 40 years FosterHope has directly impacted the lives of youth and families within the greater Sacramento region providing care, community and support. As a California licensed, 501(c)(3) nonprofit Foster Family Agency (FFA), our Care Homes are located from Stockton to Shingle Springs and from Tahoe City to Sacramento.
Federal Tax ID: 68-0073413

name: Run to Remember
description:
This 5k run/walk invites families, friends, and community members to come together in honor and memory of loved ones who have passed. After the 5K, we will gather for a peaceful lantern lighting ceremony, offering a beautiful and symbolic way to celebrate lives lived and memories cherished.

Whether you run, walk, or simply come for the ceremony, your presence helps us support those who are grieving while celebrating the enduring bonds of love and remembrance.

All ages are welcome. Proceeds benefit hospice care and bereavement support services.

name: Run With All Your Heart 5k- Los Angeles
description:
Get ready to lace up and make a difference! Join Curing Kids Cancer for the Run With All Your Heart 5K Fun Run, a high-energy, family-friendly event organized by our Future Leaders in Medicine. An incredible team spearheads this inspiring run: UCLA resident and founder Brandon Gettleman, alongside USC Keck School of Medicine’s Natalie Kistler (LA Event Co-Director) and UCLA Geffen School of Medicine's Kole Joachim (LA Event Co-Director)

Saturday, April 11th | Griffith Park, Los Angeles, CA
Registration: 8:00 AM | Race Start: 9:00 AM

Whether you're a seasoned runner or just in it for fun, this event is for all ages and fitness levels! With every step you take, the proceeds directly support a local, multidisciplinary, multi-institutional sarcoma project led by the region’s top specialists in the greater Los Angeles area. Let’s run, have fun, and give kids battling cancer the future they deserve. Sign up today and be a part of something bigger!

We can’t wait to see you there!

name: Run with the Heroes 5k, 10k & Family Walk
description:
Join us Saturday, April 18th for the 10th Annual Run with the Heroes, a milestone celebration where every step truly makes a difference. To honor 10 incredible years, we’re excited to introduce a brand-new 10K alongside our 5k and quarter-mile Family Walk. When you run, walk, or roll, you’re supporting George’s Pass—a life-changing program that creates sensory-safe, inclusive experiences for special needs children in hospitals and throughout our community. Your participation helps kids feel seen, safe, and celebrated exactly as they are.

This year, we’re honoring the Heroes Among Us—healthcare professionals, first responders, and everyday heroes. Come dressed as your favorite superhero, light up strollers and wheelchairs, to shine a bright light on inclusion for kids of ALL abilities. Bring the whole family and enjoy a sensory-friendly carnival, food, fun activities for all ages, and the chance to connect with organizations dedicated to supporting children with special needs. Run with purpose. Celebrate inclusion. Be a hero.

Sign up today and help us create a world where every child belongs.

description:

*Processing Fee To Be Added At Checkout

RACE LOCATION:
Woodley Park Section 1, Lake Balboa
6076 Woodley Ave.
Los Angeles, CA 91316

 

We're thrilled to announce the 16th Annual Run/Walk for WeSPARK 5K/10K happening on Sunday, February 22 at Woodley Park in Lake Balboa! Rally your family, friends, and teammates - it's time to move together in support of WeSPARK Cancer Support Center. With options for every pace and age, there’s truly something for everyone.

Join us for a fun-filled, family-friendly day!

  • Commemorative T-shirt & Finisher Medal for all 5K/10K registrants
  • Age Division Awards: 1st, 2nd & 3rd place in each group
  • NEW! Kaya Medals: 1st, 2nd & 3rd place for our four-legged friends that complete the 5K
  • Vendor Expo with community partners
  • Raffle prizes & great music

Race Highlights

  • Chip-timed 5K & 10K Courses around scenic Lake Balboa - fast, flat, and perfect for seasoned runners or casual walkers.
  • Kids FUN RUN (ages 3–11): A short, spirited dash in Woodley Park.
  • Stroller-friendly & Dog-friendly (must be on-leash): Bring the whole family!   

New this year, all registered dogs can compete for the 1st, 2nd, or 3rd place "Kaya Medal” - a special award created in loving memory of Kaya The Husky.  

Packet Pick-Up Begins @ 7:30am

Race Begins @ 9:00am

 
All proceeds benefit WeSPARK Cancer Support Center! Learn more at www.wespark.org

name: Runnin' To The Rig
description:
Embrace the BHS Legacy and Join us for our 2nd Runnin' To The Rig 5k Run/Walk!

Saturday, February 21st - Shot Gun Start at 8:30am and Check-in at 7:30am

Runners Start on Morrow Field / Walkers Start on Griffith Field Stadium / Embrace the Legacy Tour meets at the Water Tower near the concessions stand at Griffith Field.

Day of Race Registration 7am - 8am at Check-In Desk at Table on Morrow Field.  Cost is $40/pp

We invite you to participate with us in this FUNdraising endeavor to build community and raise funds. Our 5k course is designed as a nostalgic run/walk throughout our historic campus ending near the famous football tunnel in Griffith Stadium.   Our 2K walk will meander around campus and even through some of the buildings.  The Walk will start after the Run.  Medals given to all finishers!          

Race T-shirts can be purchased during registration for an extra fee if you pre-register  by February 4th.

Plan to hang around after the race for pictures and selfies on historic Griffith Field. 

Don't wait, come join the fun! We are grateful for your support of Bakersfield High School. Go Blue! Once a Driller, Always a Driller!

 

Bib & T-shirt Pickup

You can pick up your race packet and t-shirt at the stadium parking lot near Griffith Stadium.

Fri. Feb. 20,  3:30-6 pm
Sat. Feb. 21,  7-8 am

name: Running Fence Run - Celebrating Christo & Jeanne-Claude's "Running Fence" - a 24.5-mile fabric fence in Sonoma & Marin Counties installed in September 1976
description:
A 2,516-Year Echo: Marathon to Running Fence​
​
On September 12, 490 BC, the Athenians defeated the Persians at the Battle of Marathon. A messenger—Pheidippides—ran from Marathon to Athens to announce the victory.​ His route measured 24.5 miles, the distance of the first Athens Olympic Marathon in 1896. The distance was changed to 26.2 miles for the 1908 London Olympics.​
​
In 1976, Christo & Jeanne-Claude’s "Running Fence" stretched 24.5 miles across Sonoma and Marin — the same length as Pheidippides’ legendary run. Christo conceived of the "Running Fence" in October 1972, following American Frank Shorter's graceful marathon victory at the Munich Olympics. The "Running Fence" was controversial requiring years of public debate before installation permits were approved. The Running Fence - Watson School Historic Park memorializes the project.

Runner's World magazine revealed a key running connection: Bob Urie, who supplied fabric for Christo's projects, was both a marathon runner and an organizer of the 1976 New York City Marathon. Despite critical dismissal of the "Running Fence' at the time as being "meaningless", it embodied themes of running and the democratic freedoms that originated in ancient Athens. Christo, having fled Soviet-bloc oppression, characterized his creation as "a scream of freedom."​ More details at RunningFenceRun.org

2026, on September 12, Runners return to the beautiful Sonoma County rural landscape of Running Fence to celebrate: ​

  •   The 50th anniversary of Christo & Jeanne-Claude’s "Running Fence"  exhibited in 1976 from September 10th - 21st.​
  •   The 2,516th anniversary of the Battle of Marathon  - September 12, 490 BC.​

Choose your distance, 5K, 10K, 1/2 Marathon, or modern 26.2 Mile Marathon, and challenge yourself while supporting great causes.

Visit the Museum of Sonoma County's exhibition:

name: Running for the Rescues – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Race Details

Start Location: Claremont Beach, 5400 E Ocean Ave, Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule

Saturday
1-3:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email the week of the event)

Sunday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for 1half marathoners and 10-milers only, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route & 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists. 

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located along the course. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results: A link for race results and photos will be sent within 24 hours of the event. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question?
Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Running Is For The Birds - 5K, 10K, Kids Run - Earth Day Celebration
description:
Amigos De Bolsa Chica, in conjunction with Bolsa Chica State Beach is hosting a run/walk/beach cleanup for Earth Day! 

🌎 Run for the Birds, Run for the Planet, Run for Earth Day
At a local 5K/10K near you!
Join us on Saturday, April 25, 2026, at Bolsa Chica State Beach — where every step makes a difference.
Run and walk along the beach on a flat, fast, and paved course with stunning ocean views.
🎉 FREE BEACH PARKING before 8:00 AM — races start sharp!
 
🏃‍♀️ Race Options:
Plover Dash 5K
Brown Pelican 10K
Fuzzy Feathers Fun Run (for the kiddos)
5K Plogging (picking up litter while jogging)
10K Plogging
Beach Clean Up with State Beach staff
 
🧢 What You Get:
All registered participants in the 5K, 10K, and Plogging events receive:
🏅 Custom Commemorative Medal – designed exclusively for this Earth Day event
👕 Limited-Edition Race Shirt – beautifully designed by a local artist and featuring a new Bolsa Chica bird each year. These collectible commemorative shirts are more than swag — they’re wearable art that celebrates the spirit of the wetlands.

🏆 Overall & Age Group Awards
⏱️ Professional Chip Timing – results synced to Athlinks
🎪 Finish Line Festival – vendors, product samples, music & local community vibes

Location: Lot 25, Bolsa Chica State Beach
Check-In Begins: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K Start: 8:00 AM
Kids Fun Run: 9:00 AM

🚲 Bike Valet available near the start line
🎒 Gear Check Available
Fuzzy Feathers Kids Run participants receive commemorative medals & special prizes.

name: Running With the Lions
description:
The Madera Evening Lions invite you to participate in "Running with the Lions", a 5K Run-Walk event at Lions Town & Country Park in beautiful Madera, California.  We would like to create diabetes awareness and provide information through local agencies and organizations.  A great day to get outside and move for those impacted by diabetes.  This year JDRF will be present-they are the leading company on diabetes research and over the years have improved the way of life for many diagnosed.

Online registration closes on the 9th of April.  You can still register at packet pick up on the 10th, and the morning of the race on April 11th once registration closes.

Race Participants will earn a ready to plant fruit tree from The Burchell Nursery! (one per family)

T-Shirts and appropriate size will be guaranteed to those who register before and on March 21st.

Finishers will earn a surprise finishers goodies/ your Very own finishers Lion Medal!

Funds raised will assist with Diabetes Research to help better lives and find a cure.

Bib Number and T shirt Pickup will be Friday April 10th at Town and Country Park between Baseball Fields 1 and 2 behind the snack bar under big purple tent from  6:00-7:30pm .  Day of Bib pick up will start at 7am at the amphitheater by the starting line.  

Race starts at 8:30am

Did you know that glasses could be recycled properly?- The Madera Evening Lions will be collecting glasses at packet pick up and race day...

Thank you for joining us as we celebrate the 5th annual race to raise awareness.

name: Ruth McKenzie Preserve Half Marathon | 10k | 5k | Kids Race
description:
The Ruth McKenzie Table Mountain Preserve (2960 acres) is located between Friant and Prather, on the north side of Auberry Road. The main gate is 3.3 miles uphill from the intersection of Auberry Road and Millerton Road.

The McKenzie Preserve was acquired in trust from The Nature Conservancy in 1998. The property had previously been placed in a trust by its owner, Ruth Bea McKenzie, who wanted it to remain in ranching and open space after her death.The McKenzie Preserve is primarily grassland and oak woodland that slopes upward toward the basalt lava table lands that give the preserve its name.

The preserve includes a significant portion of one of the flat-topped tables that are visible from the road. In spring, rain water collects in the table’s low spots, forming vernal pools. Since the basalt is impermeable, these pools hold water for several weeks or months until it eventually evaporates. The pools provide habitat for rare plants and crustaceans that “come to life” in the presence of the water. When the pools dry up in late spring, these crustaceans become seeds or cysts in order to survive the rest of the year. On the far side of the table formations, out of sight of Auberry Road, the land slopes steeply down to the San Joaquin River. These north-facing slopes sustain an excellent mix of pine forest and chaparral. The preserve also includes a 47-acre parcel along the creek on the south side.

name: Ryan's Ranch Run
description:
Ryan’s Ranch Run is a community-driven 5K, 10K, and Kids Mile hosted at the breathtaking Thousand Hills Ranch in Pismo Beach—Ryan Teixeira’s family ranch and the heart of his legacy. This unique event blends scenic running routes with a meaningful mission, raising funds for Central Coast Athletics Foundation (CCAF) and 17 Strong, an organization founded in Ryan’s honor to provide Victory Trips to young adults battling life-threatening illness.

Runners and walkers of all ages take on a mixed-terrain course with rolling hills and the spirit of community all around. Race day begins with the inspiring 17 Strong Victory Lap, followed by the Kids Mile and the 5K/10K races. After crossing the finish line, participants enjoy a lively festival with live music, local vendors, delicious food, raffle prizes, and family-friendly fun.

Ryan’s Ranch Run isn’t just a race—it’s a celebration of resilience, community, and giving back. Each step supports two impactful nonprofits and helps continue Ryan’s legacy of strength, joy, and living life to the fullest.

name: Sagebrush Safari - XC MTB & E-MTB
description:
***ALL REGISTRATIONS ARE FINAL - THERE ARE NO REFUNDS***

SAGEBRUSH SAFARI is back for the 8th year under Quick n’ Dirty.  The 2026 Cross Country course will be roughly 31 Miles with tons of fun singletrack! This folks is true cross country course. For the true beginners, youth, and E-MTB’ers we are also offering a 23 mile course.

The Sagebrush Safari XC MTB/E-MTB courses are on multi-use trails and public roads. This means that you may encounter off-road vehicles and dirtbikes, as well as vehicles on the paved roads. We will do our best to limit the traffic on the trails and roads, but we cannot forcibly stop people from using them. Please ride with caution and be courteous if you encounter any on or off-road traffic.

WHEN:

  • FUNDO: Saturday, March 28, 2026
  • MAIN RACE: Sunday, March 29, 2026
    • XC MTB: 31 Miles Long Course (31 Miles) RideWithGPS
    • XC MTB & E-MTB: 23 Miles Short Course (23 Miles) RideWithGPS

SATURDAY FUNDO FUN RACE INFO:

There will be FUNDO Fun Race (Format TBD) that will take place on Saturday March 28, 2026. Registration for the FUNDO will be $25.00 and includes a Spaghetti dinner. You can add the FUNDO registration on as part of the Long Course and Short Course Registration, or if you only want to participate in the FUNDO with the Spaghetti Dinner, you can select FUNDO ONLY registration option.

SATURDAY SPAGHETTI DINNER:

  • The FUNDO ONLY registration includes the Spaghetti Dinner
  • The registration for the Long Course and Short Course includes an option to add on the FUNDO, which includes the Spaghetti Dinner, or an option to add the Spaghetti Dinner only
  • Dinner Bell rings at 6:00pm

SUNDAY MAIN RACE DAY SCHEDULE:

  • 7:30-9:15 – Check-in and On-site registration (Please arrive on time)
  • 9:30 – 23 Mile XC E-MTB & 31 Mile XC MTB Racers will all start together with the E-Bikers lining up in front
  • 9:35 – 23 Mile XC MTB Racers will all start at the same time
  • 9:50 – Kids Race
    Podium presentations will be conducted accordingly as racers finish

WHERE:

  • 28880 Corral Canyon Trail, Campo, CA 91906 is the nearest physical address. GOOGLE MAPS
    This address will take you further up Corral Canyon Trail but will take you right by the venue. If you are using GPS to get there don’t go all the way to the address, make sure you stop where the fun is. Don’t go past the Navy’s Camp Morena facility, it will be on the right, across the street from the venue.
  • Camp Morena location GOOGLE MAPS

ENTERTAINMENT, AMENITIES & EXTRAS:

-3 Fully Stocked Feed Stations sponsored by Hammer Nutrition
-Commemorative Sagebrush Safari Event Item
-Hammer Swag bag with good stuff!
-Friday night pre-race gathering at the Sagebrush Saloon 
-Post-race fun with Libations, Live Music, and an Overall Good Time!
-Camping (see below for more info)
-Food Vendors
-Kids Ride

CAMPING INFO:

  • Camping is $30.00 for 1 night or $40.00 for two nights
  • Boondocking (Dry Camping) will be available Friday afternoon though Sunday evening.
  • NO INDIVIDUAL CAMPFIRES (Forest Service approved fire rings will be placed in pre-determined locations within the camping area)
  • If you pack it in PLEASE pack it out. We ask that you do your part to respect the area and keep your area clean and trash free

***ALL REGISTRATIONS ARE FINAL - THERE ARE NO REFUNDS***

You can add the FUNDO registration on as part of the Long Course and Short Course Registration, or if you only want to participate in the FUNDO with the Spaghetti Dinner, you can select FUNDO ONLY registration option.

SATURDAY SPAGHETTI DINNER:

  • The FUNDO ONLY registration includes the Spaghetti Dinner
  • The registration for the Long Course and Short Course includes an option to add on the FUNDO, which includes the Spaghetti Dinner, or an option to add the Spaghetti Dinner only
  • Dinner Bell rings at 6:00pm

SUNDAY MAIN RACE DAY SCHEDULE:

  • 7:30-9:15 – Check-in and On-site registration (Please arrive on time)
  • 9:30 – 23 Mile XC E-MTB & 31 Mile XC MTB Racers will all start together with the E-Bikers lining up in front
  • 9:35 – 23 Mile XC MTB Racers will all start at the same time
  • 9:50 – Kids Race

WHERE:

Don’t go past the Navy’s Camp Morena facility, it will be on the right, across the street from the venue.

-3 Fully Stocked Feed Stations sponsored by Hammer Nutrition
-Commemorative Sagebrush Safari Event Item

-Friday night pre-race gathering at the Sagebrush Saloon 
-Post-race fun with Libations, Live Music, and an Overall Good Time!
-Camping (see below for more info)
-Food Vendors
-Kids Ride

CAMPING INFO:

  • Camping is $30.00 for 1 night or $40.00 for two nights

name: San Clemente Ocean Festival
description:
San Clemente Ocean Festival is a volunteer organization, dedicated to the promotion and support of ocean safety, the environment and the community by providing a quality athletic venue and enjoyable family event. Saturday July 19

Beach Events (All Events) - includes 5K Beach Run, Biathlon (Swim 1K, Run 5K), Open Ocean Paddle, One Mile Ocean Swim, Run-Swim-Run, SUP Sprint, Splash & Dash Relay

name: San Diego 4th of July 5k
description: We are hosting the 1st annual San Diego 4th of July 5k in honor of Ethan Hamilton. It's a non profit event giving kids scholarships to play sports that otherwise wouldn't be able to. Giving back to the community and our future. The 5k run/walk will take place at 8am and there will be a Kids 1K Fun Run at 9:30am. In-N-Out Burger will be there serving burgers and Karl Strauss is sponsoring a beer garden.  Give aways from the San Diego Padres, SD Wave FC, Rancho Bernardo Inn, SD Gulls Hockey Club, Orangetheory, UC San Diego and many more will be raffled off along with other amazing raffled off items. Each participant will receive a raffle at packet pick up on Thursday, July 3rd from 1-6pm. Packet pick up will be located at SHAY Realtors 16611 Dove Canyon Rd. San Diego, Ca 92127. Come out for a wonderful community event, celebrating the 4th of July and honoring an amazing man who gave so much to so many!

name: San Diego 50 & Trail Runs
description:
SAN DIEGO 50M | TRAIL MARATHON | RELAY | HALF MARATHON | SUMMIT CHASE 10M | VALLEY 5M | STROLLER 5K | KID'S 1 MILE

                       

The San Diego 50M is a great introduction into ultra marathons or your first 50M distance, ideal for all running levels.

The San Diego Trail Marathon is a staple in the trail marathon events. Enjoy a fast trail while getting to summit its high point of Raptor Ridge. 

San Diego Trail Marathon Relay is a new format to our classic Trail Marathon. Run 13.1 before passing off to your team mate to run the last 13.1 miles finishing at our Official Finish Line. * Note there will not be a shuttle. Easy Pick Up Drop Offs available at the Piedras Parking Trail Head Parking Lot.

The San Diego Trail Heavy Half Marathon is a beautiful courses for exploring new trails and accomplishing race goals as it gives you just that little more than a half marathon.

NEW Summit Chase 10M conquer and claim the CROWN on the fast out and back course up to the top of Raptor Ridge. The fastest time out and back claims the crown.

NEW Valley 5M our flat 5 plus mile event gives you a introduction distance and amazing valley views.

NEW Stroller Trail 5k our flat 5k (3.1 Mile)  event gives you a super flat course to get out with your little ones and enjoy the day.

The Elevated Youth 1 Mile is open to children 10 and younger. This is a non-timed run. All kids receive a finisher’s shirt/medal 

                                                           Whether you sprint, run, walk, jog, or hike this event you do not want to miss.

                                             We are a CUPLESS race series. Please make sure to bring some form of hydration vessel to carry hydration for your event. There will not be cups provided at aid stations.

The San Diego Trail Marathon is a staple in the trail marathon events. Enjoy a fast trail while getting to summit its high point of Raptor Ridge. 

San Diego Trail Marathon Relay is a new format to our classic Trail Marathon. Run 13.1 before passing off to your team mate to run the last 13.1 miles finishing at our Official Finish Line. * Note there will not be a shuttle. Easy Pick Up Drop Offs available at the Piedras Parking Trail Head Parking Lot.

The San Diego Trail Heavy Half Marathon is a beautiful courses for exploring new trails and accomplishing race goals as it gives you just that little more than a half marathon.

NEW Summit Chase 10M conquer and claim the CROWN on the fast out and back course up to the top of Raptor Ridge. The fastest time out and back claims the crown.

NEW Valley 5M our flat 5 plus mile event gives you a introduction distance and amazing valley views.

NEW Stroller Trail 5k our flat 5k (3.1 Mile)  event gives you a super flat course to get out with your little ones and enjoy the day.

The Elevated Youth 1 Mile is open to children 10 and younger. This is a non-timed run. All kids receive a finisher’s shirt/medal 

                                                           Whether you sprint, run, walk, jog, or hike this event you do not want to miss.

                                             We are a CUPLESS race series. Please make sure to bring some form of hydration vessel to carry hydration for your event. There will not be cups provided at aid stations.

name: San Diego Beach & Bay Half Marathon
description:
The San Diego Beach & Bay Half Marathon is an award-winning loop course along some of the best of San Diego’s coastline. Experience beautiful beaches to picturesque bays, you’ll run past SeaWorld, Belmont Park, Mission Beach, Pacific Beach, and Sail Bay — the best of San Diego in one unforgettable course.

With only 165 feet of total elevation gain, this is one of California’s flattest and fastest half marathons — perfect for chasing a PR or enjoying the ultimate destination race in San Diego.

Register today and join us on April 11, 2026.

name: San Diego Holiday Half Marathon & 5K
description: The San Diego Holiday Half Marathon is a fast 13.1-mile course that starts on Penasquitos Drive in front of the Hotel Karlan (formerly, the Doubletree Golf Resort) then travels SW along Carmel Mountain Rd (your only ‘real’ hill at mile 1.5), along the 56 bike path and finishes at the beautiful Torrey Pines State Beach (pictured above!). The race includes a 711-foot net elevation drop along the “rolling” downhill bike path, which also makes it a personal best candidate. This popular winter half has been a sell-out event every year. Get your end-of-the-year PR!!!

name: San Diego Neighborhood Cruise 5K & 10K Run/Walk
description:
Get ready, San Diego! We invite you to join us for our inaugural event in one of San Diego’s beautiful park. Cruise along the lake, feel the cool ocean breeze, and soak in the scenery as you run, jog, or walk with our community. This is more than a race—it’s a celebration of movement, connection, and good vibes.

🏁 San Diego Neighborhood Cruise 5K & 10K Run/Walk 
📍 De Anza Cove Park
3000 N Mission Bay Dr, San Diego, CA 92109

With a lowrider-inspired theme and a welcoming atmosphere, this event brings together fitness, culture, and community. Friends and families are encouraged to come out and enjoy the day—everyone is welcome!

Whether you’re a seasoned runner, casual jogger, walker, or cheering from the sidelines, there’s a place for you here. 

Come cruise the course and celebrate in-style.🔥 Lowrider fans—this one’s for you! Cross the finish line strong. We cant wait to see you.

Let’s cruise together! 💖✨Earn your medal.

🗓️ Event Details

⏰ 6:30 AM – Registration Opens
🏃‍♂️ 7:30 AM – 10K Starts
🏃‍♀️ 7:45 AM – 5K Starts
🏆 9:00 AM – Awards Ceremony
⏱️ 10:00 AM – Event Closes

🗺️ Course Instructions

5K:
• Out-and-back course
• Complete the route 1 time (1X)

10K:
• Follows the same 5K route
• Complete the course 2 times (2X)

Please follow all course signage and volunteer directions for a safe and smooth race experience.

⏱️📸 Timing, Results & Photos

• This event is gun-timed
• Race bibs are not chip-timed

name: San Fernando Valley Mile
description: The City of San Fernando invites you to lace up your shoes and run or walk your best mile! Set in the vibrant heart of San Fernando, this one-mile race is perfect for runners and walkers of all levels. The course starts at 8th Street and Maclay Avenue, taking you down the iconic Maclay Avenue and finishing just before 3rd Street. Whether you're racing for speed or strolling for fun, this is your chance to experience the energy and charm of San Fernando in a whole new way!

name: San Joaquin River Trail 10k/25k/50k
description:
Come out and run some of the best trails in the valley along Millerton Lake and the San Joaquin River. 

More info at: www.SanJoaquinRunning.com

Start/Finish: At the S. Finegold Pinic Area, located at the end of Sky Harbour Road in Friant, CA. Sky Harbor Road is located on the West side of Table Mountain Casino off of Millerton Rd. in Friant, Ca. Take Sky Harbor Rd North for approx. 6 miles and it will dead end at the South Finegold Picnic Area where parking is located. 

Start times: 50k – 0630am  •  25k – 0700am  •  10k – 0730am 

Packet Pickup/Check in: Race day at the Start/Finish area. Please arrive arrive early to get your bib, check in and hit the bathroom. NO RACE DAY ENTRIES.

Race Day Check In: 0540-0620am for 50k runners  •  0600-0655am for 25k runners •  0640-0725am for 25k runners <br /><br />

Pacers: Allowed for the 50k at Mile 16 (SJR Gorge/Aid Station #3&4)

Official cutoff for the Finish line will be 5:30pm 

Lodging: If you're traveling from out of town the nearest places to stay will be in Clovis, CA and Fresno, CA.

Camping: Camping is available on the North side of Millerton Lake and also near the 50k turnaround at the San Joaquin River Gorge Mgmt area, each is about a 30 min drive from the Start/Finish. No camping is available at the Start/Finish.

Refunds/Transfer: No refunds after 09/01/2024. Bib transfers are allowed until 10/01/2024.

Crew access: Crew access at San Joaquin River Gorge Management Area near the Ya Gub Weh Tuh Campground-Mile 14.5 for 50k 

Aid Stations: Aid stations will be almost every 5 miles along the course. They will have water, sports drink, gels, fruit, snacks and basic first aid. 

Drop Bags: Need to be marked "Drop bags" with bib# conspicuously written on it. They will be at San Joaquin River Gorge Management Area, Ya Gub Weh Tuh Campground.

name: San Joaquin River Trail Half Marathon & 10K
description:
Come out and run some of the best local trails and a half marathon course that will kick your butt. With approx. 2500' of elevation gain this course won't be your typical stroll in the park. Over 90% single track trail in the foothills, this course could easily become your new favorite. Awards will be given out to top 3 overall Male and Female and 3 deep in age-groups.

 

All Participants Receive: 
Custom Finisher medal
Custom event shirt
Custom Race Awards for Overall & Age Groups

Early Bib/Shirt Pickup
When: Friday, March 6th From 3:30-5:30pm
Where: Fleet Feet Sports Fresno 9447 N Fort Washington Suite 106 Fresno, Ca 93730
 
Race Day Bib/Shirt Pickup 
When: Saturday, March 7th 6:30-7:50am in the Start Area
 
Race Location 
San Joaquin River Gorge Special Recreation Management Area
40060 Smalley Road Auberry, CA 93602
Click here for Google Map Directions
Parking
 
Please Carpool if possible. Parking is available near the Start/Finish in the Aholul Campground, additional parking is also available in the lower & upper parking lots and on cleared dirt areas along the roadside, not on the shoulder. 
We will have volunteers directing you upon reaching the Gorge Area
 
Please DO NOT park in the Equestrian Area. 
 
If you arrive late parking will be available down on Smalley Rd.
 
Please do not block the roadway or driveways.
 
 
Race Start Times 
Half Marathon: 8:00am
10k: 8:10am
 
Course Information 
Both the 10k and Half Marathon courses are challenging with steep hills and rough terrain. If you have not run in this area before please know that this course will take you much longer than a road Half Marathon or 10k. With that in mind please plan to carry a handheld water bottle and your preferred nutrition. 
 
Aid Stations: There will be one aid station for the 10k around mile 4. It will have water, GU Gels, Skratch and other snacks.
The Half Marathon Course will have Aid Stations at mile 4, 6, 9.6, & 11.7  
Please make sure any trash stays at the aid station, do not drop it along the course. 
 
Course Markers:  The course will be marked with the following: signs with directional arrows and orange ribbon. The course should be very easy to follow so long as you look for the markers.
 

 
Weather Forecast for Auberry, CA:

 
Awards
Both Half Marathon and 10k Finishers will receive a Finishers medal.
The Half Marathon & 10k will have awards for Top 3 Overall Male & Female finishers.
The Half Marathon & 10k will go 3 deep in 10yr Age Groups for men and women.
 
Post Race
Once you finish we will have refreshments waiting for you.
Please feel free to hang out and enjoy the area and cheer on your fellow runners as they finish.

name: San Lorenzo River Trail Run
description:
Run through 300 foot tall, 1500 year-old Coastal Redwoods, lush stream canyons, open meadows, pine and oak forests, and high dry chaparral-covered ridges. The Half Marathon, 30K, Marathon, and 50K events cross the San Lorenzo River (shown above) multiple times! 
(Distances are accurately measured using a Rolatape® surveyor's measuring wheel.)

name: San Lorenzo River Trail Run
description:
Run through 300 foot tall, 1500 year-old Coastal Redwoods, lush stream canyons, open meadows, pine and oak forests, and high dry chaparral-covered ridges. The Half Marathon, 30K, Marathon, and 50K events cross the San Lorenzo River (shown above) multiple times! 
(Distances are accurately measured using a Rolatape® surveyor's measuring wheel.)

name: San Mateo PAL's 5K & 10K Run/Walk and Wellness Fair - 2026
description:
San Mateo PAL in collaboration with Stride for Awareness present:

 

PAL's 5K Run/Walk & 10K Run and Wellness Fair

 

Join us May 30, 2026, from 8:00 a.m. - Noon at Coyote Point Recreation Area in San Mateo. This day is dedicated to supporting health and mental wellness, encouraging community partnerships and educating about diverse resources.

5K Run/Walk (Participation Fee) 
Start the day with a 5K Run or Walk through Coyote Point Park. Strollers and dogs are welcome with mindfulness to other participants. Race t-shirt and finishers medal included in registration.

10K Run (Participation Fee) 
Kick-off the day with a 10K Run through Coyote Point Park. (10K for runners only). Race t-shirt and finishers medal included in registration.

Stay after the 5K and 10K to attend our FREE Wellness Fair at Coyote Point Recreation Area starting at 8:00 a.m.

****When registering for the 5K or 10K, you don't need to register for the Wellness Fair. This is included in your ticket purchase.****

 
Wellness Fair (Complimentary) 
Join San Mateo PAL for the Wellness Fair at Coyote Point Recreation Area starting at 8:00 am. This fair features community, health and wellness vendors.

The Wellness Fair is FREE to all event attendees! 

-----------------------------------------------------

Start/Join a Team for the 5K or 10K Events!  
*Prize Opportunity! The Team Lead with the highest team participation on event day will win an exclusive prize.  

Create a Race Group/Team 
During registration, you will be asked the question: "Would you like to join or create a Group/Team?" Select “Yes.”  

Choose a Group Type:  

Friends and Family
Team Building
Student/Youth Groups 
Come up with a Group Name. Some ideas could be:  

Wellness Warriors 
Advocates for Awareness 
Not Fast, Just Furious 
Run Like the Winded 
Students for Mental Health 
Sole Mates 
Complete registration. Your group is now active!   

Join a Group 

Method 1 

During registration, you will be asked the question: "Would you like to join or create a Group/Team?" Select “Yes.” 

Choose the Group Name you would like to join.  

Method 2 

On the event page, navigate to the menu tab labeled “More.” Select “Group/Teams.”  

You will see a list of active groups. If you see the name of the group you want to join, click the green “Join” button. You will then be asked to register for the race to join the group.  

-----------------------------------------------------

This a community event that brings us together to support and raise awareness about the importance of health and mental well-being.

Join us on this empowering day because you and your mental health matter!
