name: Sandman Tri
description:
The Sandman Triathlon is one of Santa Cruz County’s oldest triathlons, having held its inaugural race in 1985, in the infancy of the sport.

The Sandman is a fundraiser for:

  • the local State Parks,
  • Lifeguard operations,
  • the Junior Lifeguard program.
    Proceeds help fund scholarships for underprivileged kids so they can receive high-quality water safety education.

The Sandman Triathlon is a USAT-sanctioned event.

name: Sandman Tri
description:
The Sandman Triathlon is one of Santa Cruz County’s oldest triathlons, having held its inaugural race in 1985, in the infancy of the sport.

The Sandman is a fundraiser for:

  • the local State Parks,
  • Lifeguard operations,
  • the Junior Lifeguard program.
    Proceeds help fund scholarships for underprivileged kids so they can receive high-quality water safety education.

The Sandman Triathlon is a USAT-sanctioned event.

name: Santa Anita Derby Day 5K
description:
Race like a champion before enjoying elite horse racing. This family-friendly event has something for everyone, so gather your loved ones and get ready for an unforgettable day!

Event Highlights:
  • Scenic Course: Run or walk a 5K through the picturesque Los Angeles Arboretum, surrounded by lush greenery and stunning botanical gardens, before finishing on the iconic Santa Anita Race Track.
  • Kids' Races: Young runners can join the fun with two options—a 6-furlong race for ages 7–12, or a quick Homestretch Dash for ages 6 and under—both on the legendary horse track.
  • Post-Event Entertainment: Enjoy the lively post-race expo featuring music, food, a complimentary beer for participants 21+, and the annual Spring Carnival.
  • Free Admission to Derby Day Horse Races: All participants receive complimentary admission and parking to the Derby Day horse races, plus an admission ticket to a future Santa Anita Park ($20 value).
  • Medals, Shirts & Timing: Every participant gets a finisher medal, an official event shirt, and chip timing to track your performance.
    Important Information: Registration fees are non-refundable and non-transferable.

name: Santa Barbara Trail Work Series presented by Runners for Public Lands and the Los Padres Forest Association
description:
Runners for Public Lands (RPL) envisions a world in which everyone has access to healthy, runnable landscapes. We are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that empowers runners to protect public lands and expand access to nature for all. 

We are excited to partner with the Santa Barbara Foundation, Los Padres Forest Association, the Santa Barbara Trail League, and the United States Forest Service (USFS), to present the 2026 Trail Work Series in Santa Barbara County. This brings our local community of runners together to learn about and care for the living landscapes we run with. Through repetitive, hands-on service events, we can grow ecological values and create strong connections that inspire runners to care for the places they love. 

The 2026 Santa Barbara Trail Work Series will include 4 independent trail work events. Each event will be approved, permitted, and insured by the USFS, led by the Los Padres Forest Association trail work leaders, and managed by Runners for Public Lands Staff and Ambassadors.  Attend multiple events and win prizes from our brand coalition sponsors, including Athletic Brewing, GU, Fractel, On, Altra, rabbit, as well as local partners and Runners for Public Lands.

Registration opens on February 7 th for the first event of the season, which will be held on Saturday, March 7th. Later events will be held in April and May. Please note that the days and times of all events are subject to change based on the discretion of the USFS, current conditions, and weather. We will keep everyone informed through the Runners for Public Lands Ventura/Santa Barbara Strava Club and direct emails to registrants.

name: Santa Barbara Trail Work Series presented by Runners for Public Lands and the Los Padres Forest Association
description:
Runners for Public Lands (RPL) envisions a world in which everyone has access to healthy, runnable landscapes. We are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that empowers runners to protect public lands and expand access to nature for all. 

We are excited to partner with the Santa Barbara Foundation, Los Padres Forest Association, the Santa Barbara Trail League, and the United States Forest Service (USFS), to present the 2026 Trail Work Series in Santa Barbara County. This brings our local community of runners together to learn about and care for the living landscapes we run with. Through repetitive, hands-on service events, we can grow ecological values and create strong connections that inspire runners to care for the places they love. 

The 2026 Santa Barbara Trail Work Series will include 4 independent trail work events. Each event will be approved, permitted, and insured by the USFS, led by the Los Padres Forest Association trail work leaders, and managed by Runners for Public Lands Staff and Ambassadors.  Attend multiple events and win prizes from our brand coalition sponsors, including Athletic Brewing, GU, Fractel, On, Altra, rabbit, as well as local partners and Runners for Public Lands.

Registration opens on February 7 th for the first event of the season, which will be held on Saturday, March 7th. Later events will be held in April and May. Please note that the days and times of all events are subject to change based on the discretion of the USFS, current conditions, and weather. We will keep everyone informed through the Runners for Public Lands Ventura/Santa Barbara Strava Club and direct emails to registrants.

name: Santa Barbara Triathlon & Beach Festival
description:
Incredible coastal views as you cycle the challenging bike course.


Take in the view of the channel islands as you toe the water’s edge of the Pacific Ocean at the 2026 Santa Barbara Triathlon & Beach Festival. Then, experience the beautiful backdrop of the Santa Ynez mountains as you cycle the challenging bike course. Finish with a beachfront run that ends with music, refreshments, and plenty of great finish-line vibes!

name: Santa Clarita Trail Race
description:
EPIC RACE IN THE GOLDEN HILLS OF SANTA CLARITA, CA

Ready to hit the trails? The Santa Clarita Trail Race offers seven exciting distances—5K, 10K, 15K, 30K, 60K, 100K, 120K—and three fixed time categories—6, 12, 24-Hours—along with team relay options on an epic trail course taking you through the breathtaking golden hills of Santa Clarita, CA.

Whether you’re a first-time trail runner or a seasoned athlete, the Santa Clarita Trail Race has something to match your fitness level and goals. Prepare for an epic trail race experience!

Step into the golden trails of California and join us for the Santa Clarita Trail Race—an unforgettable trail running experience for all levels, brought to you by New Global Adventures, creators of the popular VALENCIA Trail Race and SPACEROCK Trail Race.

Set in the historic Placerita Canyon, where gold was first discovered in 1842, this race takes you through some of the most stunning and diverse landscapes in Santa Clarita, CA. From challenging hills and winding trails to breathtaking panoramic views, you’ll experience why Southern California is home to some of the best trail running in the country.

Don’t miss your chance to be part of this epic race experience—register today and secure your spot at the start line!

AWESOME TRAILS
Run along flowing singletrack trails that wind through East Walker Ranch Open Space with a few killer hills to climb and a blissfully long downhill as you journey through the sun-kissed golden hills of Santa Clarita.

360 VIEWS
Conquer the heart-pounding climbs to reach the sweet ridgelines and be rewarded with breathtaking panoramic views stretching across the stunning Santa Clarita Valley.

NATURE
Leave the concrete jungle behind and immerse yourself in nature’s beauty and reconnect with the peaceful, healing landscapes to recharge the body, mind, and spirit.

CAMPING
Camping at the race adds to the overall race experience for relay teams and ultra runners. Giving you a home base for the perfect setup to push your limits with confidence.

NOTE: Relay team registrations are available on the official race website. 

Learn more and see full race details at SantaClaritaTrailRace.com

Whether you’re a first-time trail runner or a seasoned athlete, the Santa Clarita Trail Race has something to match your fitness level and goals. Prepare for an epic trail race experience!

Step into the golden trails of California and join us for the Santa Clarita Trail Race—an unforgettable trail running experience for all levels, brought to you by New Global Adventures, creators of the popular VALENCIA Trail Race and SPACEROCK Trail Race.

Set in the historic Placerita Canyon, where gold was first discovered in 1842, this race takes you through some of the most stunning and diverse landscapes in Santa Clarita, CA. From challenging hills and winding trails to breathtaking panoramic views, you’ll experience why Southern California is home to some of the best trail running in the country.

Don’t miss your chance to be part of this epic race experience—register today and secure your spot at the start line!

AWESOME TRAILS
Run along flowing singletrack trails that wind through East Walker Ranch Open Space with a few killer hills to climb and a blissfully long downhill as you journey through the sun-kissed golden hills of Santa Clarita.

360 VIEWS
Conquer the heart-pounding climbs to reach the sweet ridgelines and be rewarded with breathtaking panoramic views stretching across the stunning Santa Clarita Valley.

NATURE
Leave the concrete jungle behind and immerse yourself in nature’s beauty and reconnect with the peaceful, healing landscapes to recharge the body, mind, and spirit.

CAMPING
Camping at the race adds to the overall race experience for relay teams and ultra runners. Giving you a home base for the perfect setup to push your limits with confidence.

NOTE: Relay team registrations are available on the official race website. 

Learn more and see full race details at SantaClaritaTrailRace.com

name: Santa Claus For A Cause 5K/10K
description:
Santa Claus with a Cause 5K/10K
📅 Saturday, December 12th, 2026
📍 Bolsa Chica State Beach – Lot 25, Huntington Beach, CA

Get ready for the ultimate Santa celebration at Bolsa Chica State Beach!
This isn’t just a race, it’s a full-blown Christmas experience.

You’ll run along the beach surrounded by falling snow, live carolers, festive music, and holiday cheer. Every runner receives their choice of a full Santa suit, cozy Santa beanie, or custom-designed race shirt, plus one of the biggest, most festive finisher Santa medal designed to double as a Christmas ornament.

And the best part? This race GIVES BACK. Proceeds from the event help gift staple goods, schooling, and hope to villages in Africa and Nepal, as well as supporting local health initiatives.

 
🎄 Race Day Fun & Schedule
Arrive early and soak up the holiday spirit. There’s so much happening before the race even starts!

6:30 – 8:15 AM: Registration and bib pick-up open at Lot 25. Walk-up registrations are welcome, so bring your friends!

7:00 – 9:00 AM: The REAL Santa 🎅 will be on-site for festive selfie photos (use hashtag #carenwareevents or tag us caren.ware.events). Lil Dickens Carolers will be singing, and snow will be falling to set the perfect holiday mood.

8:00 AM: Kids take center stage with the Ho Ho Ho Dashes (200m, 400m, ½ mile, and 1 mile). Cheer on the little elves as they dash through the holiday magic!

8:15 AM Holiday Costume Contest

8:20 AM: Warm up with the Penguin Macarena! Everyone is invited to join in. Best Costume and Best Christmas Spirit awards are given out here, so come dressed to impress.

8:30 AM: MASS START for the 5K & 10K! Your official time begins when you cross under the start arch, but you must cross by 8:40 AM to be officially timed.

9:20 AM – 5K Awards Ceremony

9:40 AM – 10K Awards Ceremony

11:00 AM - Expo Festivities End

 
🎁 What’s Included
Your registration comes packed with holiday cheer! Every participant receives chip-timed results for the 5K or 10K, so you can track your performance. You’ll also get to choose your festive swag, whether you want to run in a full Santa suit, stay cozy in a Santa beanie, or sport a custom-designed Santa race shirt.

When you cross the finish line, you’ll receive one of the biggest custom Santa-at-the-beach medal that doubles as a Christmas ornament to hang proudly on your tree.

Throughout the morning, enjoy a lively holiday atmosphere with falling snow, live carolers, games, and photo ops with the REAL Santa. Prizes will be awarded for Best Christmas Spirit, Best Costume, and even Best Dressed Doggie, so bring your creativity and holiday cheer.

And don’t leave hungry, we’ll have food vendors on-site serving tamales, tacos, specialty coffee, cookies, fresh fruit and more. Plan on enjoying breakfast by the beach with us after your run!

And for the competitors, we have three-deep age division awards in five-year increments — from ages 1-10 all the way through 85+.

 
📅 Early Packet Pick-Up- Optional
Race Day Pick-Up: 6:30 – 8:15 AM at Lot 25
Early Pick-Up: TBD
(No ID required, and you may pick up for others.)
 
🚗 Parking & Drop-Off
Bolsa Chica State Beach Lot 25 parking is $15 per vehicle (cash or state park pass recommended). The main gate opens at 6:00 AM — use the main entrance only.

Drop-off is available at the corner of Warner & PCH. Free public parking is also available in Sunset Beach (behind Jack in the Box) if you’d like to walk in.

Restrooms

Restrooms are open and located on each end of lot 25.

Strollers
Strollers are welcome! Please stay to the right and use at your own risk. Only registered participants with a bib will receive a finisher medal. Be sure your bib is worn on the front and visible to finish line staff.

Pets:

Friendly Pets are allowed and must be leashed at all times and accompanied by a Run /Walk participant.  Please use a leash of 5 ft or less, for the safety of all pets and runners.  Line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course.

Weather

Rain or shine, the event will go on
 

 
🎥 More Than Just a Race
Santa Claus with a Cause is the race that GIFTS BACK. Your participation helps provide staple goods, education, and training to those in need around the world.

📺 Watch our global giving journey: YouTube: Caren.Ware.Events
📚 Visit the Caren Ware booth on race day for book signings of Finding Fit — an inspiring story about running through life’s challenges.

 
💡 Register today, join the celebration, and make this holiday season unforgettable, for you AND for others.

name: Santa Cruz Sunrise Rotary Firecracker Run
description:
Year 41 — and America's 250th Birthday!

This is the one you don't want to miss.
The Santa Cruz Sunrise Rotary Club is fired up to bring you the 2026 Firecracker — and this year is unlike any other. Our nation is celebrating its 250th birthday, and we're throwing the party Santa Cruz style: lace up your shoes, hit the pavement, and kick off Independence Day the way this community has for over four decades at Harvey West Park, Santa Cruz CA.

We're calling all runners, walkers, families, and friends — our goal is 1,000+ runners this year! 

That's right. We want to make the 2026 Firecracker the biggest in our history. So grab your crew, sign up your neighbors, rope in your coworkers, and let's pack Harvey West Park on the Fourth of July. Whether you're chasing a PR or pushing a stroller, there's a course for you.

name: Santa Cruz Trail Run
description:
Giant redwoods dominate the landscape in our Santa Cruz Trail Run. Aside from coiling single-track that opens up to expansive roads and paths–and even sand–participants will enjoy the ocean breezes pouring in from the Santa Cruz coast. This race delivers everything from river crossings to high ridges with aid stations every 5-6 miles for refueling before tackling the next beautiful, albeit strenuous, section. This is a perfect race for family and friends to attend. They can cheer, enjoy Henry Cowell park, and consume post-race food fit for a trail running king or queen!

Park Information: Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park

Start Times:
30K – 8:30 AM
Half – 8:45 AM
10K – 9:00 AM

Check-In & Bib Pickup:
Race Morning: 7:30 AM – 9:00 AM

Time Limit: There is a 6 hour time limit for the race. All runners must be off the course by 2:30 PM.

Capacity: The Santa Cruz Trail Run has a capacity of 330 runners, across all distances.

Parking:  Parking at Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park is $10.00. There is limited parking along Highway 9 outside of the park. To save some money, we recommend you carpool from Felton (minutes away from the park) or Santa Cruz.

Directions:
Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park
101 North Big Trees Park Road, Felton, CA 95018
Click for Directions

Timing:  All races are professionally chip timed, utilizing MyLaps and Race Director, ensuring your time is captured as accurately as possible. Disposable chips are attached to back of each bib number.

Post Race:  We offer a broad selection of sweet and salty snacks, as well as fresh fruit and a diverse line up of pre-packaged food options (chips, cakes, jerkey, etc.).

Dog Policy:  Sorry, no dogs are allowed within Henry Cowell Redwoods State Park.

name: Santa Cruz Triathlon
description:
The Santa Cruz Triathlon is a popular, scenic, non-profit race offering Sprint and International (Olympic) distances, plus relays, aquabike, and an aquathlon option, known for its coastal course along West Cliff Drive and along Highway 1. Its an ocean swim around the iconic Santa Cruz Wharf, a spacious transition area on a soccer field, then riding out along West Cliff and Highway 1 to the quaint town of Davenport and back. Then finish with a beautiful run along West Cliff and finish on Cowells Beach. 

This is great for beginners and veterans alike, with proceeds funding local high school and college athletics in Santa Cruz County. It's a long-running event that donates significantly to youth sports, featuring a sheltered ocean swim and largely closed-course bike and run, creating a fun, community-focused event.

name: Santa To The Sea 1/2 Marathon, 1/4 Marathon & 5K
description:
Santa to the Sea is a nonprofit event born out of a desire to give back to the community. What started in 2003 as a toy drive to celebrate the relocation of the world’s largest Santa Claus from Carpinteria to Oxnard, has grown into a robust running event, toy drive, and community fundraiser. Santa to the Sea includes a half marathon, a Quarter Marathon plus a 5K run and 1K kids fun run. The Santa to the Sea Scholarship Fund partners with Gene Haas and Oxnard College Foundation to award $500 scholarships to local high school students and adults continuing their education at Oxnard College. 

Santa to the Sea offers families not only a weekend of fun, but also an opportunity to give back to those in need, just in time for the holiday season. The nonprofit event helps collect toys for underprivileged children throughout Ventura County while raising scholarship money for students at Oxnard College.

The Half Marathon gets underway at the giant Santa located along the Interstate Highway 101 (2801 Ventura Boulevard) and continues through the strawberry fields of Oxnard before heading to historic downtown Oxnard (where the Quarter Marathon starts) and ending at Marine Emporium Landing (where the 5k and kids 1k start and finish) in picturesque Channel Islands Harbor. There, visitors can enjoy the Finish Line Festival filled with a full day of activities including kids play area, a Santa’s Village, costume contests, food booths and live entertainment.

The Santa to the Sea Half Marathon, Quarter Marathon and 5k, is based in the coastal com­mu­nity of Oxnard, CA., and just 40 min­utes north of Los Angeles. Combine your athletic pursuits with a seaside weekend getaway during the annual Santa to the Sea Half Marathon, 1/4 marathon, 5K run and 1k kids fun run taking place the second Sunday every December.

name: Santiago Canyon College’s Hawk's Flight 5K
description:
Join us on Saturday, March 21st, for the annual Hawks Flight 5K Run/Fun Run/Walk at Santiago Canyon College. Nestled at the foot of the stunning Santiago Mountains, our scenic campus offers a perfect setting for runners and walkers of all levels. Experience a fast, runner-friendly course that winds through lush landscapes and top-tier facilities. Whether you're aiming for a personal best or simply enjoying the view, come spread your wings and take flight with us on this unforgettable race day!

 

All proceeds from the event will be donated towards a scholarship for one female and one male student from one of our local high schools.

name: SAPR Golf Tournament
description:
Support SAPR for Sexual Assault Awareness Month with a 18-hole Golf Tournament. Scramble Rules apply! Gather your foursome and compete for prizes. Event registration includes a buffet lunch at the Golf Clubhouse and prize opportunities.

Lunch buffet will be fried chicken with mashed potatoes, veggies, rolls and a fountain drink. 

Prizes for longest drive, closest to the pin, overall winning team, and opportunity drawings at lunch time. 

Pre-arranged foursomes encouraged, however open to all singles, doubles, etc (will be paired up with others to create a foursome). Towards the end of registration, you will be asked for your team name. Please make sure all players input same team name to be paired up together.

name: SAPR Run/Walk
description: Run or walk in honor of those affected by sexual assault. Groups and commands are encouraged to register together. All abilities and ages are welcome.

name: SAR Wild Run
description:
An event for the entire family, join us for this Fresno County Search And Rescue FUNdraiser!  Starting 1/4mi North of the intersection of Dinkey Creek Rd. & Fishing Club Rd, on the South side of Shaver Lake, experience the beautiful Sierra scenery of Shaver Lake, breathtaking meadows, forests and cool streams all for a good cause. Participants receive a technical event shirt, unique medallion, chip timing and BBQ prepared by the Fresno County Sheriff's Search and Rescue Team!

The 10k Trail Run is a 20 point race in the CLASSIC Runner of the Year Series.

name: Sasquatch Trail Run
description:
There is noises coming from the Dry Creek Preserve...Just before summer Sasquatch makes an appearance for just one day in the month of May. Are you ready to race through the Dry Creek Preserve and come face to face with Sasquatch? This Premier 5k has high end Swag and is a family friendly event. Bring your camera and let's hope you aren't the slowest runner

This is a Live Race and on Private Property

All Finisher's Receive:

  • Sasquatch Finisher T-Shirt (Size not guaranteed after 5/4/25
  • Custom Medal for all Adult Participants
  • FREE Race Photos
  • Bananas and Muffins
  • Music
  • Chip Timed with Live Results

Age Groups: 19 and under, 20-29, 30-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-69, 70+

Kids Race (Age 12 and under)

  • Sasquatch T-shirt
  • Sasquatch Kids Finisher Medal
  • FREE Race Photos
  • Kid Snacks

Who we Support

A large portion of proceeds will be donated to Dry Creek Preserve in Woodlake, CA. The property is 152 Acres and is free to the public.

Sequoia Riverlands Trust is a nonprofit organization that owns and manages six nature preserves including Dry Creek Preserve. It is our mission to keep these beautiful places open for the public. Accordingly, there is no fee to visit our preserves. However, we do ask that you donate to help us keep these spaces available for generations to come.

Event organized by Sierra Cascades Muiltisport Productions

name: SCAD Research Inc. - Giving Tuesday Campaign
description:
Spontaneous Coronary Artery Dissection (SCAD) is a little-known and often misunderstood cause of heart attacks. Most patients are young, healthy, active women who have none of the typical risk factors for heart disease. Although less common, SCAD can affect men as well. It can recur—and it can be fatal. More research is urgently needed to identify the causes and determine the most effective treatments.

SCAD is the #1 cause of heart attacks in women under age 50, including pregnant women and new mothers.

This holiday season, we invite you to support this vital work. Your contribution helps fund research that brings us closer to answers, improved treatments, and lives saved.

Be part of our Giving Tuesday campaign!
SCAD Research, Inc. is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. Your donation is tax-deductible.

description:

name: Screenland 5K
description:
5k Starts at 9:00 am.

Follow the yellow brick road with Dorothy, Toto and the Munchkins pursued by the Wicked Witch of the West, experiencing legendary movie and television experiences. Finish on the red carpet with Scarlett O'Hara, Rhett Butler and paparazzi at our star-studded 9th Annual family fun 5K adventure in the Heart of Screenland.  This year's costume contest theme is "Glitz, Glamour, Glory & Gold."

All participants will receive a commemorative bib, official time, medal, shirt, on-course support and entertainment, entrance into the post-race party, and free downloadable event photos.

Beach to City Challenge

Screenland 5K + BRA Run = Bonus bling featuring the fabulous Greta Garbo! 

This cinematic legend and breast cancer survivor called Culver City home, so we are celebrating her with the Beach to City Challenge! 

You must do both events back to back. You can do the Screenland 5K and then either the 5K or the 15K at the BRA Run and you will be able to claim the bonus medal at the finish line festival of the BRA Run on August 24, 2025 at Dockweiler Beach.  If you missed Screenland in 2024, you can start the challenge at Screenland in March and finish it at BRA Run in August.

We will be publishing a list of those who are qualified on the BRA Run website in August, before that event. You can check there to make sure we have you on the list after you register.

Sign up for both events at the same time or register for the BRA Run at the finish line festival after the Screenland 5K in 2025, and get a discount on registration.

More info about the BRA Run 5k & 13K at www.BRArunLA.com.

October 18, 2026

name: Sea Splash Color Dash 5K
description:
The City of Port Hueneme and the Port of Hueneme are co-hosting the “Sea Slash Color Dash 5K and Kids 1K” event, which is set to occur on Saturday, March  21, 2026, at Hueneme Beach. Participation in the 5K is $25 a runner, with the race beginning at 9:00 am sharp, and the Kids 1K is $10 per child that will begin at 10:30 am sharp. All registered participants will receive a bib, t-shirt, and medal. There will be an awards ceremony for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place winners in different age categories.

 

Kids 1K Information:

Registration to participate as a runner closes on Sunday, March 1st, or once we reach 650 participants for the 5K and 150 participants for the Kids 1K. The Kids 1K will open to ages 12 and under and must be accompanied to the venue by an adult, but does not have to participate. Parents or guardians who wish to run alongside their child will be required to sign a waiver onsite and must check in to be issued a wristband. Only the registered child will receive a bib, participation medal, and t-shirt. 

 

Both races will feature a "color run" theme, with the "color" element represented by a final fishline tunnel segment in a designated zone along the competition route. Participation in the color run spray is optional, and an alternative competition path is available for those who prefer not to participate in the color segment. 

 

The FREE Health Wellness Fair following the conclusion of the race will be located in Parking Lot “C”; featuring health career educational booths, a children’s activity area, healthy food vendors, live entertainment, and much more.

 

Event Hours: 9:00am - 12:00pm

Weather: This is a rain or shine event!

Restrooms: We will have bathroom trailers on site, including an ADA-accessible restroom. 

Food: Healthy food trucks will be on-site, offering food and drinks for purchase. This is a non-alcoholic event.

 

Runner Packet Pick-Up: Saturday, March 14th, from 10:00 am - 2:00 pm, and Friday, March 20th, from 9:00 am - 4:30 pm

at the Orvene S. Carpenter Community Center located at 550 Park Ave, Port Hueneme, CA.

 

Please stay tuned for more details by following us on the City of Port Hueneme’s Facebook, Instagram @PortHuenemeRec, or the designated race website.

For questions, please call Recreation & Community Services at 805-986-6542.

 

**Please note: There are no refunds for this event. Once the race is filled, the event will not reopen for further registrations.

description:
Come join us for our 5th annual 5k fun run on Saturday, April 18th! Event held at St. Elizabeth Ann Seton Church.

“Running for Faith to Build our Future” is a Fun Run 5k hosted by the MOMS at SEAS ministry of St. Elizabeth Ann Seton Catholic Church benefiting the church’s Building Fund. name: Season of the Witch 5K 10K by Califlow Runs
description:
🖤 Season of the Witch Run
5K & 10K • Long Beach

📍 Location:
5000 E Ocean Blvd
Granada Beach, Long Beach, CA

🖤 Season of the Witch Run
5K & 10K • Long Beach

Spooky season starts early in Long Beach.

Step into the Season of the Witch Run, a magical 5K & 10K experience where movement meets mysticism and the coastline becomes your coven. Witches, warlocks, mystics, and magical beings of all kinds are invited to lace up, costume up, and run into fall with us.

Set against the ocean backdrop at Granada Beach, this is more than a race — it’s a ritual.

Before the miles begin, gather for our Witch Warm-Up Ritual, a guided movement flow designed to awaken your body, focus your energy, and set your intention. Because how you start matters.

As the sun rises, we take off together — capes flowing, brooms flying, spells activated — for a scenic, flat, and fast coastal run that’s welcoming to runners, joggers, and walkers alike.

After you cross the finish line, the magic continues.

Stay for our Spellbound Stretch Cool Down, a grounding yoga session by the ocean to help your body recover, release, and restore. Then explore our Witchy Fair & Finish Line Festival, featuring psychic and tarot readers, crystals, mystical vendors, music, and some of the most epic photo ops of the season.

🧙‍♀️ Costumes are highly encouraged, and we’ll be awarding our Best Witch / Warlock Costume — so bring the drama, the sparkle, or the spooky glam.

✨ This is your reminder that movement is powerful.
✨ Healing can be playful.
✨ And running can be magic.

Come cast your spell with us.

 

⏰ Schedule:

Bib Pickup: 6:30 AM

Same Day Registration: 6:30 AM
Witch Warm-Up Ritual: 7:40 AM
5K & 10K Start: 8:00 AM


🧙‍♀️ Costumes Encouraged!
Witches, warlocks, mystics, and magical beings welcome.

 
✨ What’s Included
⏱️ Professional chip timing
📸 Free race-day photos
🏅 Witchy-themed finisher medal
🏆 Overall & age group awards
🎧 Live DJ & finish-line festival
🔮 Witchy Fair with tarot readers, crystals & vendors
🧘‍♀️ Spellbound Stretch Cool Down Yoga
👟 Stroller & walker friendly
🐕 Dog-friendly
 
🌙 Bonus Experiences
Witch Warm-Up Ritual – set intentions & awaken the body
Best Witch / Warlock Costume Contest
Epic photo ops throughout the course & finish area
✨ Heal your body through movement. Run the spell. Feel the magic.

name: Seasonal Confusion 5K. 10K. Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
😵‍💫 SEASONAL CONFUSION RUN
5K • 10K • Half Marathon

📅 Sunday, September 13
📍 5100 E Ocean Blvd, Granada Beach | Long Beach, CA

Sweater or bikini?
Iced coffee or pumpkin spice?
It’s California — we’re officially in a state of seasonal confusion.

The Seasonal Confusion Run celebrates that weird in-between moment when summer won’t let go, fall is pretending to arrive, and the weather absolutely refuses to cooperate. Come run the coast in whatever makes sense to you — hoodie, tank top, or beachwear encouraged.

 
🏁 Race Day Schedule
• Half Marathon: 7:00 AM
• 5K & 10K: 7:30 AM

Same-Day Registration & Bib Pickup:
Opens at 6:00 AM

 
🌊 Why You’ll Love It
Flat, fast, scenic beach path course
Beginner- and walker-friendly
Strollers welcome
Dogs on leash welcome 🐾
Professional chip timing
Free race-day photos
Overall & age group awards
Finish line festival vibes
 
🍔 Post-Race Perk
Run first, refuel after.

Take your bib just steps from the finish line to Monty’s Dog Beach Café and receive 20% off food when you present your race bib.

 
💛 Why CaliFlow Runs
Life doesn’t wait for perfect conditions — and neither do we.

CaliFlow Runs creates inclusive, feel-good races where everyone belongs. Whether you’re racing hard, walking it out, running with your pup, or just here for the vibes, this is a space to move, breathe, laugh, and enjoy the moment.

It may not be fall yet.
It may not be summer anymore.
But it is a great day to run.

name: Shadow of the Giants 50k & 20k Run
description:
Event Information:

 36th Annual Shadow of the Giants 20k & 50k
Experience the Magic of the Sierra National Forest
Join us for the 36th Annual Shadow of the Giants 20k & 50k, an unforgettable race through the scenic and historic trails of the Sierra National Forest. 

Time Limit for 50k: 8 hours - 9hours with an Early Start

Important Notice: Pets are not allowed on the trail, so please leave your furry friends at home.

Pre-Race Accommodations and Dinner
For those interested, we are offering the option to stay onsite the night before the race on Friday, June 6th at Camp Green Meadows in the dorms. Additionally, join us for our traditional pre-race lasagna dinner on Friday, June 5th at approximately 5:45 PM in the Green Meadows Dining Hall.

Race Day Schedule
50k Start Time: 7:00 AM
20k Start Time: 7:15 AM
Early Starts Available: 6:00 AM (Early starters are not eligible for overall awards, they are eligible for Age Group Awards)

Course Information
Detailed course maps and updates will be provided, closer to the race day

Aid Stations: Located roughly 5-7 miles apart, our aid stations will be well-stocked with food, Gels, Electrolyte drink, water, Coca-Cola, ginger ale, and a variety of sweet and salty snacks.

Guidelines:

No pacers.
No dogs.

Poles are permitted.
Fun and smiles are mandatory!

Post-Race Celebration
After the race, you’re invited to hang out at Green Meadows to cheer on fellow runners. Post-race food and beverages will be provided in the Dining Hall. Bring a chair, a pop-up tent or umbrella, and enjoy the camaraderie.

BIB Pickup

When: Friday, June 5th
Time: 3:00 PM - 5:30 PM
Where: Camp Green Meadows Outdoor School in Fish Camp, CA, in the Cafeteria
Race Day Bib Pick-Up:

When: Saturday, June 6th
Time: 5:40 AM - 6:45 AM
Where: Cafeteria at Camp Green Meadow Outdoor School
Note: No pets or dogs are allowed on the Green Meadows Campus, except for service animals.

Staying at Camp Green Meadows
Arrival: Do not arrive before 1:15 PM on Friday, June 5th
Check-In: Begins at 1:30 PM in the Cafeteria. Bunks are first-come, first-served. No check-ins after 8:00 PM.
What to Bring: Bedding, pillow, sleeping bag/blankets
Shared Space Etiquette: Respect others and keep noise levels down. Quiet time starts at 9:00 PM.
Facilities: Showers and restrooms available onsite.
Trash: All trash must be removed before departure.
Camping: Tent camping is not allowed on campus. There is dispersed camping in the area. 
Parking: Large or oversized vehicles like RVs are not permitted on campus. You may park on nearby Forest Service Roads.

Pre-Race Dinner
If you’ve purchased a ticket for our pre-race dinner, it will start around 5:45 PM - 6:00 PM in the Cafeteria at Camp Green Meadows. The dinner will include lasagna, salad, bread, and drinks. No additional tickets will be sold as meals are prepared based on pre-orders.

Parking Guidelines
Do Not Block Roadways: Ensure clear access in and out of Green Meadows.
Parking Locations: Once the parking lot at Green Meadows is full, you may park on the shoulder of the camp entrance or on the dirt road shoulder just before the camp entrance. Do not block roadways.
Alternative Parking: You may park off Jackson Road near the final turn down onto the single track that leads to the finish line. It’s a pleasant half-mile walk from there with no parking issues.
Changing Distances
You may switch to the 20k distance at any time up until race day. Changes can be made at bib pick-up or at the timing tent at the start/finish area.

Course Cutoff
The cutoff time for completing the 50k course is 3:00 PM. Early starters (6:00 AM start) have until 3:00 PM to finish, giving them a total of 9 hours.

Start Times for Saturday, June 6th, 2026
50k Early Start: 6:00 AM (Please be self-sufficient until Aid Station #2)
50k Regular Start: 7:00 AM
20k Start: 7:15 AM

BIB Pickup

When: Friday, June 5th
Time: 3:00 PM - 5:30 PM
Where: Camp Green Meadows Outdoor School in Fish Camp, CA, in the Cafeteria
Race Day Bib Pick-Up:

When: Saturday, June 6th
Time: 5:40 AM - 6:45 AM
Where: Cafeteria at Camp Green Meadow Outdoor School
Note: No pets or dogs are allowed on the Green Meadows Campus, except for service animals.

Arrival: Do not arrive before 1:15 PM on Friday, June 5th

You may switch to the 20k distance at any time up until race day. Changes can be made at bib pick-up or at the timing tent at the start/finish area.

The cutoff time for completing the 50k course is 3:00 PM. Early starters (6:00 AM start) have until 3:00 PM to finish, giving them a total of 9 hours.

50k Early Start: 6:00 AM (Please be self-sufficient until Aid Station #2)
50k Regular Start: 7:00 AM
20k Start: 7:15 AM

name: Shamrocked: The  Friday the 13th  After Dark - 5K. 10K. Half Marathon
description:
☘️ Camp Shamrocked: The Unlucky Run
🌲 Friday the 13th – 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach
5K | 10K | Half Marathon
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803
📅 Friday, March 13, 2026
🕓 Check-In: 4:00 PM
Start Times | Half: 5:00 PM | 10K & 5K: 6:30 PM

 
💀 About the Event
Welcome back, campers… and may the luck be ever in your disfavor. 🍀
They say strange things happen every Friday the 13th — but when it lands right before St. Patrick’s Day, you can bet the leprechauns are up to no good.

Join us for Camp Shamrocked: The Unlucky Run, a moonlit race where green fog meets grit, and superstition takes the scenic route down the Long Beach shoreline. Whether you’re chasing a PR or just chasing your luck, you’ll be part of something rare — a tribe that runs through the chaos with heart, humor, and a little mischief.

 
🌊 What to Expect
USATF-Certified Course
Chip Timing for accurate results ⏱️
Free Race-Day Photos by Nina & Dre 📸
Finisher Medals for All Participants 🏅
Overall & Age Group Awards
3 On-Course Water Stations (one at each turnaround)
Campfire Finish Line Festival 🔥
Costume Contest – Leprechauns, Lucky Charms & Creatures of the Night 👻
DJ, Lights & Green Glow Effects for that signature CaliFlow After-Dark magic
Runners, Walkers, and Shamrocked Souls of All Paces Welcome!
 
🌕 Course Info
The course begins under the glowing CaliFlow arch near Belmont Pier, winding along the oceanfront path under the light of the moon (and maybe a little mischief).

Expect glowing green markers, fog  and checkpoints straight out of Camp Shamrocked lore:
🍀 Cabin 13 — where luck runs thin
🪞 The Clover Crossing — every 13th step’s a gamble
🔥 The Campfire Finish — where legends light up the night

Half Marathon: 3 × 4.36-mile loops
10K: 2 × 5K out-and-backs
5K: 1 loop

Each station will be fully stocked with water, encouragement, and a few surprises to keep your spirits high and your luck questionable.

 
🧿 The Vibe – Welcome to Camp Shamrocked
At CaliFlow Runs, we don’t chase luck — we create it. This is your chance to laugh in the face of superstition, defy the odds, and dance your way across that finish line under a canopy of stars and green glow.

So grab your glow sticks, pull on something lucky (or not), and join us for the most unforgettable Friday the 13th run of the year.

✨ Not just a race. Join the movement.

name: Sharon's Ride.Run.Walk. 2026
description:
Join the Epilepsy Foundation of San Diego for the 2026 Sharon's Ride.Run.Walk., a movement that brings our community together to educate, spread awareness, and make a difference for the people we love who live with epilepsy.

This event is dedicated to the memory of Sharon Rosenfeld, a nurse and teacher who cared deeply about epilepsy and advocated helmet safety. Click here to learn more about Sharon and helmet safety.

After you cross the finish line, there will be a community picnic with live music, food trucks, lawn games, and more. We encourage families to bring their own blankets, beach chairs, and umbrellas.

Sharon's Ride.Run.Walk. San Diego is a 15-mile Bike Ride or 5K Run/Walk, but it’s more than that.

It matters because

  • 1 in 10 will have a seizure in their lifetime
  • 1 in 26 will be diagnosed with epilepsy
  • 50,000 San Diegans live with epilepsy
  • 3.4 million individuals nationwide are affected by epilepsy

Epilepsy is more than seizures. Every story matters in this fight. Follow us on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and LinkedIn to meet our San Diego community affected by epilepsy and read personal stories of why this matters.

Schedule of events

  • 8:00am: Registration opens and packet pick-up
  • 9:15am: 15-mile Bike Ride start
  • 10:00am: 5K Run/Walk start
  • 11:00am to 1:00pm: Community picnic

Registration and fundraising

Funds raised from Sharon's Ride.Run.Walk. provide education and awareness, training programs on seizure recognition and first aid, as well as access to specialty and supportive care for the nearly 50,000 people affected by epilepsy here in San Diego.

People with epilepsy need our support more than ever. 80% of your registration fee is used for our no-cost programs and services to anyone affected by epilepsy.

  • Register as an individual, join a team, or create your own team.
    • With your registration, you will receive a FREE commemorative San Diego Sharon's Ride.Run.Walk. T-shirt. (T-shirt sizes must be placed by April 15 to guarantee your size. After April 15, t-shirts will be available on a first come, first served basis until we run out.)

Sharon's Ride.Run.Walk. San Diego is a 15-mile Bike Ride or 5K Run/Walk, but it’s more than that.

It matters because

  • 50,000 San Diegans live with epilepsy

name: Sharsheret West Coast Dash
description:
On Sunday, October 25, 2026, Sharsheret will gather hundreds of thrivers, caregivers, friends and supporters on the beach for our 5th Annual West Coast Dash in support of our breast and ovarian cancer work. Our run/walk will include a 5K Race, 10K Race, Family Fun Race, Virtual Race and Event Festival. Contributions excluding the value of race entry tickets are tax-deductible.

Schedule for Race Day, Sunday, October 25 (schedule subject to change)

6:00am – Parking Lots Open – First 200 cars will receive a free parking pass. Parking is $13. Please have cash available to expedite process.

7:00am – Registration and Festival Opens (Recommended 5K/10K arrival time)   

7:20am – Minyan 

8:00am – Welcome and Opening ceremony. 

8:20am - Warm Up and Walk to Start Line for 5K/10K

8:30am - 10K Start (Recommended Family Fun Race arrival time)

- 10K Race Course Map https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6202657963/ 

- 5K Race Course Map https://www.mapmyrun.com/routes/view/6202686184 

8:40am - 5K Start

9:25am – Family Fun Race Warm Up and Walk to Start Line for Family Fun Race

9:35am - Family Fun Race Start

- 1K Family Fun Race Course Map https://www.strava.com/routes/3401592517811740622  

10:00am – Awards Ceremony

BEACH CLEAN UP
Help us leave Dockweiler Beach cleaner than we found it! Join Shemesh Farms for a group beach clean up directly following the Dash.

Directions
12000 Vista Del Mar
Dockweiler Beach
Playa Del Rey, CA 90293

Waze and Apple Maps may misdirect you. Please follow the instructions below.
Freeway Route from 405N and 405S: Take the 105 Imperial Hwy past LAX towards the beach. Beach entry is at the end of Imperial Hwy where it passes Vista Del Mar.
City Streets from North: Take Pershing Drive south (NOTE ** Vista Del Mar will be closed North of Imperial Highway on race morning) until it hits Imperial Hwy. Make a right into the beach entry.
City Streets from South: Take Vista Del Mar north until it hits Imperial Hwy. Make a left into the beach entry.

Parking
Free parking: The first 200 cars will receive a free parking pass. Parking is $13 per car. Please have cash available to expedite process.
When you arrive: Please let the parking attendant know that you are with the event and be prepared with cash. The line to pay and park will get backed up so please arrive early.
Lots for parking: After you pay turn right and follow the road. There are three parking lots. We recommend parking in the 2nd lot. The 2nd lot is a 5 minute walk to the race start line and festival.
There is very limited parking in the 3rd lot and it is reserved for volunteers and those who require wheelchairs or other special needs. All race distances end in the 3rd and last lot. There is no exit from the 3rd lot while the event is going on. Anyone parked in the third lot will have to wait to leave until all races are complete. No vehicles will be able to leave the third lot before 10am.
_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Celebrate our Race Grand Marshals! 

Stay tuned for more information!

Race Entry

Run or walk on this fully paved course at Dockweiler Beach, just steps from the ocean with a cool morning breeze and incredible coastal views. Join us at the race festival with food, refreshments, entertainment and more, while helping to raise funds for those facing breast cancer, ovarian cancer, or at elevated genetic risk. 

5K / 10K  - Race entry tickets include a race t-shirt and finisher’s medal. Both races will be chip timed. Recommended for elementary school-age and above. 

Family Fun Race (1K) - Race Entry tickets are for ages 1 and up and include a race t-shirt and medal. This race is open to people of all abilities and generations of families running or walking together. This race will not be chip timed. Get ready for the photo opportunity!!

Virtual Race - Join us from anywhere around the country. Race tickets purchased by October 7th will receive a race t-shirt by mail.

Become a Team Captain for your family, friends, school, synagogue or company. Win awesome prizes and make your miles meaningful. 

All ages, abilities and strollers welcome.

Visit Sharsheret.org/westcoast for more information.

_________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Early Bird Packet Pickup Details

Thursday, October 22 from 4 - 7pm

Stay tuned for details about our LA Metro and Valley pickups!

name: Signal Hill Rotary Mutt Run 1K & 5K
description:
FINDING HOMES - ONE DOG AT A TIME

This is why we run!

2024 Event Photos

5K Course

1K Course

Run or walk at your pace with or without your dog.  The event starts at the Granada Launch Ramp (Rosie's Dog Beach) at 5000 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803 and the course follows along the scenic Long Beach shoreline. Park at the 54th & Claremont lot.

Race packet pick up is at the starting line on race day.  Please arrive by 7:30 am to allow sufficient time before the race.

 

EVENTS

  • 5K Runner-only (humans only) race starts at 8:30 am
  • 5K Mutt run (runner/walker plus dog) starts at 8:30 am
  • 1K Mutt run (runner/walker plus dog) starts at 8:45 am

DOGGIE DO'S and DON'T'S

  • All breeds of dogs welcome, not just mutts
  • Dogs must be leashed and stay on the pedestrian path at all times
  • Dogs must be non-aggressive with people and dogs

FUN INCLUSIONS AND POST-RACE EVENTS

  • Adoption event by the Long Beach Animal Care Services at the finish line and post-race festival
  • High quality race t-shirt for 1K and 5K participants
  • Finisher medal for all participants
  • Awards for top three 5K finishers

WHY WE RUN

  • 70% of proceeds will support the Long Beach Animal Care Services
  • 30% of the proceeds will go toward the community project fund at Signal Hill Rotary

name: Silicon Valley Kids Triathlon
description:
NEW LOCATION • NEW DATE 

Read below to make sure you understand the changes

The Silicon Valley Kids Triathlon (“SVKT”) is one of the country’s largest triathlons specifically for kids aged SIX through SEVENTEEN.

This year, we are moving to a new venue, the beautiful and recently opened Kathleen MacDonald High School. The swim will be in the pool and the run on the track as usual. The bike course will continue to be on closed roads. There should be plenty of parking, the bike course has easy spectator viewing, and the whole event will be more compact.

Because we are in a new venue with a smaller pool, we are cutting out some of the events that have been traditionally held in order to make the event smaller as we gain more experience with this venue.

Triathlon

There are two triathlon events to choose from. 

Competitive Triathlon is for kids aged 6 to 15 who are ready to race on their own. It is timed and there will be awards. No parents will be allowed in transition at any time. (We will have transition clinics to teach the kids everything they need to know.) Your child needs to be able to swim across the pool without stopping and without swim aids; no training wheels or balance bikes either.

The Super-Sprint is for kids 11 to 17. Kids 11 to 15 can choose the shorter distances of the traditional event or the longer distances of the Super-Sprint. 

Not sure which event to sign up for or if your child is ready for the competitive event? Read this guide.

Non-Competitive and Duathlon Events

There will be no Non-Competitive Events at this race. But Menlo Park and East Bay Kids Triathlons will still have them.

There will be no Duathlon either. There will be a Duathlon at the East Bay Kids Triathlon.

After some experience at this venue, we hope to bring these events back.

NorCal Youth State Series

This event is part of USA Triathlon's Youth State Series. Because there is so much overlap in participants, we will not have the Bay Area Kids Triathlon Series this year. We encourage everyone to participate in the entire state series, including the Sunnyvale Kids Splash and Dash (date TBD) and the Oakland Tri Club's Splash and Dash on October 25th. Series awards will be given out at the OTC Splash and Dash.

Youth Teams and Clinics

There are two youth teams in the area: TCMTriSquad Juniors in Santa Cruz and Santa Clara Counties and First Youth Triathlon Team (FYTT) in Menlo Park. Both put on clinics and workouts.

In addition, there will be several youth clinics -- especially practice tris and transition practice -- put on by Rolling Stumps Endurance. More details to be announced soon.

NEW DATE • MAY 10, 2026

Give your mom a break - race in the morning, celebrate in the afternoon!

Anyone who identifies as a mother will get a small surprise!

name: Silva Strong Superhero 5K Run & 2 Mile Walk
description:
The Silva Strong Run & Walk is an annual community event held in loving memory of Mayor Robert Silva, a dedicated leader who devoted his life to serving and strengthening the Mendota community. Known for his integrity, heart for public service, and commitment to youth and community development, Mayor Silva also served as the founding Chairperson of the Mendota Community Corporation.

This family-friendly event features a 5K Run, 2-Mile Walk, and a Kids Fun Run, welcoming participants of all ages and fitness levels. Whether you run, walk, or cheer from the sidelines, Silva Strong is a celebration of unity, resilience, and community pride.

Proceeds from the event benefit the Mendota Community Corporation, continuing Mayor Silva’s vision of uplifting and empowering the community he loved.

Join us as we come together to honor his legacy and show that Mendota remains Silva Strong.

name: Silver Moon Race: Kings River
description:
The Silver Moon Race is about challenging yourself, taking your endurance ability, and miles to new heights. Perfect for those who want to elevate from half marathons to marathons to ultramarathons.

You'll run in beautiful scenic locations in a 12K or for 6, 12, 24-hours, or 100-mile race on an awesome lap course. Go solo or in a 4-person team relay with your favorite running friends.

The race is always timed on a weekend closest to the full moon. Starting right before sunset and running through the night under the vibrant glow of the full moon and stars into the sunrise the next day.

Where in the world is Reedley? It is one of our favorite hidden gems nestled in the San Joaquin Valley of central California where much of the fruit we enjoy is grown.

Experience running through a beautiful scenic farm with orchards, vineyards, under the canopy of oak trees, and along the majestic Kings River in Reedley.

Get ready to have the Silver Moon Race become one of your favorite running experiences. Register today to reserve your spot!

Learn more at SilverMoonRace.com/kings-river/

You'll run in beautiful scenic locations in a 12K or for 6, 12, 24-hours, or 100-mile race on an awesome lap course. Go solo or in a 4-person team relay with your favorite running friends.

The race is always timed on a weekend closest to the full moon. Starting right before sunset and running through the night under the vibrant glow of the full moon and stars into the sunrise the next day.

Where in the world is Reedley? It is one of our favorite hidden gems nestled in the San Joaquin Valley of central California where much of the fruit we enjoy is grown.

Experience running through a beautiful scenic farm with orchards, vineyards, under the canopy of oak trees, and along the majestic Kings River in Reedley.

Get ready to have the Silver Moon Race become one of your favorite running experiences. Register today to reserve your spot!

Learn more at SilverMoonRace.com/kings-river/

name: SIXTO MALDONADO, JR. MEMORIAL 5K RUN / 2 MILE WALK
description:
Join us this fall for the Officer Sixto Maldonado, Jr. Memorial 5K Run & 2 Mile Walk, a special community event honoring the life and service of Officer Sixto Maldonado, Jr.

On August 19, 1975, Officer Maldonado made the ultimate sacrifice while serving the City of Firebaugh. Nearly 50 years later, we gather to remember his courage, dedication, and the lasting impact he left on our community.

This memorial run and walk isn’t just a tribute — it’s a way to carry his legacy forward. Proceeds from the event will fund a scholarship for graduating seniors at Firebaugh High School who plan to continue their education. It’s an opportunity for all of us to invest in the future of our youth and support the next generation as they work toward their goals.

Whether you run, walk, volunteer, or cheer from the sidelines, your participation makes a difference. Together, we can honor Officer Maldonado’s memory and help create brighter futures for our local students.

name: SJVDHA Pacing for Prevention
description:
Join the San Joaquin Valley Dental Hygienists’ Association (SJVDHA) for our annual Pacing for Prevention 5k! Together, we’ll take steps toward raising awareness and supporting groundbreaking research dedicated to the prevention, early detection, and treatment of head, neck, and oral cancers.

This year we will be raising funds to support the American Cancer Society. 

Bring your walking shoes, your friends, and your passion for making a difference!

Event Details:

Check In: 8:00am-9:00am

Race: 9:00 am

*Registration is $35 until the day of the race. Prices increase on race day to $40.

Trail: This moderately challenging 5k (3.1 miles) paved trail is stroller and dog-friendly. The path includes a few steep hills for an extra challenge and some nice views. It’s a comfortable, scenic route that’s easy to enjoy for all ages.

Event Highlights:

  • Family-friendly walk for all ages
  • Health and wellness booths
  • Opportunity to connect with local dental and health professionals
  • Oral Cancer Screenings for participants

name: Sloth Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🦥🏃‍♂️ The Sloth Run – Slow Is the New Fast! 🏃‍♀️🦥

Sloths will get there!

Tired of high-speed races and intense competition? Us too.
Welcome to the Sloth Run, where the pace is slow, the vibes are chill, and everyone's a winner (eventually).

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount!

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!

Be part of the Journey!

name: SludgeTrudge5k
description:
The Sacramento Area Section is hosting a 5k Event for CWEA Members, Friends, and Family. This event is to follow the closing sessions of AC26. 

This 5k is on a fully paved course at North Natomas regional park. All athletic abilities are welcome, you can walk or run the 5k.

This event is officially sanctioned and insured with USA track and field. It will be hosted and timed by Azteca FC.

Official results and race day photos will be available to all participants after the race has concluded. 

EMS services will be provided by Versa Care.

Top 3 overall female and male finishers will receive a medal. Top 3 finishers in each gender and age group will receive a ribbon.

name: SOCAL River Marathon - 26.2 - 13.1 - 10K - 5K
description:
The SOCAL River Marathon has four distances. Full Marathon, Half Marathon, 10K and 5K. 

This is a fun course in Southern California. This course runs on the Santa Ana River Trail from Yorba Linda to Huntington Beach State Park. This route truly spans Southern California from the dryer desert land to areas near Disneyland to the Beach. The course is primarily flat and straight but has a gradual downhill slant following the river to the ocean. This route is two years ago was cleaned up from homeless tents and is not fenced in nightly.

name: SoCal's Cinco De Miles 5K and 5 MILE
description:
Saturday. May 2, 2026 So Cal's Cinco de Miles 5k & 5 Miles

AT BOLSA CHICA STATE BEACH . Lot 25 

It's a  FULL FIESTA party run! Live Mariachi.  Folclórico dancing. FOOD festive RACE Event. 

Race, run, walk, or jog . Huge, unique custom cast medals with moving parts and a baby soft tech shirt fully designed front and back. NEW DESIGN each year. 

Come celebrate Mexican Culture with us. And be as victorious in your pursuit of health as those soldados were in their victory at the Battle of Puebla.  Sign up for 5K or 5 miles or run the 1-mile family fun run.   Have fun meeting people while celebrating culture. Running is universal.

RFIP CHIP TIMING and age division awards by Itz About Time.

COOL custom cast medals and Cinco De MILES authentic event t-shirts.  

EVERY PARTICIPANT RECEIVES: 

  • Custom Cinco de Miles cast medals
  • Cinco de Miles-themed event race shirts
  • Age division awards
  • RFID Chip timing by Itz About Time (itzabouttime.com)
  • Enjoy the music, the refreshments, and each other!
  • Caren Ware Events are designed for Every BODY and EVERYBODY! BEST THEMED ever races. 

RACE LOCATION:   BOLSA CHICA STATE BEACH (lot 25.)

PARKING:  Come in the main gate at 17851 Pacific Coast Hwy, Huntington Beach, Ca. 92649 and turn right, going to the very last lot which is closest to Warner and PCH.  Have $15 credit card ready at the gate per car, or a park pass.    You can also find limited free and hourly parking behind the Jack in the Box on PCH and Warner and along that inner road in Sunset Beach, and jog into the state park on running sidewalk. 

EARLY RACE PACKET PICK-UP is for your convenience or you may pick up the bib and shirt on race day at the race site.  You may pick up for others.  

PACKET PICK UP:   Friday, May 1st , 2026 .  Lunch time:  noon to 3pm

ROAD RUNNER SPORTS 1835 Newport Blvd Costa Mesa, Ca. 92627

RACE DAY SCHEDULES:

6:30 am  Registration OPENS
               Shirts are given with bibs at registration.  Medals when you finish

7:45 am to 8:15 am Folclórico Performance, Dancing Horses, Mariachi Music

8:00 am START of Cinco de Mile fun run. (1 Mile) 

8:15 am START of Kid's Carrera. (400 yards) 

8:30 am Mass START of 5K/5 Mile

9:15 am Start of 5k AWARDS CEREMONY

9:30 am Start of the 5-mile AWARD CEREMONY

Bring EXTRA CASH FOR STREET TACOS, AGUA FRESCA, FRESH FRUIT, GALLETINAS AND SPECIALTY COFFEES.

FINISHER MEDALS to every Finisher

AGE DIVISION AWARDS:

5-year Age Spans:  3 deep with 5-year age spans:  5k and 5 Mile  1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80&over 

Top  3 Overall Trophies to Males & Females     Plus award to Oldest finisher. Youngest finisher. 

Pets: Friendly Pets are allowed and must be leashed at all times and accompanied by a Run /Walk participant.  Please use a leash of 5 ft or less, for the safety of all pets and runners.  Line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course.

Stroller: Families can bring strollers, but agree to use at their own risk.  We do ask that you line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course. Note, that only registered participants with a BIB will receive a finisher medal.

Please make sure your BIB is in the front and visible to our volunteers.  And watch for cyclists enjoying the same beach bike path you are running on.

The race will take place rain or shine.  RESTROOMS are in the public buildings at the end of each of the parking lots.

8:30 am MASS START for both 5k/10K   Kid's Dash 8:00 am

name: SoCal's Sunset Trick or Trot 5k/10K - Halloween Race
description:
🎃 SoCal’s Sunset Trick or Trot 5K/10K

📅 Saturday, October 24th, 2026 | 🕔 5:00 PM (NOTE TIME. INTO the SUNSET
📍 Bolsa Chica State Beach – Lot 25
🌅 Featuring a TRUNK-or-TREAT EXPO that begins at 3pm

 
🕯️ A Spooky New Twist on a Fall Favorite!
Formerly known as the FIT FALL Halloween Harvest 5K/10K, our traditional morning run is now even more magical as an evening event! 🌙

Get ready to run (or trot!) into the sunset with beach views, Halloween fun, and festive activities for the whole family. Introducing the SoCal’s Sunset Trick or Trot 5K/10K—a coastal celebration where fitness meets fall!

 
🎉 What to Expect:
👟 5K & 10K Sunset Run
🎃 Trunk-or-Treat Expo
📸 Selfie Stations, Games & Giveaways
🏅 Custom Reversible Finisher Medal
👕 Fall-Themed Event Shirt
🧛 Costume Contests & Awards
🧃 Street Tacos, Aguas Frescas, Specialty Coffee, Cookies & More!
 
🕒 Race Day Schedule:
2:00 PM – Trunk-or-Treat Car Setup
3:00 PM – Registration & Packet Pickup Opens
4:30 PM – Kids Races Begin
5:00 PM – Mass Start for 5K & 10K
5:45 PM – 5K Awards Ceremony
6:00 PM – 10K Awards Ceremony

🎟️ All bibs, shirts, and trick-or-treat bags will be available starting at 3:00 PM at the Trunk-or-Treat Expo. No early day pickup.

 
🚗 Trunk-or-Treat Expo
Want to be part of the Halloween magic? Decorate your trunk and hand out goodies!

Trunkers will receive 1 free race entry for a Caren Ware Event Race!

Questions? Email carenfasttrack@aol.com cc: info@kourseevents.com

 
🏁 Registration Includes:
RFID Chip Timing by Itz About Time
Fall-Themed Custom Shirt
Unique Reversible Finisher Medal
Trick-or-Treat Bag
Entry into Costume & Team Contests
Eligibility for Age Group & Overall Awards
 
🏆 Awards & Divisions:
Top 3 in each 5-year age division (ages 1–80+)
Top 3 Overall Male & Female Finishers
Best Halloween Costume
Best Uniform-Themed Costume

Awards for Oldest & Youngest Finishers
 
🐾 Pet & Stroller Friendly
Leashed pets welcome (max 5 ft leash)
Strollers allowed — please start near the back
🔖 Only registered participants with a bib receive medals.
 
🌊 The Course:
Flat, fast, paved, and scenic
Ocean views all the way!
Start/Finish in Lot 25 – Bolsa Chica State Beach


🚘 Parking Options:

Park in Sunset Beach and walk in
OR enter via Bolsa Chica State Beach Main Gate ($15 Entrance Fee)
 
🧡 Part of the Winter Series!
Complete 3 of the following Caren Ware Events to earn a 4th medal—FREE!

Sunset Trick or Trot
Thanksgiving Day Races
Santa Claus with a Cause
Run in the New Year
Because we LOVE FITTING it all together! 🎖️

 
🌧️ Rain or Shine – We Run!

Register today and bring your spooky spirit, running shoes, and Halloween flair!

name: SoCal's Tiki Beach 5K & 10K Run/Walk
description:
🌺 Welcome to SO CAL's BIGGEST & BEST POLYNESIAN PARTY RACE! 🌺

Since 2014,  Tiki Beach 5K/10K has been a vibrant tradition on the beach, a chance to run, celebrate, and enjoy island-inspired music, food, and community. It's your end of the summer BEACH PARTY RUN!

🏖️ Experience the energy of the beach with live Polynesian drummers and dancers, bringing authentic rhythm and movement to your run. This isn’t just a race, t’s a festive send-off to summer! Coconuts, palm trees, grass skirts, and the TAPUA PRODUCTION drummers and dancers make this the BEST BEACH BASH, healthy RUNNER's Party!

🎽 Every participant receives a custom Polynesian-style race shirt and one of our signature Tiki finisher medals, a collectible highlight for your race journey. Have enough shirts?  Choose a custom beach towel while supplies last, or add to your collection by getting BOTH for only an additional $20.

🍍 Post-Race Fun: Enjoy coconut and Island inspired pancakes offered by IVC Circle K and Kiwanis of Irvine, specialty coffee, tasty street tacos , Bar b que sandwiches, fresh baked cookies, Hawaiian shaved ice, and Nekter Juice (available for purchase. You make pay with cash, credit card, or pre buy food vouchers) while you explore the expo area and capture those perfect beachside selfies. It's a FOOD FEAST while watching authentic Polynesian drummers and dancers. Support the causes.  KID'S READ will be giving out free books for those that purchase Kiwanis pancakes.  BIG J's So Cal Bar B Que will be offering mini sliders, or full bar b que lunches to eat, take home, or remain at the beach for a picnic!

 
Course:

Flat, scenic, out-and-back along the paved beach path with ocean views. Run fast or take it easy, the waves will be your soundtrack.
Timing: RFID Chip Timing by Itz About Time

Awards:

Top 3 male & female overall (5K & 10K)
Age group awards in 5-year divisions (up to 80+)
Special recognition for those completing 3+ Caren Ware Events this year
 
Schedule
6:30 AM – Vendor & Volunteer Check-in
7:00–8:30 AM – Registration & Packet Pick-Up (race-day available)

7:30 -8:30 Am LIVE POLYNESIAN dancers and drummers/ Tupua Productions/ An active EXPO

8:15 AM – Kid’s Dash & 1-Mile Fun Run
8:30 AM – 10K & 5K Start
9:20 AM – 5K Awards Ceremony
9:40 AM – 10K Awards Ceremony
6:30–10:00 AM – Polynesian-Inspired Expo Open
 
Early Packet Pick-Up
Saturday, Sept. 26 10am to 1PM  (Note: Earlier so we have afternoon time to set up the race) 
Sports Basement, 10800 Kalama River Ave, Fountain Valley, CA 92708
(You may also pick up race morning at the start line.)
 
Parking
Bolsa Chica State Beach, Lot 25 — $15 State Park fee (bring exact cash for faster processing)
Public parking available in Sunset Beach (walking required into park)
 

Restrooms

Restrooms are open and located on each end of lot 25.

Strollers
Strollers are welcome! Please stay to the right and use at your own risk. Only registered participants with a bib will receive a finisher medal. Be sure your bib is worn on the front and visible to finish line staff.

Pets:

Friendly Pets are allowed and must be leashed at all times and accompanied by a Run /Walk participant.  Please use a leash of 5 ft or less, for the safety of all pets and runners.  Line up towards the back of the pack at the start and keep to the side of the race field on the course.

Weather

Rain or shine, the event will go on
 
🌊 Whether you’re racing for a PR or jogging with friends, Tiki Beach is your lively, healthy way to wrap up the summer. Come for the run, stay for the rhythm, community, and celebration.

💙 A portion of proceeds supports Caren Ware Events’ global outreach projects, including families in the Himalayas and local community programs.

name: Sole Sisters Hopeful Hearts
description:
Sole Sisters Hopeful Hearts 5K is a community-driven walk/run dedicated to raising awareness about preconception health and overall wellness.

This event is a collaboration between Fresno County Perinatal Equity Initiative, Black Infant Health, BGR Central Valley, and FCHIP. 
This is a community event for ALL, aimed to empower individuals with knowledge and resources to support their health before conception. Participants will enjoy an uplifting and inclusive experience, featuring a scenic 5K route, informational booths, and engaging activities. Join us as we take strides toward healthier futures—one step at a time!

 

 Early Packet Pickup
Friday, April 10, 2026

4:00 pm - 6:30 pm
Fleet Feet Fresno
9447 N Fort Washington Rd 
Fresno, CA 93730

 

Race Day Packet Pickup at Woodward Park

Saturday, April 11, 2025

7:00 am to 7:40 am
Bib pickup will close at exactly 7:40 am.
LOCATION: Woodward Park, Fort Washington, and Friant entrance; first parking lot, west of the Art of Life sign.

 

Race Amenities
  • Finisher’s medal - for the first 300 participants (250 adults & 50 kids)
  • Race shirt -for the first 300 participants (250 adults & 50 kids)
  • Course Hydration
  • Raffle prizes and Giveaways

There are several ways you can help! Please share the race sign-up link, and if you're interested in volunteering, you can sign up under the volunteer tab.

name: Sonoma County Balloon Chase 5k
description:
Join us for the first annual Sonoma County Balloon Chase 5k and Little Chasers 1k dash! Presented to you by the Sonoma County Hot Air Balloon Classic.

This event will take place on Sunday May 3rd at 8am at Keiser Park in Windsor, California!

 

The course is a 3.1 mile road route looping around the gorgeous Starr Road and Windsor River Road areas in Windsor. Starting and ending in Keiser park. Strollers allowed. Please leave dogs at home. 

5k entrants receive a hat and collectible pin

1k entrants receive a collectible pin with option to add a hat with additional fee.

 All participant entry includes the opportunity to take photographs with local hot air balloons, learn about what it takes to fly (and chase!) hot air balloons

Parking Included with price of registration.

name: Soroptimist Stop Human Trafficking 5k
description:
We are hosting our 4th annual 5k Run April 19th, 2026! This Run will be Chip Timed by Under the Sun Events. We are very excited to launch this run again this year. As last year, our efforts in part benefit a worldwide issue that we feel strongly about.

Human trafficking is a serious global issue that affects millions of people across all ages, genders, and communities. It involves the exploitation of individuals through force, fraud, or coercion for purposes such as forced labor or sexual exploitation. Trafficking often occurs in plain sight, making awareness and education critical tools in prevention.

This event aims to raise awareness, share knowledge, and empower our community to recognize the signs of human trafficking and take action. By coming together, we can help protect vulnerable individuals, support survivors, and work toward a future where exploitation has no place.

name: Southern Sierra Sprint - Kernville 5k & 1k
description:
Kernville Elementary PTC presents our annual St. Patrick's Day Fun Run/5k. A FUN and challenging run in the southern Sierra Nevada town of Kernville, Ca. The annual out and back 5K through the town of Kernville will take place on Saturday March 14th, 2026 at 8:30am. Our staging area, pack pick-up and race start will be at Kernville Elementary School. This is intended to be a fun run, all ages and levels welcome. Walkers are welcome too! Our kid's run (ages 8 and younger) takes place in the school's backyard and starts promptly at 8:30am. Kids will collect gold coins along their route and trade them in for a treat! A full weekend can be made of your time in Kernville. Come and enjoy the beauty of the Kern River and surrounding mountains. 

 

***Registration and packet pick-up will begin at 7:30am. Fun run will begin promptly at 8:30 and 5K at 9am***

name: SPACEROCK Trail Race
description:
OUT-OF-THIS-WORLD TRAIL RUNNING


SPACEROCK: the final trail running frontier.
These are the voyages of trail runners around the world.
Your mission: to explore strange new trails, to seek out new life and new experiences, to boldly run where no one has run before.


Experience the exotic trails and sights of the world-famous Vasquez Rocks Natural Park in Southern California. Known as the backdrop from popular TV shows and movies including Star Trek, The Flintstones, Battlestar Galactica, Planet of the Apes, and many of our favorite classic westerns films. Now get a spectacular experience running the trails at the SPACEROCK Trail Race!

Learn more at and register at: SPACEROCKTrailRace.com

name: Splash Dash 5k/ A Wet or Dry Run 5k plus Duckie Dash/Wild Rivers in Irvine
description:
The WILD RIVERS SPLASH DASH 5K 
SUNDAY, AUGUST 24, 2025

 

A 'cool' Run.  Chose SPLASH DASH 5k (if you want to get to plunge through the wild river before the finish line.) Or the DRY RUN 5k (if preference is to not get wet)

It's your 'coolest' summer run/walk. With the coolest race BLING!  Choice of a custom event BEACH TOWEL or a custom event t shirt, and a huge custom FINISHER MEDAL for all participants. 

Plus the chance to win SUPER DUPER Age divisions medal awards. 

It is a SUPER DUPER FUN event.  Make it competitive, or choose to cruise it and have great fun! The last 600 yards of the SPLASH DASH you get to 'DASH' through the lazy river in 2 1/2 feet of water, going with the current!

***************************************************************************************

name: Spring Fling Run – 5K, 10K, Half Marathon
description:
Fresh air, good vibes, and springtime miles. Spring Fling Run at Hansen Dam is a fun, community-focused race designed to kick off the season and remind you why you love running.

Details

Start Location: Hansen Dam Recreation Area, Ranger Station, 11770 Foothill Blvd. Lake View Terrace, CA. 
Parking: There are free parking lots nearby the start

Event Schedule

6:30am – Bib pick-up opens at the start
7:00am – Half marathon start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Course

5k & 10k – this 5k route is used for the 5k (done once), 10k (done twice)
Half Marathon – this 4.4-mile route is used for the half marathon (done 3 times)

More About the Course: This is an out and back course. Our courses are not closed, which means that there are often runners, walkers, and others enjoying the day along with you. Please be considerate to others along thecourse.

On-course support: Courses are well marked with two water stations along the way.

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, Orange County, and San Diego. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Email us at events@hightideruns.com

name: Spring Sprint @ Uvas
description:
Join us for this popular race at Uvas Reservoir. It's a Sprint but super-sized. Swim .75 miles in Uvas Reservoir. Bike 16.2 miles on quiet country roads. Only two climbs! Finish up with a 5 mile run. Then eat tasty food and listen to good music while waiting for the award ceremony.

Top 3 in 5-year age groups for Triathlon. Top 3 Overall for all other events. Special Youth & Senior pricing. Clydesdale & Athena waves. Non-binary/Prefer Not Say options. Relays too! AquaBike, Duathlon, Aquathlon, and OWS events also available.
