name: St. Anthony High School's 17th Annual SAINTS RUN 5K
description: St. Anthony High School College Preparatory invites you to our 17th Annual SAINTS RUN 5K. All proceeds from the SAINTS RUN 5K go to our financial aid program providing over $1 million in tuition assistance annually to underserved, low-income families who would not otherwise be able to afford a quality, Catholic, college preparatory education. Every student at SAHS benefits from this program as it allows our tuition to remain as low as possible! You won’t want to miss this scenic race, starting at Shoreline Aquatic Park, featuring the lighthouse and Queen Mary with stunning views of the beautiful Pacific Ocean. Fun for the whole family!

name: St. Edward Spartan 5K Run & Walk
description:
⚔️ Join the Spartan Spirit at St. Edward School’s 3rd Annual 5K Run & Walk! ⚔️ 

Bring your family, friends, neighbors, colleagues – even your pets – and step into a day of fun, fitness, and community! 🐾👟

🏃‍♂️ Conquer the scenic 5K trail around Quarry Lakes Park! Teams, warriors, and solo Spartans of all ages and abilities are welcome to run or walk this adventure.

🎶 Celebrate the Spartan community! After crossing the finish line, enjoy a victory picnic, music, games, raffle prizes, and a silent auction. If you pre-ordered lunch, it’ll be ready to fuel your champion spirit. This isn’t just a race – it’s a celebration of courage, camaraderie, and the unstoppable Spartan community.

💖 Every step strengthens our mission! Proceeds support St. Edward School’s commitment to providing a nurturing, faith-centered environment where students grow academically, spiritually, and socially – empowering the next generation of Spartans.

✨ Unite, challenge yourself, and celebrate – all for a great cause!

St. Edward School is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN: 94-1535363). All donations are tax-deductible.

 

SCHEDULE OF EVENTS


7:30 AM – 8:30 AM
✅ Check-in

8:00 AM
🎉 Opening Ceremony
🖤 Silent Auction Opens

8:30 AM
🏃 5K Starts!

8:30 AM – 10:30 AM
🎖️ 5K Medal Distribution to Finishers

During 5K
🎨 Open Activities
🎟️ Purchase Raffle Tickets
🖤 Silent Auction Bids

10:00 AM
🍴 Brunch (10:00 AM - 11:30 AM)

11:00 AM
🍦 Mr. Softee (11:00 AM – 12:00 PM)

⏳ Last Call for Raffle & Silent Auction Bids

11:30 AM
🎟️ Raffle Closes
🖤 Silent Auction Closes

🎲 Heads or Tails Game

12:00 PM – 12:30 PM
🎤 Closing Remarks
🏆 Announce Auction Winners & Raffle Drawing

12:30 PM – 1:30 PM
🧹 Clean Up

 

GETTING THERE


From I-880 in Fremont, take the Decoto Road exit east and proceed to Paseo Padre Parkway. Turn right on Paseo Padre, then left on Isherwood Way. Proceed to the park entrance on the right. 

 

From Mission Blvd (Hwy. 238) in Fremont, turn south on Nursery Ave. (away from the hills) and right (west) on Niles Blvd. Turn left on Osprey Drive and left on Quarry Lakes Drive. Proceed to the park entrance on the left.

 

More details about Quarry Lakes Regional Park , including a park map can be found here.

 

PARKING

 

There are plenty of parking spots at the park. There is a parking fee at this park so please be prepared with payment.  Please review park details at the site: https://www.ebparks.org/parks/quarry-lakes

 

The St Edward School 5K Registration desk is located in the Ensenada South Picnic Area and there is a parking lot close to it. However if the lot is full, there is additional parking close to Niles Beach.

 

NOTE: due to the high traffic that will be expected, please plan ahead to come early.

 

  • Register early to receive a free parking pass! The pass will be included in your pre-race packet.

** Anyone registering after the early registration period or unable to pick up their pre-race packets will need to pay for parking at the gate, no reimbursements for parking will be made.

 

RACE PACKET PICKUP

Wed, April 22 @ 2:15pm at St. Edward School
Thu, April 23 @ 3:00pm at St. Edward School
Fri, April 24 @ 3:00pm or St. Edward School
Fri, April 24 @ 5-8pm at Location TBD

 

Your race packet will include:

  • Race Bib
  • Safety pins to attach the bib to your clothing
  • Commemorative Shirt
  • Food Ticket for those who pre-ordered
  • Columbia Employee Invitation Pass to the Columbia Employee store


Please present a copy of your order confirmation and an ID at the registration desk to pick up your bibs. You may also pick up bibs for another participant, but please make sure you present their order confirmation. You will be responsible for getting the bibs to the participant.

 

COURSE

 

🏞️ Course
Packed gravel trails looping through Quarry Lakes Park. Not USATF certified; distance approximate.

 
🏷️ Bibs
Wear your bib clearly visible on your chest at the start.

 
🚶‍♀️🏃 Walkers & Runners
Walkers and runners follow the same course.

 
🚫 Not Allowed
No bikes, skateboards, or scooters.

 
⚠️ Safety
Stay on trails. Wear proper shoes and dress in layers.

 
🌿 Keep It Clean
Leave no trace; use trash bins along the course.

 
🐕 Dogs
Leash required. Please clean up after your pet.

 

OTHER AMENITIES

  • Water stations will be located close to every mile marker
  • First aid will be available at every Water station and also at the Registration/Check in desk 
  • The park has several restrooms that will be available for your use.

 

FINISHER MEDALS

Your finisher medals can be picked up after the race at the designated finish line table. 

** We cannot guarantee medals for registrations made after April 05, 2025

 

SILENT AUCTION AND RAFFLE BASKET PRIZE


Annual St. Edward Walk / Run Event will hold a silent auction and raffle draw for baskets and will be held after the race.  Raffle basket ticket holders need not be present to win. If the raffle winner is not present, they will be notified via email and phone call within the week after the 5K.

 

ANY QUESTIONS ON THE DAY OF RACE …


Please note that this event is a volunteer-led school fundraiser and not a professionally timed race. Our goal is to provide a fun, welcoming, and memorable 5K experience for everyone. If you have any questions or concerns, please reach out to one of our volunteers—we’re happy to help and support you throughout the event.

Thank you for your patience, kindness, and cooperation throughout the entire event—we truly appreciate your support.

name: St. Paddy's Day Lucky Run 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🍀 St. Paddy's Day Run: Luck, Laughs, and Laces! 🍀

Celebrate St. Patrick’s Day with a fun and festive run that’s as much about the spirit of the holiday as it is about the finish line! Whether you're running, walking, or just along for the ride, this 5K/10K/13.1 is the perfect way to enjoy the day with friends, family, and fellow revelers.
Dress up in your favorite green gear—shamrocks, leprechaun hats, and everything in between—and join us for a race full of fun and good cheer!

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

Celebrate St. Patrick’s Day with a fun and festive run that’s as much about the spirit of the holiday as it is about the finish line! Whether you're running, walking, or just along for the ride, this 5K/10K/13.1 is the perfect way to enjoy the day with friends, family, and fellow revelers.
Dress up in your favorite green gear—shamrocks, leprechaun hats, and everything in between—and join us for a race full of fun and good cheer!

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal!

name: St. Patrick's Day 5K Run / Community Walk (Riviera Village)
description:
The Village Runner St. Patrick’s Day 5K Run & Leprechaun Dash for the Gold is returning to Redondo Beach on Saturday, March 14, 2026!

This year’s event is hosted in partnership with South Bay Children’s Health Center, with proceeds supporting their vital programs for local children and families.

All participants will receive a St. Patrick's Day Run t-shirt and finisher's medal.  The event also features computerized chip timing, age division awards, and cash prizes to the top three overall male and female runners in the 5K.

name: Steps for Strength: Bay Area Young Survivors (BAYS)
description:
Please Note **After careful consideration we have decided to regrettably cancel this years Steps for Strength event scheduled for 5/2/2026. ***

 

Bay Area Young Survivors (BAYS) is hosting its second annual Steps for Strength 5K at Campbell Park in Campbell, CA. The event kicks off at 8:30 a.m. with a health resource fair, followed by the 5K walk/run at 9:00 a.m. The 3.1-mile loop course is flat and scenic, winding through Campbell Park. Water stations will be available at the start/finish line and halfway point, with public restrooms at the finish. This 5K event will be a professionally timed race. 

 

This family-friendly event features a playground, music, a food truck, face painting, and more fun activities for kids. After the race, enjoy participant medals, the health resource fair, and snacks. All proceeds benefit BAYS and its free programs for young breast cancer survivors.

 

ABOUT BAYS:
Bay Area Young Survivors (BAYS) is an all-volunteer, 501(c)(3) nonprofit supporting young breast cancer survivors under 45 in the San Francisco Bay Area by providing emotional support and resources for life during and after cancer. Funds raised will help fund free programming offered to members such as: support groups, educational workshops, community meetups, and emergency financial assistance.

 

MORE INFORMATION

  • Create a TEAM with friends, family, or colleagues, or register as an individual to participate in-person or virtually!
  • Set a fundraising goal and help BAYS by encouraging your community to sponsor your run—or your team’s run.
  • Together, we can raise awareness and support for young adults with breast cancer in the Bay Area. Help spread the word about BAYS and the vital services we offer to those in need.
  • Can’t Attend the Steps for Strength on May 2, 2026 ? You can still make a difference by making a donation to BAYS! Click the yellow "Donate" tab at the top to contribute. Any donation, big or small, will be greatly appreciated and go a long way in helping us continue to offer free services to our young breast cancer members.

VOLUNTEER SIGN UP
Interested in Volunteering?

We have a variety of roles and skillsets needed for this exciting event! To sign up, use the link in the header.

 

SPONSORSHIP OPPORTUNITIES

Interested in Sponsoring? 

Become a sponsor and make a lasting impact at this incredible event! We offer a variety of sponsorship opportunities for your business or organization. Your support will directly benefit Bay Area Young Survivors (BAYS) and help provide essential resources for young adults with breast cancer in our community.

  • To sponsor, head to the Sponsors tab in the header, complete our     or email us at runwithbays@bayareayoungsurvivors.org
  • To learn more about sponsorship opportunities, please reach out to us. We’d love to discuss how we can collaborate for a great cause!

Funds raised will help fund free programming offered to members such as: support groups, educational workshops, community meetups, and emergency financial assistance.

 

MORE INFORMATION

  • Create a TEAM with friends, family, or colleagues, or register as an individual to participate in-person or virtually!
  • Set a fundraising goal and help BAYS by encouraging your community to sponsor your run—or your team’s run.
  • Together, we can raise awareness and support for young adults with breast cancer in the Bay Area. Help spread the word about BAYS and the vital services we offer to those in need.
  • Can’t Attend the Steps for Strength on May 2, 2026 ? You can still make a difference by making a donation to BAYS! Click the yellow "Donate" tab at the top to contribute. Any donation, big or small, will be greatly appreciated and go a long way in helping us continue to offer free services to our young breast cancer members.

VOLUNTEER SIGN UP
Interested in Volunteering?

We have a variety of roles and skillsets needed for this exciting event! To sign up, use the link in the header.

 

SPONSORSHIP OPPORTUNITIES

Interested in Sponsoring? 

Become a sponsor and make a lasting impact at this incredible event! We offer a variety of sponsorship opportunities for your business or organization. Your support will directly benefit Bay Area Young Survivors (BAYS) and help provide essential resources for young adults with breast cancer in our community.

  • To sponsor, head to the Sponsors tab in the header, complete our     or email us at runwithbays@bayareayoungsurvivors.org
  • To learn more about sponsorship opportunities, please reach out to us. We’d love to discuss how we can collaborate for a great cause!

description:

This winery specializes in handcrafted, artisan, estate and single vineyard wines that faithfully represent the terroir of origin. name: Strawberry Stomp 5K
description:
Held on Memorial Day weekend, the annual Strawberry Stomp 5K provides individuals and families the unique opportunity to run/walk the Strawberry Festival Parade route, preceding the parade.

All race proceeds benefit the Sister City Association of Garden Grove, a nonprofit 501(c)(3) organization dedicated to furthering the knowledge and understanding between Garden Grove and its sister city Anyang, Republic of Korea while providing Garden Grove students the unique opportunity to travel abroad.

name: Sugar Daddy Race
description:
WELCOME TO THE SUGAR DADDY RACE!

Celebrate Father's Day by kicking off the weekend with an awesome race taking you on a scenic tour through the beautiful Santa Clarita Valley in a Half Marathon, 10K, 5K, or Kids race.

Get your PR on our fast, almost flat course on paved paseo trails. Created to bring runners together for a great race experience as you finish across the historic Iron Horse bridge into the finish line to earn our epic Sugar Daddy Race bling, plus receive yummy Ben & Jerry's ice cream to help cool you down from your awesome run! 

Learn more below or register today to secure your spot at the start line!

FAST COURSE
Runners get to enjoy the best of Santa Clarita's awesome paths and paseos taking runners on a spectacular tour around the Santa Clarita Valley on a very fast course. 
 
HISTORIC BRIDGE
All runners get to make the final push into finish line to run across the historic 120-year old Iron Horse bridge, making for a landmark race finish.
 
FAMILY FUN
The Sugar Daddy Race is for everyone, runners, walkers, hikers, there is even a Kids Fun Run for the little ones to get active and healthy to experience a race.
 
SWEET FINISH
In addition to earning an awesome medal, Sugar Daddy finishers will get a special ice cream treat to help cool them off after finishing the race.

Learn more at >> SugarDaddyRace.com

name: Summer Grand Prix
description:
The Summer Grand Prix is a thrilling four-race competition for runners of all levels. Held at the scenic Panorama Vista Preserve in Bakersfield, this series offers a challenging yet rewarding summer of racing.

NEW FOR 2026
1. We are adding divisions! (Youth, High School and Adult)
2. Only two waves.
3. Prizes for top three in each division. (M/F)
4. Scoring only the best of three races.

We believe these changes will give more opportunity for runners to compete and win, allows participants to miss a race and improves the overall experience of the series.

Four Open 5k Races
Participate in four exciting 5k races throughout the summer, each held at the picturesque Panorama Vista Preserve. 

Walkers are welcomed and encouraged to participate. 

Points System
Top three finishers (M/F) in each division (not wave) will earn points. 

1st place • 9pts
2nd place • 8pts
3rd place • 7pts
4th place • 6pts
5th place • 5pts
6th place • 4pts
7th place • 3pts
8th place • 2pts
9th place • 1pts

Race Waves
Select from one of the three waves you want to race 
Wave 1 • 6:15am
Wave 2 • 7:00am
**time will expire after 45 minutes of each race

Grand Prix Champions
The runners with the most points in each division accumulated across the series will be crowned the overall champion of the Summer Grand Prix.

Top Finisher Winners
This year we are breaking up our winners into three divisions Youth, High School and Adult each with top three winners per division both female and male athletes.

Donations
Part of the proceeds and donations will go to the Panorama Vista Preserve to help them continue to maintain and improve the scenic venue for all to share and enjoy.

Parking
Parking is limited so carpooling is encouraged. Overflow parking along the street.

name: Summer Luau Run 5K & 10k
description:
Join us for the Summer Luau Run 5K & 10K, a vibrant summer celebration of fitness, community and good vibes! Set against a beautiful outdoor course, this event blends the energy of race day with a relaxed luau-inspired atmosphere perfect for runners, joggers, walkers, and families of all ages. 

Participants will enjoy a scenic run, upbeat music, festive summer touches, and a welcoming environment that celebrates movement and togetherness.

Whether you're chasing a PR, enjoying a fun run with friends, or soaking up the summer energy, the Summer Luau Run is all about running strong, feeling good, and celebrating miles. 

Come run, walk, or jog your way into summer - we can't wait to celebrate with you !

🌺 Tropical attire encouraged! Break out your florals, leis, and island vibes.

🌺 Best-dressed runners may be featured on social media! 

 

What is included with registration

🌺 Every finisher will receive a custom Summer Luau Run finisher medal

🌺Exclusive Summer Luau Run race shirt. (T-shirts are guaranteed for participants registered by June 20, 2026. Sizes are first-come, first-served after that date.)

🌺Race Bib

🌺Chip timed race

🌺Post Race Refreshments

🌺Age Group Awards 

🌺Free finisher pictures

 

Race Day Schedule: 

  • 6:30–7:45 am Check-in & Packet Pickup
  • 7:45am  - 10k start
  • 8:00am  5K start
  • 9:00 am award ceremony 

Course Information

  • The 5K and 10K courses will take place within Griffith Park. The final course routes are pending park approval and will be posted closer to race day.

 

Parking and Arrival Info

  • Free parking is available within Griffith Park. Participants are encouraged to arrive early to allow time for parking, check-in, and warm-up.

 

📣 Social & Updates

  • Follow us on social media for updates, announcements, and sneak peeks of the medal and shirt design.
  • 📷 Instagram: @pinklacesraces

Celebrate the longest day of the year with an electrifying glow run along the scenic Long Beach coastline! As the sun rises, the party begins—race under the golden hues of sunrise. Whether you’re running the 5K.10K or half marathon, this is your chance to embrace the solstice spirit with a vibrant community of runners.

name: Summer time in the LBC 5K, 10K, & Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
🌴☀️ Summertime in the LBC – 5K, 10K, and Half Marathon 🌞🏃‍♂️


Get ready to soak up the sunshine and celebrate summer with Summertime in the LBC, a vibrant race along the beautiful Long Beach waterfront! Whether you’re running the 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon, this event captures the iconic energy of Long Beach, combining stunning coastal views with CaliFlow’s unbeatable race vibes.

 
📍 Start Location:
5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803

🏃‍♂️ Race Day Schedule:
Bib Pick-Up: 6:00 AM – 7:35 AM (Race Ready Athletics Tent)
Half Marathon Start: 7:00 AM
5K & 10K Start: 7:30 AM

🚫 No late starts. Please arrive early to ensure you're ready for your race!

 
🚗 Parking Information:
Street Parking: Free along Ocean Blvd.
Beach Lot Parking: $2.00 per hour. Pay at the machine (credit card and coin payments accepted).
Lot Location: 5500 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803
 
🌟 Race Perks:
🏅 Finisher Medal for all participants.
📸 Free Race Photos – Capture your summer memories.
🏆 Chip-Timed Results – Accurate, instant, and ready at the finish.
🥇 Overall & Age Group Awards – Top 3 male and female finishers in each distance.
🚰 Water and Aid Stations – Located every 2 miles.
🚻 Restrooms – Conveniently located near the start line.
👶 Stroller & Walker-Friendly – All are welcome.
🌊 Course: Fully marked and staffed, showcasing the best of Long Beach’s scenic coastline.
 
☀️ Weather & Safety:
This is a RAIN or SHINE event.
In the rare case of severe weather (tsunami, tidal wave, or zombie apocalypse), updates will be sent via email and posted on our social media channels.

 
📸 Join the Community:
Tag us in your race photos using #CaliFlowRuns for a chance to be featured!

🔥 Don’t miss #FreeEntryFriday – answer our question on social media for a chance to win a free race!

 
🌴 Why Run with CaliFlow?
We host over 60 races per year, making big race experiences accessible without the big price tag. It’s all about good vibes, great views, and bringing the community together.

👉 Register now and feel the summer vibes at Summertime in the LBC! 🌊☀️🏃‍♂️

name: Sunrise Marathon 5K/10K/13.1 LOS ANGELES
description:
🌅Run at Sunrise with pretty scenic views!

Start your day — and your journey — with a breathtaking sunrise and fellow runners chasing greatness.

 

Overview:
Run will sell-out QUICK! We will close off waves the moment they fill up. If waves are sold out, you can sign-up for the virtual run option or wait list.
This is a smaller, private group run with a cap per wave.
All paces and ages (under 18 with guardian) are welcome - Run or Walk!  
There's no equipment or setup, this is a pure run with our coordinators to support you in a warm, stress-free setting!
When you sign-up, we give you the support you need to help you achieve your goals and fitness. We also invite you to be part of our local run clubs that supports your fitness journey. 
Timing:
- Timing is Optional: You may track your time on an app (Strava, RunKeeper, Nike Run, etc) and submit your times with our easy form to be posted online. Or you can ask our coordinators to help keep track of your time. 
- No timing chips (This is a stress free run to support you in achieving your goals)!
What You Get (Swag Bag):
- Running T-Shirt (Shipped to the address you register with - US only)
- Finisher's Towel or Giveaway
- Finisher's Medal! 
- Digital Training Pack 
- Online Results & Certificate of Completion
- Invitation to Join one of our Local Running Clubs
- We now have Technical Running Shirts (Optional). These lightweight, moisture wicking shirts can be upgraded for just $5 more. 
Packet Pickup:
No hassle of picking up packets required!
-Swag shipped direct to your address (Please make sure you provide your full, correct US mailing address including apartment number and check spelling)
- Race bibs are provided on race day
When will I get my Swag?
You will get your shirt at your mailing address the week of your race.
Race Updates:
We will email you a final update the Wednesday before the race with final details and course maps.
Do you accept last minute registrations? (For those signing up 2 weeks before the race)
Yes, but please note that it takes time for us to ship your shirt. Your shirt will likely arrive after the run. You can wear any shirt you find appropriate to run the race! 
 
Wave Times: (Email Us Your Desired Wave Time: info@thebestraces.com)
(Waves filled on a First Come, First Serve Basis)
Wave A: 7:30AM
Wave B: 8:00AM
Wave C: 8:30AM
Late runners can run upon arrival (Please note our coordinators stay 3 hours after the first wave)
Are there any other Questions we missed?
https://www.thebestraces.com/faq/
Virtual Run Option:
- Our Virtual Run uniquely offers a Training Pack with Digital Tools to support your run. 
Virtual runs can be done any time and place of your choosing using any tracking device (optional). After you finish, you can submit your results to info@thebestraces.com to receive your medal! 
Race Bundle:
Sign-up for more races and get a discount! 

Sponsorships & Promoting your Business:

If you're looking to become a sponsor, we'd love showcase your business!
https://www.thebestraces.com/events
 

Team Glo Volunteers:

If you're interested in helping put on runs for the Community and helping people achieve their goals, we invite you to join our team of volunteers, fill out the form here: https://www.thebestraces.com/volunteer-form/
 

Be part of the Journey!

Our Charity Initiatives. Find out more @ www.thebestracesjourney.com
Keep running. Every mile you log after the race, we'll donate $1 to one of the charities we work with! (Note that Fundraising is Optional)

name: Super Hero Dash – 5K, 10K, 10M, and Half Marathon
description:
Calling all caped crusaders, masked vigilantes, and crime-fighting champions! Gear up for the ultimate test of superpowers at the Super Hero Dash!

Details
Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the lot is $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free.

Event Schedule
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)
Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners and 10-milers only, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Courses
5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course
The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is located along the course. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details
Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Awards: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance.
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, Santa Monica, the San Fernando Valley, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule.

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: Superhero 5K Fun Run
description:
Date: Sunday, March 8, 2026
Location: Union City Civic Center / City Hall
Address: 34009 Alvarado-Niles Road, Union City, CA
Check-In: 8:00 AM | Race Begins: 9:00 AM
Rain or Shine!

Become the Hero You Were Meant to Be
Suit up, power up, and hit the streets of Union City for our annual Superhero Fun Run! Whether you’re flying solo or running with your sidekicks, this event is packed with community spirit, friendly competition, and heroic fun for all ages.

Join hundreds of fellow heroes for a morning featuring:

💥 Official race timing for accurate results
🏅 Award medals for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place in each category
🎟️ Exciting raffle prizes and giveaways
🦸 Costume contest for the best hero (or villain) look

Community Support Makes This Event Possible
We are proud to recognize Union City Pediatric Dentistry for their generous donation in support of this year’s Superhero Fun Run. Their commitment to supporting healthy, active families in our community helps make events like this possible.

We would also like to thank Comics & Figure Addicts in Union City for contributing exciting prize donations that will make our raffle and awards even more fun for participants of all ages. Their continued support adds an extra spark of superhero magic to race day.

A Race That Gives Back
Since 2016, the Superhero Fun Run has celebrated the anniversary of the Mark Green Sports Center while supporting an important cause. A portion of every registration—$5 per participant—will be donated to the Parkinson’s Foundation through our Union City Moving Day team. Your steps make a real difference.

Race Categories
Boys/Girls 12 & Under
Boys/Girls 13–17
Men/Women 18–29
Men/Women 30–39
Men/Women 40–49
Men/Women 50–59
Men/Women 60–69
Men/Women 70+

name: Support Blue Fresno
description:
Join us at this year's Support Blue Run to show your support for our men and women in law enforcement who protect our Valley!  By participating, you are helping to support the Fresno Police and Fire Chaplaincy, a non-profit dedicated to partnering with Fresno Police and Fire Departments and committed to being first to serve - providing spiritual and emotional support to first responders and the community.
The Fresno Support Blue Run campaign aims to:
  • Foster trust and confidence between our officers and the community they serve
  • Provide opportunity for our community to visibly show their support for law enforcement
  • Educate youth to enhance relationships and understanding with officers
  • Raise funds to provide staff and resources for the Fresno Police and Fire Chaplaincy programs who support our volunteer Police Chaplains and the Fresno Police and Fire Departments

Children 9 & under registering for the 5K/2M will receive a discount applied at checkout.

name: Sutter Buttes Spirit Mountain Run 5K, 10K & Half Marathon
description:
Come join us on May 16, 2026 for our 5K, 10K and Half Marathon run through the center of the Sutter Buttes, Pass Road. Scenic paved route through the smallest mountain range in the world. All run courses start on flat road and have a slight gradual rolling incline then a slight gradual rolling decline. All proceeds will benefit children and families in need in the Sutter/Yuba area. Event will take place rain or shine!

As in years past we will have a racers breakfast at the finish line but there will be no vendors or beer & wines sales at the completion of the race. 

We are excited to be able to get back out and host this event! Hope to see you all MAY 16th 2026!

Sign Up Now!

T-shirts are not guaranteed if you register after April 15th.

name: Suzie Smith Memorial Run
description: Join us for the first Suzie Smith 5k Memorial Run. This event is to honor and remember Suzie Smith's dedication and service to our community. For 35 years Suzie served as a flight nurse meeting and serving people in some of their most difficult moments. Please join us as we honor Suzie and her commitment to God, her family, and her community. All proceeds from this event will be given to Suzie's foundation "Our Angel that Flies."

name: Sweet Life - Pineapple Run 5K. 10K. Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
🍍 SWEET LIFE - PINEAPPLE RUN
5K • 10K • Half Marathon

📅 [Saturday, May 24th, 2026] | Long Beach, CA
📍 Start/Finish: 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach

Life is sweet — and this race is all about celebrating it.

The Sweet Life Run is a joyful coastal celebration of movement, sunshine, and good vibes. Whether you’re running for fun, walking with friends, or chasing a finish-line smile, this event is designed to feel like the best day of summer — relaxed, welcoming, and full of heart.

Come soak up ocean views, bright energy, and a finish line that feels more like a party than a podium.

 
🏁 Race Day Schedule
Two Start Times
• Half Marathon: 7:00 AM
• 5K & 10K: 7:30 AM

Same-Day Registration & Bib Pickup:
6:15–7:35 AM at the Race Ready Athletics Tent

Course Cut-Off: 10:30 AM 

 
✨ Event Highlights
🍍 Sweet Life–themed Finisher Medals
📸 Free race-day photos
⏱️ Professional chip timing with overall & age group awards
🚰 Water stations & restrooms on course
👶 Beginner-, walker-, and stroller-friendly
🌊 Flat, scenic beach path course
🎉 Finish line festival with feel-good vibes

 
🌞 Why CaliFlow Runs?
We’re not just about miles — we’re about moments.

CaliFlow Runs creates celebration-first races that welcome every pace, every story, and every reason you show up. Whether you’re chasing a PR or just here to enjoy the Sweet Life, you belong at this start line.

Run happy-ish. Run together. Run the Sweet Life. 🍍

name: Swim the Bear
description:
Dive in to this incredible Open Water Swim Race on Big Bear Lake!

Join us as we bring a new discipline of endurance sports to Big Bear Lake. Swim the Bear is part of Big Bear’s Paddlefest. This year featuring both 1.2 and 2.4 mile races held back to back. The course starts on the sand at Swim Beach, head out to the tip of Eagle Point, and then returns for an exit onto the grass at Ski Beach Park. 2 Laps for the longer distance!  

Registration includes: Race SWAG, Finishers Medal, and Awards Eligibility

Cash Prize for Overall Male and Female winners.
Age Group Winners Awards - Junior (<18), Open, Masters (40+)
Average water temperature in August is 70 degrees.
Wetsuits are allowed but not eligible for awards.

description:
👽🍕 TAKE ME TO YOUR PIZZA
Alien Dash • 5K • 10K • Half Marathon

📅 Sunday, September 27
📍 5400 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803

Run. Slice. Beam us up.

Celebrate National Pepperoni Pizza Day the CaliFlow way — with coastal miles, alien sightings, and a finish line that delivers exactly what you’re thinking about: pizza.

The Take Me to Your Pizza Alien Dash is a playful, out-of-this-world race experience where running meets ridiculous fun. Whether you’re chasing a PR, running for vibes, or just here for the post-race carbs, this is one event you knead on your calendar.

Expect ocean views, UFO-level energy, and a finish line party that’s equal parts weird, welcoming, and wildly fun.

name: Taxiway 5k
description:
The Taxiway 5K returns for its second year on Saturday, February 28, bringing runners back to one of the most unique race venues in Southern California, Cable Airport in Upland, CA.

This afternoon 5K (4:30pm start) starts and finishes in front of Mt. Baldy Brewery, taking runners on a loop around the airport with beautiful mountain views and a chance to see some of the incredible aircraft on display. After crossing the finish line, stick around at the brewery for a post-race celebration featuring live music, food trucks, and the best beer in SoCal. This year's event will also feature a 800m "Kid's Takeoff Dash" presented by the Mt. Baldy Athletics Foundation which will start at 4pm. 

Registration includes a Taxiway 5k pom pom beanie and a post-race drink at the Brewery! There are also Taxiway 5k finishers medals for all finishers. Don’t miss your chance to be a part of this unique race with great vibes, delicious brews, and can't miss mountain views await. Spots are limited, so register today and be part of year two of the Taxiway 5K!

name: Teaming Up Against Cancer
description:
Online registration closes on Thursday, March 13, 2025 at 11:59pm.  If you would like to come out to the event as a cancer survivor or general visitor, please feel free to do so...there is no charge.  The opening ceremony and survivor ceremony is at 9am on Saturday, March 15th.  Competitions are to follow.  Cornhole competition opportunities are available onsite for $20 per person.

Please scroll down to view Game Rules, Event Schedule and Event Map.

This exciting competition brings local businesses, service organization and families of all sizes together for a variety of fun and entertaining activities.  It's a great opportunity to promote teamwork and a sense of pride. All proceeds benefit the Kern County Cancer Foundation.

Teams will compete in a variety of fun and low-skill activities all while vying for the most accumulated points and ultimately, ownership of the "Ultimate Cancer Fighters" Team Cup.  Likely competitions include:  Connect 4, Giant Pong, Hoppin' World Cup, Obstacle Course Relay, Bigfoot, and Around the World.  

 

The 2025 Event Schedule, Game Rules, Team Roster and Event Map are at the bottom of the Competition Info section of this website.

This one-day competition will take place at Liberty Park 11225 Brimhall Rd. 93312 in Bakersfield on Saturday, March 15th 9am-2pm with awards and raffle to follow.

Each team consists of 10 members.  A group can enter more than one team if space allows.  If your company/club/family has paid for your team, please see your team leader for your registration code to waive your individual fee.

For more information or help with registration please call 661-825-8249 and speak with Alissa.

name: Thankful Paws Turkey Trot
description:
Join us for the first annual Turkey Trot – Thankful Paws 5K/10K Run on Thanksgiving morning at Rohr Park, in the beautiful city of Bonita, located in Chula Vista, CA.

This special day is dedicated to giving thanks to our pets—past and present—for the joy, love, and companionship they've brought into our lives and homes.

Enjoy a scenic course alongside a golf course and vibrant community park—perfect for both serious runners and casual participants. Whether you're chasing a PR on a fast course or simply looking for a joyful way to start your holiday, this event has something for everyone. We’re offering a 5K, 10K, Kids’ Mile, and our always-popular Doggy Mile!

Bring the whole family—including your four-legged friends—and kick off your Thanksgiving with a fun, active, and festive tradition.

All proceeds benefit Kane's Animal Rescue, a local nonprofit dedicated to giving abandoned and at-risk pets a second chance at life. So, while you're breaking a sweat, you're also making a difference.

Come trot with us, give thanks, and support a great cause—because every step helps save a paw.

Proceeds will benefit Kanes K9s & Animal Rescue! 

Kanes K9s is a local nonprofit animal rescue organization. Proceeds from ticket sales will be donated to the rescue.

 

FAQ

Bib Pickup: Registrations submitted on or after Nov. 20th will pick up their bib on race day. If you registered prior to Nov. 20th, bib pickup is available Sunday, Nov. 23rd at Road Runner Sports in Chula Vista from 2pm-6pm (2015 Birch Rd Suite #512, Chula Vista).

Dog Mile: For the dog mile, the dog must cross the finish line ahead of their owner/partner to log a valid race result.

name: The 41st Annual Newark Mile 4k (2026)
description:
CXC4L is proud to announce that we will be hosting the Newark Mile again in 2026. The race will take place along its traditional 2.5 mile (4km) course along the Newark Days parade route (see course map below for more detail). We are pleased to be hosting the 41st running of this local Newark favorite in partnership with the Newark Days Celebration!

After the race, stick around to enjoy the rest of the Newark Days such as carnival rides, parade, live entertainment, food festival, beer & wine pavilion, car show, and an arts & crafts fair.

name: THE 8TH ANNUAL GRAND PRIX FOUNDATION OF LONG BEACH 5K RUN/WALK
description:
This spring, racing fans and runners of all skill levels and ages will have the opportunity to “run the course” at the 8th Annual Grand Prix Foundation of Long Beach 5K on April 12, 2026, which will benefit local charities through the Grand Prix Foundation of Long Beach.

Participants will run a two-lap tour of the world-famous Acura Grand Prix of Long Beach racecourse including Pine Avenue and Seaside Way, with the finish at the official Grand Prix start/finish line on Shoreline Drive. Kids 12 and under can get in on the action with the Kids’ Turbo 1K, which will take place after the main races on a portion of the regular racecourse. The other two races will be the Elite/Pro 5K (those who can finish the race in under 25 minutes) which will start at 7:00 a.m. and the run for the general public, beginning at 7:30 a.m.

Each runner will receive a finisher medal, an official Grand Prix Foundation 5K t-shirt, post-race refreshments and two complimentary Friday general admission tickets to the Acura Grand Prix of Long Beach, a $68 value. There will also be photo ops and activities in the 5K festival area at the conclusion of the run.

name: The Almaden Spring Run
description:
The Leland High School Booster Club, a non-profit organization, is organizing a fundraising event to support our student athletes. The event is a 5K and 10K walkathon and run event. All proceeds will go to the Leland High School Booster Club.

We encourage all members in the community to participate by purchasing the ticket and participating at the event. The event is organized by board members of the booster club, volunteers , community members, and students of the Leland High school.

name: The Aloha Run
description:
Join us for a morning full of tropical vibes, fitness, and fun at the Aloha Run!

Whether you're a seasoned runner or just looking to enjoy a brisk walk with family and friends, the Aloha Run is the perfect way to welcome fall with a splash of island spirit. Don your best Hawaiian shirts, leis, or grass skirts and head to the scenic Old Town Clovis Trail for a run/walk event you won't forget!

Registration Includes:

  • Custom Aloha Run T-shirt

  • Finisher medal

  • Awards for top finishers in the competitive category

  • Entry into our post-run raffle

  • Tropical treats and refreshments at the finish line!

Why Join Us?

  • Celebrate health, community, and Hawaiian spirit

  • Perfect for competitive runners and casual runners/walkers

All ages, all abilities, all welcome!

Ready to Run or Walk?
Register today – spots fill up fast!

Let the island breeze guide your stride. We’ll see you at the starting line—Aloha style!

description:
📅 SAVE THE DATE: 3/14/2026!

🏃‍♂️🎉 Get ready for a fun-filled race day while supporting Birney Elementary in University Heights!

Why Pi Day? Because 3.14 miles of running just makes sense! But since Pi Day falls on a Friday, we’re bringing the fun to Saturday, 3/14 so everyone can join in!

🌟 What to Expect:
✅ Multiple race distances—all on a 3.14-mile loop Max PI (Every lap counts), Half PI, & Kids/Family Run.
✅ Food vendors, music, raffles, and a guaranteed dang good time!
✅ A spectator-friendly venue at the Velodrome in Morley Field—plenty of seating, restrooms, and all the action right in the center of the track!

Bring your friends, family, and your best running spirit—whether you’re racing or just there to cheer, it’s going to be a blast!

Stay tuned for more details—see you on 3/14! 🏃‍♀️🔥

name: The Cedar Grove Scamper - Presented by Chico Running Club
description:
Join us for Chico Running Club's Spring 4 Miler, the Cedar Grove Scamper. For our second year the race will again feature an Open Division (all ages) and a Master's Division (age 40+). Race proceeds benefit Chico Running Club, celebrating our 50th year in 2025. Our programs include our scholarship fund and our non-profit mission to support running events and local runners in Chico and the North State.

Date: Saturday May 16, 2026 @ 8am
Location: Cedar Grove Picnic Area in Bidwell Park, Chico - Google Map
Parking: At the Cedar Grove dirt lot, or overflow on East 8th Street

Course: A beautiful 4 mile loop through lower Bidwell park, the course starts and ends at Cedar Grove picnic area. Surfaces are pavement and dirt trail.
The course begins at South Park Drive and quickly crosses the Forest Avenue bridge to the North side of Big Chico Creek. From there it runs up Peterson Memorial drive then doubles back on the Vallombrosa dirt trail. It proceeds until turning back on South Park Drive after the Highway 99 over-crossing to return to Cedar Grove. Course Map

Divisions: There are two race divisions- enter either the Open Division (all ages) or the Master's Division (ages 40+). Prizes will be given to the top finishers in each division.

Bibs and Timing: Bibs will be given to all race entrants. Packet pick-up will be at Fleet Feet Friday May 15th from 1:30-4:30. Bib pick-up can also be done the day of the race at Cedar Grove, starting at 7:30. Timing will be performed by Chico Running Club.

Aid Stations: One water station will be on the course at the half way point of the race. Please carry any water or food needed during the race. Water and snacks are available at the start and finish, park bathrooms are available at Cedar Grove.

Give Aways: All those who registered before Sunday April 26th and selected the shirt option ($15 additional) will receive a shirt at check-in.

Discounted Registration: To celebrate our 50th anniversary Chico Running Club Members receive 50% off race registration. You can join the club at our website. Please don't select member registration unless you are signed up as a member.

Refreshments: Drinks and snacks will be provided after the race. Please stay after completing the race to cheer on other participants as they cross the finish.

Volunteers: Not ready to participate? Volunteers are needed and welcome for this race. Please click on the volunteer tab in the RunSignUp menu to sign up.

Sponsors: Would you like to sponsor this event? We have T-Shirt, Refreshment, and Event Sponsor tiers.

Race Insurance: Is provided by a RunSignUp partner. Chico Running Club does not provide or administer race insurance should participants elect to purchase it.

name: The Cedar Grove Scamper - Presented by Chico Running Club
description:
Join us for Chico Running Club's Spring 4 Miler, the Cedar Grove Scamper. For our second year the race will again feature an Open Division (all ages) and a Master's Division (age 40+). Race proceeds benefit Chico Running Club, celebrating our 50th year in 2025. Our programs include our scholarship fund and our non-profit mission to support running events and local runners in Chico and the North State.

Date: Saturday May 16, 2026 @ 8am
Location: Cedar Grove Picnic Area in Bidwell Park, Chico - Google Map
Parking: At the Cedar Grove dirt lot, or overflow on East 8th Street

Course: A beautiful 4 mile loop through lower Bidwell park, the course starts and ends at Cedar Grove picnic area. Surfaces are pavement and dirt trail.
The course begins at South Park Drive and quickly crosses the Forest Avenue bridge to the North side of Big Chico Creek. From there it runs up Peterson Memorial drive then doubles back on the Vallombrosa dirt trail. It proceeds until turning back on South Park Drive after the Highway 99 over-crossing to return to Cedar Grove. Course Map

Divisions: There are two race divisions- enter either the Open Division (all ages) or the Master's Division (ages 40+). Prizes will be given to the top finishers in each division.

Bibs and Timing: Bibs will be given to all race entrants. Packet pick-up will be at Fleet Feet Friday May 15th from 1:30-4:30. Bib pick-up can also be done the day of the race at Cedar Grove, starting at 7:30. Timing will be performed by Chico Running Club.

Aid Stations: One water station will be on the course at the half way point of the race. Please carry any water or food needed during the race. Water and snacks are available at the start and finish, park bathrooms are available at Cedar Grove.

Give Aways: All those who registered before Sunday April 26th and selected the shirt option ($15 additional) will receive a shirt at check-in.

Discounted Registration: To celebrate our 50th anniversary Chico Running Club Members receive 50% off race registration. You can join the club at our website. Please don't select member registration unless you are signed up as a member.

Refreshments: Drinks and snacks will be provided after the race. Please stay after completing the race to cheer on other participants as they cross the finish.

name: The Cobra 5Kai, 10Kai & Half Miyagithon
description:
May 16, 2026 · 7:00 a.m. PST · 6846 Owensmouth Ave, Canoga Park, CA

Join us for The Cobra 5Kai, 10Kai & Half Miyagithon. An 80s-inspired martial arts throwback run along the iconic LA River Path!

Presented by Jed & Ted’s Excellent Races

Strike first. Strike hard. No mercy.
Whether you’re running for Miyagi-Do honor or Cobra Kai glory, this is your shot to earn a finisher’s medal with dojo-level pride.

Choose your challenge:

  • The 5Kai – Out-and-back power sprint to awaken your inner warrior.
  • The 10Kai – Twice the distance, double the badassery.
  • The Half Miyagithon – Go the distance. Channel the balance. Defeat your limits.
  • The Multiverse Dojo Dash (Virtual) – For anyone who can’t make it to our timeline but still wants to join the fight. Run from your own dimension and earn the same medal as the in person warriors.

Expect high-energy music, 80s and 90s throwbacks, themed signage, and a cheering crowd that knows the way of the fist. Costumes welcome. Finish line crane kicks encouraged.

This is a Jed & Ted’s Excellent Race...fun, fast, and full of heart.

Sign up now. Mercy is for the weak.

 

Parody Note:
This event is a fan made parody inspired by classic pop culture and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any official rights holders. It’s all for fun, community, and good energy.

name: The Great Bunny Hop – 5K, 10K, 10-Miler, Half Marathon
description:
Let's hippity hop together!

Race Details

Start Location: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Ave. Long Beach, CA
Parking: Parking in the local lots is usually $2/hour and starts at 8am, if you are running the Half/10m you can use the Passport app to pay for parking. Street parking is free but limited.

Event Schedule

Friday
4-6:00pm – Early bib pick-up on the 2nd floor at Sports Basement Long Beach (store discount sent via email race week)

Saturday
6:20am – Bib pick-up opens
7:00am – Half marathon & 10m start
7:30am – 5k & 10k start
7:35am – Registration & start line close
10:20am – Course closes (3 hours, 20 minutes for the Half and 10m)

Early start of 6:30am may be pre-arranged for half marathoners and 10-milers only, email your request to events@hightideruns.com. All early starters will not be eligible for awards.

Out and Back Course

5k & 10k: The 5k route is used for the 5k (one lap) and 10k (two laps) – 5k route
10m: The 5m route is used for the 10m (two laps) – 5m route
Half: The 5m route is run twice and the 5k route is run once for the Half – 5m route and 5k route

More about the Course

The beach path is an open course, so you will encounter others using it. When we start the race, please stay on the right side of the beach path. The right side is for pedestrians and the left side is for cyclists.

On-Course Support: A fully stocked water station is along the course. The finish line will also have an aid station stocked with water, electrolytes, gels, and fruit snacks. We have a first aid kit at each station and all High Tides Crew Members have received CPR training. The turns are clearly marked with chalk, a runner turn sign, and a flag

Final Details

Bib: Please wear your race bib on the front of your shirt so we can track your time and send your pics!
Gear Check: You may leave personal items with staff at the registration tent. Please bring your own bag.
Medals: All finishers earn a race medal. 1st place medals are given to the overall 1st male and female in each distance
Results & Photos: An email with race results and photos will be sent the day after the race and earlier on Instagram. Race photos are free!

Join Us Again: Did you have a blast running with us at our low-pressure, high vibes race? We have themed races throughout the year in Long Beach, the San Fernando Valley, San Diego, and Orange County. Register for multiple races at a time to earn a discount. Check our full schedule

Have Another Question? Check our FAQ page, it's probably answered there!

name: The HEART RUN Half Marathon & 5K/10K
description:
❤️ The HEART RUN Half Marathon, 10K, 5K, & Kid’s Dash  Saturday, February 13th, Valentine's DAY, 2027
Celebrate Valentine’s Day in a healthy, heart-filled way! Whether you're running for a personal best, walking with a sweetheart, or bringing the whole family, this is Southern California’s premier February race. Enjoy a flat, fast course at beautiful Bolsa Chica State Beach and stay for the festival!

🏃‍♀️ Packet Pick-Up Options
Skip the lines on race morning and grab your gear early!

Option 1: Pre-Race Packet Pick-Up (Optional)

  • Date: Thursday, February 11
    Time: 3:30PM – 6:30PM
    Location: Road Runner Sports in Newport Beach
    Address: 1835 Newport Blvd, Costa Mesa, CA 92627

Option 2: Race Day Pick-Up

  • If you can't make it Thursday, don't worry! You can pick up your bib and shirt on race morning starting at 6:30 AM in LOT 25. (State Park gates open at 6:00 AM).

🚗 High Traffic Alert & Parking Info
Please Plan Ahead: The State Park entrance gate no longer accepts cash.  Have a credit card handy, or quickly waive a parking pass.  We are working to get them to provide hourly parking and NO GATE FEE for races, but that is not in the works for approval until possibly 2027. 

  • Arrive Early: We kindly ask that you plan to arrive early to ensure you are parked and ready.
  • Carpooling: We highly encourage carpooling! It saves you money and helps everyone get into the park faster.
  • Entrance Fee: The State Park charges $15 per car. Please have a credit card or your State Parking Pass ready to keep the line moving.
  • Free Parking Option: Free LIMITED parking is available in Sunset Beach for those willing to arrive extra early and walk into the park. (No car entrance at the far corner of Lot 25; use the Main Gate in the mid-section).

📅 Race Day Schedule (Saturday, Feb 14)
6:30 AM: Race Day Check-In Begins (Lot 25)
7:00 AM – 11:00 AM: February Festival Expo & Valentine Card Station
8:00 AM: Half Marathon Start
8:15 AM: Kid’s Dash (Tot Trot & Youth)
8:30 AM: 5K & 10K Mass Start
9:10 AM: 5K Overall & Division Awards
9:30 AM: 10K Awards Ceremony
9:45 AM: Half Marathon Awards Ceremony
 
🎁 Caren Ware Event's have SO CAL's BEST BLING!  Participant Swag
for The Heart Run includes:

  • Custom Apparel: A high-quality 5K/10K race shirt or a premium Long-Sleeve "Finisher" Hoodie (exclusive to Half Marathon participants).
  • The Medal: BEST DESIGNED and HUGE Custom finisher medal with a distance-specific neck ribbon.
  • Access to our "Full of Heart" section, including a complimentary DIY Valentine’s card-making station, free POPCORN, a scrumptious food court, and a chance to decorate your own heart cookie. Bring some spare cash.  

🍪 February Festival Expo & Treats
Fuel up and have fun! Add a $6 Food Voucher to your registration to use at any booth, including:

  • Galletina’s Specialty Cookies: Delicious heart-themed treats.
  • Tacos & Tamales: Authentic post-race fuel.
  • Fresh Fruit & Whole Coconuts: A refreshing tropical recovery.
  • Specialty Coffee: To kickstart your morning.
  • New for 2026: Visit our "Decorate Your Own Cookie" experience booth!
  •  
  • AWARDS:
    There are “In It To Win It” age categories 3 deep with 5-year age spans:
    1-10, 11-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-29, 30-34, 35-39 40-44, 45-49, 50-54,55-59 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79 and 80-84, 85 & plus.
     

📍 Essential Logistics
Location: Bolsa Chica State Beach, LOT 25 (Corner of Warner & PCH).
Parking: Entry is via the Main State Park Gate only (mid-section of the beach). Parking is $15 (Credit Card or State Pass required).

Pro Tip:

  • Free LIMITED parking is available in Sunset Beach for those arrive early and willing to walk into the park.
  • Finisher Medals: Collect your medal at the designated table under the finish arch (Left for Half, Middle for 10K, Right for 5K).
  • Family & Pet Friendly: Strollers are welcome! Pets are allowed but must be kept on a leash with responsible clean-up.

Run for a Cause: Proceeds support the Ware in the World Foundation, providing medical supplies and schooling in Nepal and supporting Miss Pam’s Ranch for troubled youth, working with local food banks.  Each race reaches a special need Caren has RUN into , running around the world and into things to support locally.

name: The Hoag OC Marathon Running Festival
description: The Hoag OC Marathon Running Festival includes four different runs during the first weekend in May annually. The weekend of running begins at the OC Fair and Event Center on Saturday morning with the award winning Hoag Kids Run the OC when nearly 9,000 kids from over 150 Orange County schools participate. The afternoon kicks off with the CELEBRATE OC Festival with local sports teams, craft brews and some of Orange County's iconic brands and live music all day. Later in the day on Saturday, the OC 5K takes place with a fun, flat tour of the OC Fairgrounds and nearby Orange Coast College followed by the Celebrate OC Finish Festival. Sunday morning begins early in Newport Beach. The exceptional OC Marathon & Half Marathon course is a blend of chic coastal scenery, tranquil nature and sophisticated arts and shopping which equal the best of OC. Enjoy breathtaking views of the Pacific Ocean and cruise down historic PCH through the seaside village of Corona del Mar. Run above pristine wetlands of Upper Newport, the Arts District and shopping mecca of South Coast Plaza in the "Heart of the OC" to the supportive cheers of residents in the many diverse neighborhoods and finish with a huge party at the Sunday Celebrate Finish Festival at the OC Fair and Event Center.

name: The Honey Badger Half (& 10K/5K)
description:
The Badger's race RETURNS to China Camp State Park in Santa Venetia, CA! If the LIVE option doesn't work for you, we're supporting VIRTUAL as well. We'll be happy to ship your swag and you can participate wherever you are! 

Where: China Camp State Park in Santa Venetia, CA.
When: Sun, 9/13- 9:15AM-1:00PM 
Course Maps: 5K Course Map, 10K Course Map, Half Marathon Course Map.

*NOTE-The half marathon is a STOUT challenge. We would NOT recommend the half marathon if you've never covered this distance before and/or you are not doing any kind of trail running currently.

The Swag:

All participants receive...

  • An epic, trail run at China Camp State Park (assuming you're not participating virtually)
  • An AWESOME race woodallion AND lifestyle tee
  • A custom Honey Badger beer sampler stein.
  • An awesome post race goodie bag & post race snacks/beverages including Jambar, Bellwether Farms Yogurt, and more!
  • Access to the post race BREWFEST sponsored by Standard Deviant Brewing.

Pre-Race Bib & Shirt Pickup:

-Sat, 9/12 from 12-4PM at A Runner's Mind SF (3575 Sacramento St).

A friend/family member can pickup your bib/shirt for you if they furnish proof of your registration. We will also support race morning bib pickup between 7:30-9AM at the race start/finish area.

PLEASE NOTE WE CANNOT SUPPORT REFUNDS, TRANSFERS, AND/OR CREDITS.

In the event of race cancellation due to wildfires, hazardous air quality, hazardous weather conditions, natural disasters, COVID and/or other global pandemics, or any 'act of God' (force majeure) that is beyond our control, we cannot support refunds, transfers, and/or credits. Please note this has only happened ONCE due to COVID in 2020, but anything is possible. Please make sure you are comfortable with these potential risks before you sign up. 

In the event of race cancellation due to any of the aforementioned, we will ship all race swag/items to participants and provide direction around navigating the course(s) on your own. We'll also provide direction around submitting your result. 

We also cannot support refunds, transfers, and/or race credits if you get injured in the days/week(s) leading up to race day, if your schedule changes in the days/week(s) leading up to race day, if a work trip comes up that makes it impossible for you to attend on race day, and/or any other professional or personal matter that arises making it difficult for you to attend in person on race day.

In the event of any of the aforementioned, we will ship all race swag/items to said participants and provide direction around navigating the course(s) on your own. We'll also provide direction around submitting your result.

name: The Liberty Center Mystery
description:
This weblink serves to direct your interest by visiting our facility in-person. No payments will be accepted via this webpage. Punch Cards are available for purchase in-person at VADM Martin Liberty. See below for new info on how to enter. 

 

There's been a MURDER at VADM Martin Liberty Center and it's up to YOU to solve the mystery!😱 Based on the board game CLUE, be the first to correctly guess ALL THREE important details of the case: WHO committed the murder, WHAT was the weapon, and in which room (WHERE) did the murder occur. Enter for a chance to win a prize. 

 

CASE

Details of the case are only available in-person at VADM Martin Liberty Center, BLDG 1507, NASNI.

HOW TO PLAY

Enter to win by purchasing a $5.00 guessing Punch Card, only available in-person at the front counter. Your Punch Card includes 6 guesses aka 6 Accusation Slips that you fill out and submit for 6 chances to correctly identify the murderer, weapon, and location. 

PUNCH CARD

Our Punch Cards are designed to fit perfectly in your wallet. Upon purchase, please write your name on the back of the card in permanent marker. It is your responsibility to ensure you don’t lose your punch card. In the event that you lose your Punch Card, a new Punch Card may be purchased for $5.00. Similarly, once you've used all 6 guesses, a new Punch Card may be purchased for additional guesses.

ACCUSATION SLIP

You may only submit one Accusation Slip per day; therefore you may only make one guess per day. Accusation Slips must be completed in pen. Please write your First and Last name, phone number, and date and time at the bottom of the slip. Clearly mark your selection for the murderer, weapon, and room by marking the box next to the corresponding item. Note that you may only select one murderer, one weapon, and one location per Accusation Slip. Selecting more than one in each category will result in a void Accusation Slip. Additionally, ambiguously marked selections will result in a void Accusation Slip. Attempting to submit more than one Accusation Slip per day will result in all slips being void. 

 

Your Accusation Slip must be entered within facility hours of operation and placed in the designated box. Slips will not be accepted past closing time. 

 

Accusation Slips will be reviewed daily, and the submission box will “reset” every morning at 0900. In the event, that we determine a winner, an announcement will be posted in facility, and the winner will be contacted by phone. 

TERMS AND CONDITIONS

Must be Active Duty E1-E6 to win.

name: The Long Beach Halloween Run 5K. 10K. Half Marathon by Califlow Runs
description:
🎃 The Long Beach Halloween Run
5K • 10K • Half Marathon • Kids Dash

📍 Start/Finish: Alamitos Beach, 780 E Shoreline Dr., Long Beach, CA
📸 Iconic Backdrop: The legendary Queen Mary

Get ready for a hauntingly good run along the Long Beach shoreline.

The Long Beach Halloween Run brings spooky-season energy to one of the most iconic coastal courses in Southern California. As you race along the waterfront, the Queen Mary looms in the background — rich with history, mystery, and more than a few ghost stories of her own. 👻⚓️

Costumes are encouraged, vibes are high, and the miles are unforgettable. Whether you’re chasing a PR, running for fun, or just here to show off your costume, this is Halloween done the CaliFlow way.

 
🏁 Race Day Schedule
6:00 AM – Runner Check-In & Bib Pickup Opens
7:30 AM – Half Marathon Start
8:30 AM – 5K & 10K Start (All Ages Welcome)
9:15 AM – NEW! Kids Dash (200-yard dash for kids 10 & under) 🎃🧒

 
🕸️ Why You’ll Love This Race
✅ Iconic Course: Flat, fast waterfront miles at Alamitos Beach
✅ Professional Chip Timing: Accurate results for every runner
✅ Incredible Photo Ops: Queen Mary, harbor views & skyline
✅ Finish Line Festival: Music, energy, and CaliFlow vibes
✅ Free Race-Day Photos: Memories included
✅ Kids Dash Medals: Every little ghoul earns one
✅ Beginner-, walker-, stroller-, and dog-friendly 🐾

 
🧡 Run the Coast. Feel the Spirit.
CaliFlow Runs brings together community, creativity, and unforgettable race-day experiences. Whether you’re dressed spooky, silly, or somewhere in between, the Long Beach Halloween Run is a celebration of movement, fun, and a little October magic by the sea.

Come for the run.
Stay for the vibes.
Leave with candy, medals, and memories. 🎃

Sunday, February 14, 2027 | Long Beach, CA
5K • 10K • Half Marathon

Celebrate love, friendship, and movement this Valentine’s Day at the Long Beach Sweethearts Run! Whether you’re running solo, with your sweetheart, your bestie, or your fur babe — this is your moment to shine with miles, smiles, and signature CaliFlow energy. 💘

 
🏁 Race Info
📍 Location: Granada Beach — 5000 E Ocean Blvd, Long Beach, CA 90803

Everyone!

If it’s not CaliFlow…
it’s just an average race. 💘

name: The Lucky Run
description:
The Lucky Run is a March race celebrating the start of spring. Race distances include a 2K, 5K, 7K, 10K and Kids Fun Runs. Events start and finish at Davis High School in North Davis (adjacent to Community Park). The 2025 event will be held in the gym parking lot off Oak Avenue. Loop courses travel along city streets, along bike paths and through residential neighborhoods.

Entry for the 2K, 5K, 7K, and 10K includes a short sleeve dri-blend t-shirt, finisher medal, timing and eligibility for age group awards, and post-race refreshments.
Entry to the Kids Runs includes a t-shirt, finisher's medal and post-race refreshments (race is not timed).

name: The Master's University Winter 5K
description:
RACE DAY NEED TO KNOW:

Check-In and Packet Pickup: Begins at 7AM at TMU's North Campus, and ends at the start of your race. You will receive your Race Number, Timing Chip, and T-Shirt (sizes subject to availability for participants who registered after 12/15/26)

The Master's University, North Campus Address: 24736 Quigley Canyon Rd, Santa Clarita, CA 91321

Parking: Arrive early to find parking. Parking is NOT available at North Campus (P3). Free parking is available in any of TMU's lots apart from P3. CLICK HERE for a campus map. (Available lots: P1, P2A, P2B, P2C, P4. Additional parking is available at TMU's Centennial lot). Carpool recommended. 

 

Since 2011, The Master’s University Winter 5K has been a favorite among local runners thanks to the welcoming atmosphere, scenic course, and community partnerships. This year we are continuing 2025's new features; the Kids 1K, and a more competitive 5K race – the 5K Challenge. The 5K Challenge will be limited to participants whose goal is to complete the race in around 35 minutes. Our traditional 5K Run/Walk will take place immediately following the 5K Challenge.
 
This year's course will replicate the 2025 course. The race will start on TMU’s north campus, wind through Placerita Canyon and Quigley Canyon Open Space, and will finish at the starting point on north campus. The Master's University Winter 5K boasts a scenic and entirely flat course with varying terrain, perfect for participants of all ages and abilities. Come experience what local runners have called their “favorite way to start off the new year!”

 

2026-27 REGISTRATION SCHEDULE

 

Kids K:

JUL 1 -- Early Registration ($10)

SEP 1 -- General Registration ($15)

DEC 15 -- Last day to register and guarantee souvenir T-shirt

JAN 23 -- Race Day Registration ($20): Online or In-Person (Credit, Check or Cash Available)

 

5K Challenge & 5K Run/Walk:

JUL 1 -- Early Registration ($30)

SEP 1 -- Priority Registration ($35)

NOV 1 -- General Registration ($40)

DEC 15 -- Last day to register and guarantee souvenir T-shirt

JAN 9 -- Late Registration ($45)

JAN 23 -- Race Day Registration ($50): Online or In-Person (Credit, Check or Cash Available)
 

 
AWARDS
Participants in the Kids K, 5K Challenge and 5K Run/Walk will all receive event t-shirts (exact size not guaranteed for late registrants) and medallions.
 
Prizes for the overall male and female winners, will be awarded per age group of the 5K Challenge race.

name: The Observatory Loop Relay
description:
The event is now sold out. If you are interested in competing, please register for the waitlist and we will let in new teams if we get any scratches. 

 

On Thursday, February 26 the Leap Day/Observatory Loop Relay will return for year three. This is a 4 x Mile trail relay race, where teams of two, take on the one mile long Observatory Loop. Each team will run the loop four times, with team members alternating laps, and handing off a baton at the conclusion of each lap. (That means each individual runner will do the loop two times, with a break between each loop.) 

The race will start at 7pm. This means it will be dark during the race! Runners are required to race in headlamps. 

You can sign up with a partner or individually (and we will place you with a partner).

This event is open to runners of all ability levels. All runners take home a branded baton.

name: The Pena Passage
description:
The inaugural Pena Passage, Lagoon Valley's Trail Race, presented by Altra, promises runners and hikers of every stride and skill level a scenic and adventurous trail race. Set against the stunning backdrop of Lagoon Valley Park’s rolling hills, shimmering lagoon, winding single-track trails, and fire roads, this event offers three distinct distances to challenge and delight participants.

 

The 5K course weaves through gentle terrain, ideal for first-time trail runners with some adventurous single track included, families, and those looking for a fun yet invigorating run or hike.

 

In contrast, the 10K route introduces slightly more rugged sections and elevation, testing endurance while rewarding runners with sweeping views of open grasslands and shaded oak groves.

 

For seasoned trail enthusiasts seeking a true test of resilience, the 30K distance presents every challenge of the 10k route but times three! Runners will traverse a mix of technical trails, climbs, and descents that showcase the park’s natural beauty and varied ecosystems.

 

Each course is thoughtfully marked and supported, with aid stations positioned to keep athletes hydrated and motivated. The following is a list of some of the foods and beverages each aid station may provide: Electrolyte drink, Energy gels, chews, pretzels, Oreo cookies, water, M&M’s, bananas, and watermelon! Whether competing for personal bests or simply soaking in the camaraderie of the trail running community, participants will find the Pena Passage, Lagoon Valley's Trail Race an unforgettable experience that celebrates both the spirit of competition and the tranquility of nature.

 


The Kids Fun Run at the Pena Passage a Lagoon Valley trail race is all about smiles, movement, and big finish-line energy. Young runners dash up the scenic trail with cheers from parents and volunteers echoing through the route. It’s a short, playful race that celebrates effort over speed and confidence over competition. Every kid leaves feeling like a champion—and usually asking when they can do it again.

Our race shirts are long sleeve tech tees to shield you from the elements all year long. With sun defense, moisture-wicking technology and comfortable fit, it fits the needs of every athlete. To be guaranteed a shirt and shirt size, you must register by May 15, 2026.

We are partnering with NAMI Solano County - a local mental health service charity. 

Interested in being a sponsor or vendor? Email Ivette at Ivette@fleetfeetvacaville.com


Start times

30K 7AM

5K, 10K 8 AM

Kids Run 9:30 AM

name: The Praise Run
description:
What Is The Praise Run?
A community movement with eternal impact — and your brand at the center of it.
The Praise Run is more than a race. It’s a purpose-driven event that fuses faith, fitness, and philanthropy drawing hundreds of runners, families, churches, and community leaders together to worship through movement and support a life-changing cause.

Join us for a powerful morning of movement, worship, and gratitude at The Praise Run — a 5K, 10K, or Half Marathon run to celebrate the goodness of God and raise support for the Parkker Hope Program.

Whether you're walking, jogging, or running, every step is an act of praise. Write what you're praising God for on your race bib. It could be healing, breakthrough, salvation, restoration, or simply the breath in your lungs.

This Isn't just a run.
It's a declaration.
🎶 Live worship music along the race route
🙏 Opening inspiration from Paul McClain: Leveling Up Your Life
🇺🇸 Prayer and national anthem by Pastor Branamier & God’s House Worship
📖 Stories of praise worn on bibs — turning the course into a testimony
💛 Support for the Parkker Hope Program, which offers spiritual, mental, and physical healing support for kids fighting cancer
